高管薪酬安排 Executive Compensation Arrangements

#### 高管录用通知函

#### Executive Offer Letters

作为我们的联合创始人，我们的具名高管未与我们签订录用通知函或任何其他关于其雇佣关系的正式安排或谅解。我们目前未与任何具名高管签订雇佣协议或录用通知函。我们所有具名高管均以随意雇佣方式任职，无固定雇佣期限。我们的每位具名高管将在特定符合条件的终止雇佣情形下获得福利，具体如“—控制权变更与遣散安排”一节所述。

As our Co-Founders, our named executive officers did not enter into offer letters or any other formal arrangements or understandings with us regarding their employment. We currently do not have employment agreements or offer letters with any of our named executive officers. All of our named executive officers are employed on an at-will basis, with no fixed term of employment. Each of our named executive officers will receive benefits upon certain qualifying terminations as described in the section titled “—Change of Control and Severance Arrangements.”

#### 高管遣散与控制权变更计划

#### Executive Severance and Change in Control Plan

就本次发行，我们通过了高管遣散与控制权变更计划，我们的每位具名高管均将参与该计划。高管遣散与控制权变更计划将在本次发行完成后生效。

In connection with this offering, we adopted an executive severance and change in control plan, under which each of our named executive officers will participate. The executive severance and change in control plan will become effective upon the completion of this offering.

高管遣散与控制权变更计划规定，当我们以非“正当理由”解除高管的雇佣，或高管因“合理理由”辞职时（各术语定义见高管遣散与控制权变更计划），该高管将获得(i)相当于该高管 12 个月基本工资的一次性付款，以及(ii)继续支付 12 个月的 COBRA 保费（或如更早，则至该高管符合后续雇主计划下实质等同保障资格之日止）。

The executive severance and change in control plan provides that, upon a termination by us of an executive without “cause” or by the executive due to “good reason” (each as defined in the executive severance and change in control plan), the executive will receive (i) a lump sum payment equal to 12 months of such executive’s base salary and (ii) continued payment of COBRA premiums for 12 months (or, if earlier, until the date that the executive is eligible for substantially equivalent coverage under a subsequent employer’s plan).

高管遣散与控制权变更计划还规定，如果该等雇佣终止发生在“控制权变更”（定义见高管遣散与控制权变更计划）之前三个月内或之后 12 个月内，该高管将获得(i)相当于 12 个月基本工资的一次性付款，(ii)继续支付 12 个月的 COBRA 保费（或如更早，则至高管符合后续雇主计划下实质等同保障资格之时止），以及(iii)该高管持有的所有未兑现且未归属股权奖励的完全加速归属，但须受限于绩效条件的任何未兑现且未归属股权奖励将改为适用相应奖励协议中规定的条款。

The executive severance and change in control plan also provides that, if such termination of employment occurs within three months prior to, or 12 months following, a “change in control” (as defined in the executive severance and change in control plan), the executive will receive (i) a lump sum payment equal to 12 months of base salary, (ii) continued payment of COBRA premiums for 12 months (or, if earlier, when the executive is eligible for substantially equivalent coverage under a subsequent employer’s plan), and (iii) full accelerated vesting of all outstanding and unvested equity award held by the executive, provided that any outstanding and unvested equity awards subject to performance conditions will instead be subject to the terms set forth in the applicable award agreements.

如果我们的具名高管有权获得高管遣散与控制权变更计划项下福利以外的任何福利，则其在高管遣散与控制权变更计划项下的各项福利仅在此类福利比该等其他安排项下相应福利更为有利的范围内提供。高管遣散与控制权变更计划项下的所有此类遣散付款和福利均以各高管签署对我们的一般性索赔豁免为前提。

If our named executive officers are entitled to any benefits other than the benefits under the executive severance and change in control plan, each of his benefits under the executive severance and change in control plan shall be provided only to the extent more favorable than the corresponding benefit under such other arrangement. All such severance payments and benefits under the executive severance and change in control plan will be subject to each executive’s execution of a general release of claims against us.

股票计划 Stock Plans

我们认为，我们授予基于股权的奖励的能力是一项有价值的薪酬工具，使我们能够通过将员工、顾问和董事会成员的经济利益与股东的利益保持一致，来吸引、留住和激励他们。我们的股权激励计划的主要特征概述如下。这些概述完全以计划的实际文本为准，计划文本作为本招股说明书所构成注册声明的附件提交。

We believe that our ability to grant equity-based awards is a valuable compensation tool that enables us to attract, retain, and motivate our employees, consultants, and members of our board of directors by aligning their financial interests with those of our stockholders. The principal features of our equity incentive plans are summarized below. These summaries are qualified in their entirety by reference to the actual text of the plans, which are filed as exhibits to the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.

#### 2019 年股票期权计划

#### 2019 Stock Option Plan

2019 年 7 月，我们通过了 2019 年计划，该计划最近一次修订于 2025 年 3 月 12 日。2019 年计划的目的是吸引、留住和激励其贡献对我们业务成功至关重要的合资格员工、董事和顾问。

In July 2019, we adopted our 2019 Plan as most recently amended on March 12, 2025. The purpose of the 2019 Plan is to attract, retain, and motivate eligible employees, directors, and consultants whose contributions are important to the success of our business.

股份储备。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我们已预留 73,637,600 股 A 类普通股，用于根据 2019 年计划授予的奖励，其中 3,750,480 股仍可供授予。2024 年 12 月 31 日之后，我们将 2019 年计划下预留供发行的股份数量增加了 5,300,000 股。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，可购买 7,213,820 股的期权已被行使，可购买 47,218,580 股的期权仍尚未行使，加权平均行权价为每股 $1.75。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，2019 年计划下已授予 15,454,720 份 RSU 奖励。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，2019 年计划下未授予任何限制性股票股份，也未授予任何股票增值权（“SARs”），且预计在本次发行之前不会授予任何此类奖励；但 2019 年计划下授予的某些期权可提前行权，并可就未归属的普通股股份行权，但须受回购权约束。本次发行之后，2019 年计划下将不再授予新的奖励。

Share Reserve. As of December 31, 2024, we had 73,637,600 shares of our Class A common stock reserved for issuance pursuant to grants under our 2019 Plan of which 3,750,480 shares remained available for grant. Subsequent to December 31, 2024, we increased the number of shares reserved for issuance under our 2019 Plan by 5,300,000 shares. As of December 31, 2024, options to purchase 7,213,820 shares had been exercised and options to purchase 47,218,580 shares remained outstanding, with a weighted-average exercise price of $1.75 per share. As of December 31, 2024, 15,454,720 awards of RSUs were granted under the 2019 Plan. As of December 31, 2024, no shares of restricted stock and no stock appreciation rights (“SARs”) were granted under the 2019 Plan, and no such awards are expected to be granted prior to this offering; provided that certain options granted under the 2019 Plan are early exercisable and may be exercised for unvested shares of our common stock subject to a repurchase right. No new awards will be granted under the 2019 Plan after this offering.

管理。我们的 2019 年计划由我们的董事会或董事会任命的委员会管理，本文中称为“管理人”。在符合 2019 年计划条款的前提下，管理人有权（其中包括）选择将向其授予奖励的人员，解释和说明我们的 2019 年计划，以及制定、修订和废止与 2019 年计划及其下授予的奖励有关的规则和条例。管理人可在符合 2019 年计划条款的前提下修改奖励。

Administration. Our 2019 Plan is administered by our board of directors or a committee appointed by our board of directors, referred to herein as the “administrator.” Subject to the terms of the 2019 Plan, the administrator has the authority to, among other things, select the persons to whom awards will be granted, construe and interpret our 2019 Plan as well as to prescribe, amend and rescind rules and regulations relating to the 2019 Plan and awards granted thereunder. The administrator may modify awards subject to the terms of the 2019 Plan.

资格。根据 2019 年计划，我们只能向我们或我们母公司或子公司（如适用）的员工（包括同时为员工的执行官和董事）授予激励性股票期权（“ISOs”）。我们可以向我们或我们母公司及子公司（如适用）的员工（包括同时为员工的执行官和董事）、非员工董事和顾问授予非法定股票期权（“NQSOs”）、RSU、SARs 和限制性股票股份。

Eligibility. Pursuant to the 2019 Plan, we may grant incentive stock options (“ISOs”) only to our employees or the employees of our parent or subsidiaries, as applicable (including officers and directors who are also employees). We may grant non-statutory stock options (“NQSOs”), RSUs, SARs, and shares of restricted stock to our employees (including officers and directors who are also employees), non-employee directors, and consultants, or the employees, directors, and consultants of our parent and subsidiaries, as applicable.

股票期权。2019 年计划规定可授予(i)激励性股票期权（ISO），旨在符合《税法》第 422 条规定的税务处理资格，以及(ii)购买我们 A 类普通股的非合格股票期权（NQSO），两者均按规定的行权价格授予。每项期权的行权价格必须至少等于授予日我们普通股的公允市场价值（除非管理人另有决定）。但是，授予持有我们全部股本总合并投票权超过百分之十的个人的任何 ISO，其行权价格必须至少等于授予日我们普通股公允市场价值的 110%。管理人将确定适用于每项期权的归属时间表。根据我们 2019 年计划授予的期权的最长允许期限为自授予日起十年，但授予持有我们全部股本总合并投票权超过百分之十的个人的 ISO 的最长允许期限为自授予日起五年。

Stock Options. The 2019 Plan provides for the grant of both (i) ISOs, which are intended to qualify for tax treatment as set forth under Section 422 of the Code and (ii) NQSOs to purchase shares of our Class A common stock, each at a stated exercise price. The exercise price of each option must be at least equal to the fair market value of our common stock on the date of grant (unless otherwise determined by the administrator). However, the exercise price of any ISO granted to an individual who owns more than ten percent of the total combined voting power of all classes of our capital stock must be at least equal to 110% of the fair market value of our common stock on the date of grant. The administrator will determine the vesting schedule applicable to each option. The maximum permitted term of options granted under our 2019 Plan is ten years from the date of grant, except that the maximum permitted term of ISOs granted to an individual who owns more than ten percent of the total combined voting power of all classes of our capital stock is five years from the date of grant.

限制性股票单位。2019 年计划还允许授予限制性股票单位（RSU），其条款一般由管理人确定（依据 2019 年计划），并载于奖励协议中。RSU 代表在未来的指定日期获得我们 A 类普通股股份的权利，但该权利可能因雇佣终止或未能实现某些业绩条件而被没收。一般而言，根据 2019 年计划授予的 RSU 的归属须同时满足基于业绩的归属条件和基于时间的归属时间表，且须在该等 RSU 到期日或之前满足。如果在基于业绩的归属条件和基于时间的归属时间表均获满足之前发生雇佣或服务终止，则 RSU 将被没收；或者，一般而言，如果基于业绩的归属条件或基于时间的归属时间表任一未获满足，RSU 也将被没收。基于业绩的归属条件已在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日获满足。在基于业绩的归属条件获满足后，截至该流动性事件之日因 RSU 的基于时间的归属时间表而仍未归属的 RSU，将在基于业绩的归属条件获满足后继续归属，前提是持有人持续保持连续服务状态直至每个该等基于时间的归属日期。

Restricted Stock Units. The 2019 Plan also allows for the grant of restricted stock units, or RSUs, with terms as generally determined by the administrator (in accordance with the 2019 Plan) and to be set forth in an award agreement. RSUs represent the right to receive shares of our Class A common stock at a specified date in the future, subject to forfeiture of that right because of termination of employment or failure to achieve certain performance conditions. Generally, the vesting of our RSUs granted under the 2019 Plan is upon satisfaction of both a performance-based vesting condition and a time-based vesting schedule on or before the expiration date of such RSUs. RSUs will be forfeited in case of a termination of employment or service before the satisfaction of both the performance-based vesting condition and the time-based vesting schedule or, otherwise, generally in case of non-satisfaction of either the performance-based vesting condition or the time-based vesting schedule. The performance-based vesting condition was satisfied upon the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. Following the satisfaction of the performance-based vesting condition, RSUs that remain unvested as of the date of such liquidity event due to the RSUs’ time-based vesting schedule will continue to vest after the performance-based vesting condition for so long as the holder remains in continuous service status through each such time-based vesting date.

限制性股票、股票增值权。此外，2019 年计划允许授予限制性股票奖励（RSA）和股票增值权（SAR），其条款一般由管理人确定（依据 2019 年计划），并载于奖励协议中。我们尚未根据 2019 年计划授予任何限制性股票股份或任何 SAR，且预计在本次发行之前不会授予任何此类奖励；但根据 2019 年计划授予的某些期权可提前行权，并可就未归属的普通股股份行权，但须受回购权约束。

Restricted Stock, Stock Appreciation Rights. In addition, the 2019 Plan allows for the grant of restricted stock awards (“RSAs”) and SARs, with terms as generally determined by the administrator (in accordance with the 2019 Plan) and to be set forth in an award agreement. We have not granted any shares of restricted stock or any SARs under the 2019 Plan and no such awards are expected to be granted prior to this offering; provided that certain options granted under the 2019 Plan are early exercisable and may be exercised for unvested shares of our common stock subject to a repurchase right.

有限可转让性。除非管理人另有决定，根据 2019 年计划授予的奖励一般不得以遗嘱、继承与分配法律以外的任何方式出售、质押、转让、抵押、转移或处置；对于 NQSO，亦不得通过向生前信托或遗嘱信托出具的文书进行转让（在该等信托中，NQSO 将在委托人死亡时传递给受益人），或通过赠与合格家庭成员的方式进行转让。

Limited Transferability. Unless otherwise determined by the administrator, awards granted under the 2019 Plan generally may not be sold, pledged, assigned, hypothecated, transferred, or disposed of in any manner other than by will, the laws of descent and distribution and, with respect to NQSOs, by instrument to an inter vivos or testamentary trust in which the NQSOs are to be passed to beneficiaries upon the death of the trustor, or by gift to a qualified family member.

控制权变更。如果我们发生“收购”或“其他合并”（定义见 2019 年计划，通常统指合并、出售或转让我们全部已发行证券表决权 50% 以上，或出售我们全部或实质上全部资产），2019 年计划规定，奖励将受证明该收购或其他合并的协议约束，该协议无需以类似方式对待所有奖励。该协议可在未经参与者同意的情况下，规定继续存续已授予奖励、承继或替代奖励、加速奖励归属、以现金、证券或其他对价结算奖励（无论是否已归属），或无偿注销该等奖励。

Change of Control. In the event that we are subject to an “acquisition” or “other combination” (as defined in the 2019 Plan and generally meaning, collectively, a merger, a sale or transfer of more than 50% of the voting power of all of our outstanding securities, or a sale of all or substantially all of the assets of ours), the 2019 Plan provides that awards will be subject to the agreement evidencing such acquisition or other combination, which agreement need not treat all awards in a similar manner. Such agreement may, without the participant’s consent, provide for the continuation of outstanding awards, the assumption or substitution of awards, the acceleration of vesting of awards, the settlement of awards (whether or not vested) in cash, securities, or other consideration, or the cancellation of such awards for no consideration.

调整。如果因股票股息、资本重组、股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股份细分、合并、重分类或其他影响我们股份的资本结构变动（且无对价）导致我们 A 类普通股的已发行股份数量发生变化，则为了防止 2019 年计划项下拟提供的利益或潜在利益减少或扩大，(i) 2019 年计划项下预留供发行的股份数量，(ii) 已授予期权和 SAR 的行权价格及对应股份数量，以及 (iii) 其他已授予奖励的购买价格和/或对应股份数量将（在适当范围内）按比例调整（须经董事会或我们的股东采取必要行动）。

Adjustments. In the event that the number of outstanding shares of our Class A common stock is changed by a stock dividend, recapitalization, stock split, reverse stock split, subdivision, combination, reclassification, or other change in our capital structure affecting our shares without consideration, then in order to prevent diminution or enlargement of the benefits or potential benefits intended to be made available under the 2019 Plan (i) the number of shares reserved for issuance under the 2019 Plan, (ii) the exercise prices of and number of shares subject to outstanding options and SARs, and (iii) the purchase prices of and/or number of shares subject to other outstanding awards will (to the extent appropriate) be proportionately adjusted (subject to required action by the board or our stockholders).

奖励的交换、重新定价和买断。管理人可修改、延长或续期奖励，或发行新奖励以换取交出并注销任何或全部已授予奖励，但前提是，如果任何该等行动会损害参与者的任何现有权利，则须征得相关参与者的同意。管理人可在未经股东事先批准的情况下，降低期权或 SAR 的行权价格，或买断先前授予的奖励并以现金、股份或其他对价支付，在每种情况下均须遵守 2019 年计划的条款。

Exchange, repricing, and buyout of awards. The administrator may modify, extend, or renew awards or issue new awards in exchange for the surrender and cancellation of any or all outstanding awards, provided that any such action will require the consent of the respective participants to the extent that any such action would impair any of the participants’ existing rights. The administrator may, without prior stockholder approval, reduce the exercise price of options or SARs or buy an award previously granted with payment in cash, shares or other consideration, in each case, subject to the terms of the 2019 Plan.

修订；终止。我们的董事会可随时修订或终止 2019 年计划，并可在我们解散或清算时终止任何及全部未行权的期权、RSU 或 SAR，但某些修订须经股东批准或参与者同意。自我们的 2025 年计划（如下所述）生效之日（即本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日的前一日）起，我们已停止根据 2019 年计划授予奖励。根据 2019 年计划授予的任何未行权奖励将在本次发行后继续有效，并受我们的 2019 年计划条款及适用奖励协议的约束，直至该等奖励被行权或按其条款终止或到期。

Amendment; Termination. Our board of directors may amend or terminate the 2019 Plan at any time and may terminate any and all outstanding options, RSUs, or SARs upon a dissolution or liquidation of us, provided that certain amendments will require shareholder approval or participant consent. We ceased issuing awards under the 2019 Plan upon the effective date of our 2025 Plan (described below), which was the date immediately prior to the date of the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. Any outstanding awards granted under the 2019 Plan will remain outstanding following this offering, subject to the terms of our 2019 Plan and applicable award agreements, until such awards are exercised or until they terminate or expire by their terms.

#### 2025 年股权激励计划

#### 2025 Equity Incentive Plan

2025 年 2 月，我们的董事会和股东批准了我们的 2025 年计划，作为我们 2019 年计划的继任计划，该计划于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日的前一日生效。2025 年计划授权授予 ISO（旨在符合《税法》第 422 条规定的税务处理资格）和 NQSO，以及授予 RSA、SAR、RSU 以及绩效和股票奖金奖励。根据 2025 年计划，ISO 仅可授予我们的员工。我们可向我们的员工、董事和顾问授予所有其他类型的奖励。

In February 2025, our board of directors and our stockholders approved our 2025 Plan as a successor to our 2019 Plan, which became effective on the date immediately prior to the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. The 2025 Plan authorizes the award of both ISOs, which are intended to qualify for tax treatment under Section 422 of the Code, and NQSOs, as well for the award of RSAs, SARs, RSUs, and performance and stock bonus awards. Pursuant to the 2025 Plan, ISOs may be granted only to our employees. We may grant all other types of awards to our employees, directors, and consultants.

股份储备。我们最初预留了 50,000,000 股 A 类普通股，加上 2025 年计划生效日根据 2019 年计划未发行或不受未行权授予约束的任何预留 A 类普通股，用于根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的奖励作为我们的 A 类普通股发行。根据我们的 2025 年计划预留用于发行的股份数量将在 2026 年至 2035 年每年的 1 月 1 日自动增加，增加数量等于以下两者中的较小者：(a) 截至紧接前一年 12 月 31 日我们所有类别普通股已发行股份总数加上优先股转换后可发行的 A 类普通股股份总数（如有）的百分之五，或 (b) 我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可能确定的 A 类普通股股份数量。

Share Reserve. We have initially reserved 50,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock, plus any reserved shares of our Class A common stock not issued or subject to outstanding grants under the 2019 Plan on the effective date of the 2025 Plan, for issuance as our Class A common stock pursuant to awards granted under our 2025 Plan. The number of shares reserved for issuance under our 2025 Plan will increase automatically on January 1 of each of 2026 through 2035 by the number of shares equal to the lesser of (a) five percent of the aggregate number of outstanding shares of all classes of our common stock plus the total number of shares of our Class A common stock issuable upon conversion of preferred stock (if any), in each case as of the immediately preceding December 31, or (b) such number of shares of our Class A common stock as may be determined by our board of directors or our compensation committee.

此外，下述股份将再次可用于根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的奖励发行：

In addition, the shares set forth below will again be available for issuance pursuant to awards granted under our 2025 Plan:

- 根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的期权或 SAR 所对应的股份，因行权以外的任何原因不再受该期权或 SAR 约束的；

- shares subject to options or SARs granted under our 2025 Plan that cease to be subject to the option or SAR for any reason other than exercise of the option or SAR;

- 根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的奖励所对应的股份，随后被我们没收或按原始发行价回购的；

- shares subject to awards granted under our 2025 Plan that are subsequently forfeited or repurchased by us at the original issue price;

- 根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的奖励所对应的股份，以其他方式终止而未发行该等股份的；

- shares subject to awards granted under our 2025 Plan that otherwise terminate without such shares being issued;

- 根据我们的 2025 年计划授予的奖励所对应的股份，被交出、取消或交换为现金或不同奖励（或其组合）的；

- shares subject to awards granted under our 2025 Plan that are surrendered, cancelled, or exchanged for cash or a different award (or combination thereof);

- 根据我们的 2019 计划授予的期权在 2025 计划生效日之后被没收的，行使该等期权可发行的股份；

- shares issuable upon the exercise of options granted under our 2019 Plan that, after the effective date of the 2025 Plan, are forfeited;

- 根据我们的 2019 计划授予的奖励而发行的股份，在 2025 计划生效日之后被没收或由我们按原价回购的；以及

- shares issued pursuant to awards granted under our 2019 Plan that are forfeited or repurchased by us at the original price after the effective date of the 2025 Plan; and

- 根据我们的 2019 计划或 2025 计划授予的奖励所涉及的股份，用于支付期权行权价格或代扣与任何奖励相关的纳税义务的。

- shares subject to awards under our 2019 Plan or our 2025 Plan that are used to pay the exercise price of an option or withheld to satisfy the tax withholding obligations related to any award.

截至本招股说明书日期，根据 2019 计划已预留但尚未发行的股份，或根据 2019 计划已发行但随后根据我们的 2025 计划可供授予的股份（如上所述），仅应作为我们的 A 类普通股股份根据 2025 计划发行。

Shares of our Class A common stock that were either reserved, but not issued under the 2019 Plan as of the date of this prospectus, or issued under the 2019 Plan and later become available for grant under our 2025 Plan, either as set forth above, shall be issued under the 2025 Plan only as shares of our Class A common stock.

管理。我们的 2025 计划由我们的薪酬委员会或由我们的董事会代行薪酬委员会职责进行管理。在 2025 计划的条款和条件约束下，管理人有权（其中包括）选择可向其授予奖励的人员，解释和说明我们的 2025 计划，以及确定该等奖励的条款，并制定、修订和废止与 2025 计划或据此授予的任何奖励相关的规则和条例。2025 计划规定，管理人可在适用法律允许的范围内将其权力（包括授予奖励的权力）授予一名或多名高级管理人员，但授予非雇员董事的奖励只能由我们的董事会决定。

Administration. Our 2025 Plan is administered by our compensation committee or by our board of directors acting in place of our compensation committee. Subject to the terms and conditions of the 2025 Plan, the administrator has the authority, among other things, to select the persons to whom awards may be granted, construe and interpret our 2025 Plan as well as to determine the terms of such awards and prescribe, amend, and rescind the rules and regulations relating to the 2025 Plan or any award granted thereunder. The 2025 Plan provides that the administrator may delegate its authority, including the authority to grant awards, to one or more executive officers to the extent permitted by applicable law, provided that awards granted to non-employee directors may only be determined by our board of directors.

期权。2025 计划规定授予旨在符合《税法》第 422 条资格的 ISO，以及以规定行权价格购买我们 A 类普通股股份的 NQSO。ISO 只能授予员工，包括同时为员工的高级管理人员和董事。根据 2025 计划授予的股票期权的行权价格必须至少等于授予日我们 A 类普通股的公允市场价值。授予直接或通过归属持有我们全部股本总合并投票权超过百分之十的个人的 ISO，其行权价格必须至少为授予日我们 A 类普通股公允市场价值的 110%。

Options. The 2025 Plan provides for the grant of both ISOs intended to qualify under Section 422 of the Code, and NQSOs to purchase shares of our Class A common stock at a stated exercise price. ISOs may only be granted to employees, including officers and directors who are also employees. The exercise price of stock options granted under the 2025 Plan must be at least equal to the fair market value of our Class A common stock on the date of grant. ISOs granted to an individual who holds, directly or by attribution, more than ten percent of the total combined voting power of all classes of our capital stock must have an exercise price of at least 110% the fair market value of our Class A common stock on the date of grant.

期权可根据管理人的决定，基于服务和/或业绩条件的达成情况归属。管理人可规定期权仅在归属后方可行权，或可立即行权，行权时发行的任何股份均受我们的回购权约束，该回购权随股份归属而失效。根据 ISO 发行的股份不得超过 150,000,000 股。根据我们的 2025 计划授予的期权的最长期限为自授予日起十年，但授予直接或通过归属持有我们全部股本总合并投票权超过百分之十的个人的 ISO 的最长允许期限为自授予日起五年。

Options may vest based on service and/or achievement of performance conditions, as determined by the administrator. The administrator may provide for options to be exercised only as they vest or to be immediately exercisable, with any shares issued on exercise being subject to our right of repurchase that lapses as the shares vest. No more than 150,000,000 shares may be issued pursuant to ISOs. The maximum term of options granted under our 2025 Plan is ten years from the date of grant, except that the maximum permitted term of ISOs granted to an individual who holds, directly or by attribution, more than ten percent of the total combined voting power of all classes of our capital stock is five years from the date of grant.

限制性股票奖励。限制性股票奖励（RSA）是我们授予或出售受限制的 A 类普通股股份的要约，该等限制可在满足服务条件和/或达成业绩条件后解除。RSA 的价格（如有）由管理人确定。与期权持有人不同，RSA 持有人享有投票权，且就该等股份支付的任何股息或分配将受与 RSA 相同的归属条款及其他限制约束，并将在该等股份的归属条款解除时计提并支付。除管理人另有决定外，归属将在参与者不再向我们提供服务之日终止，未归属股份可能被没收归我们所有或由我们回购。

Restricted Stock Awards. An RSA is an offer by us to grant or sell shares of our Class A common stock subject to restrictions, which may lapse based on the satisfaction of service and/or achievement of performance conditions. The price, if any, of an RSA will be determined by the administrator. Holders of RSAs, unlike holders of options, will have the right to vote and any dividends or distributions paid with respect to such shares will be subject to the same vesting terms and other restrictions as the RSA and will be accrued and paid when the vesting terms on such shares lapse. Unless otherwise determined by the administrator, vesting will cease on the date the participant no longer provides services to us and unvested shares may be forfeited to or repurchased by us.

股票增值权。股票增值权（SAR）规定向参与者支付一笔款项，以现金或我们的 A 类普通股股份支付（如管理人确定，最高不超过指定的股份上限），金额等于行权日我们 A 类普通股的公允市场价值与预定行权价格之间的差额乘以股份数量。SAR 可根据服务条件和/或达成业绩条件归属。任何 SAR 的期限不得超过自授予日起十年。

Stock Appreciation Rights. An SAR provides for a payment, in cash or shares of our Class A common stock (up to a specified maximum of shares, if determined by the administrator), to the participant based upon the difference between the fair market value of our Class A common stock on the date of exercise and a predetermined exercise price, multiplied by the number of shares. SARs may vest based on service and/or achievement of performance conditions. No SAR may have a term that is longer than ten years from the date of grant.

限制性股票单位。限制性股票单位（RSU）代表在未来的特定日期获得我们 A 类普通股股份的权利，并可能根据服务条件和/或达成业绩条件归属。RSU 可在归属后尽快或在更晚日期以现金、我们的 A 类普通股股份或两者组合结算，具体受 2025 年计划条款及任何适用奖励协议的约束（该协议可能规定仅以股份结算）。任何 RSU 的期限不得超过自授予日起十年。

Restricted Stock Units. An RSU represents the right to receive shares of our Class A common stock at a specified date in the future and may be subject to vesting based on service and/or achievement of performance conditions. RSUs may be settled in cash, shares of our Class A common stock, or a combination of both as soon as practicable following vesting or on a later date subject to the terms of the 2025 Plan and any applicable award agreement (which may provide for settlement only in shares). No RSU may have a term that is longer than ten years from the date of grant.

业绩奖励。根据 2025 年计划授予的业绩奖励可采用现金奖金的形式，或以我们 A 类普通股股份计价的业绩股份或业绩单位奖励的形式，该等奖励可以现金、财产或发行该等股份的方式结算，但须满足或达成特定业绩条件。

Performance Awards. A performance award granted pursuant to the 2025 Plan may be in the form of a cash bonus, or an award of performance shares or performance units denominated in shares of our Class A common stock that may be settled in cash, property, or by issuance of those shares, subject to the satisfaction or achievement of specified performance conditions.

股票奖金奖励。股票奖金奖励规定以现金、我们的 A 类普通股股份或其组合形式支付，金额基于管理人所确定的该等奖励所涉股份的公允市场价值。该等奖励可作为对已提供服务之对价授予，或由管理人酌情决定，受基于持续服务和/或业绩条件的归属限制约束。

Stock Bonus Awards. A stock bonus award provides for payment in the form of cash, shares of our Class A common stock, or a combination thereof, based on the fair market value of shares subject to such award as determined by the administrator. The awards may be granted as consideration for services already rendered, or at the discretion of the administrator, may be subject to vesting restrictions based on continued service and/or performance conditions.

股息等值权利。股息等值权利可由管理人酌情授予，代表就某项奖励所对应的我们 A 类普通股股份数量收取我们支付的股息（如有）价值的权利。股息等值权利将受与基础奖励相同的归属或业绩条件约束，且仅在基础奖励归属时支付，或可视为由我们进行再投资。

Dividend Equivalent Rights. Dividend equivalent rights may be granted at the discretion of the administrator and represent the right to receive the value of dividends, if any, paid by us in respect of the number of shares of our Class A common stock underlying an award. Dividend equivalent rights will be subject to the same vesting or performance conditions as the underlying award and will be paid only when the underlying award becomes vested or may be deemed to have been reinvested by us.

控制权变更。我们的 2025 年计划规定，如果发生根据该计划条款构成公司控制权变更的公司交易，则未兑现的奖励将受证明该控制权变更的协议约束，该协议无需以相同方式对待所有未兑现奖励，并可包括以下一项或多项：(1) 未兑现奖励的延续；(2) 存续公司或存续公司的母公司或子公司对未兑现奖励的承继；(3) 存续公司或存续公司的母公司或子公司以新期权或实质等同的股权奖励替代未兑现奖励；(4) 全部或部分加速可行使性或归属，或我们的回购权或其他没收条款的失效，以及奖励的加速到期；或 (5) 可按其内在价值（无论届时是否已归属或可行使）以现金、现金等价物或股权（包括受与该等奖励或相关股份适用的归属限制一致的递延归属和交付约束的现金或股权）进行结算，随后注销该等奖励；但前提是，如果我们的薪酬委员会自行酌情认定该等奖励无价值，则该等奖励可在无对价的情况下被注销，在每种情况下均无需参与者同意。继任公司还可发行与参与者持有的我们未兑现股份实质相似的股份，或其他受回购限制的财产作为替代，且该等限制对参与者不逊于原限制。如果该继任公司拒绝根据 2025 年计划承继、替代或替换任何奖励，则尽管 2025 年计划中有任何相反规定，每项该等奖励应在公司交易完成之前立即全部归属（如适用）并可行使，且其上任何回购权或没收限制将失效。受基于业绩的归属约束且未根据前述规定被承继的奖励，应被视为已按目标水平的 100% 赚取并归属，除非适用的奖励协议条款和条件另有规定。

Change of Control. Our 2025 Plan provides that, in the event of a corporate transaction that constitutes a change of control of our company under the terms of the plan, outstanding awards will be subject to the agreement evidencing the change of control, which need not treat all outstanding awards in an identical manner, and may include one or more of the following: (1) the continuation of the outstanding awards, (2) the assumption of the outstanding awards by the surviving corporation or a parent or subsidiary of the surviving corporation, (3) the substitution by the surviving corporation or a parent or subsidiary of the surviving corporation of new options or substantially equivalent equity awards for the outstanding awards, (4) the full or partial acceleration of exercisability or vesting or lapse of our right to repurchase or other terms of forfeiture and accelerated expiration of the award, or (5) may be settled for their intrinsic value (whether or not then vested or exercisable) in cash, cash equivalents, or equity (including cash or equity subject to deferred vesting and delivery consistent with vesting restrictions applicable to such awards or the underlying shares) followed by the cancellation of such awards, provided however, that such awards may be cancelled without consideration if such awards have no value, as determined by our compensation committee, in its discretion, in each case without the participant’s consent. The successor corporation may also issue, as replacement of our outstanding shares held by a participant, substantially similar shares, or other property subject to repurchase restrictions no less favorable to the participant. In the event such successor corporation refuses to assume, substitute, or replace any award in accordance with the 2025 Plan, then notwithstanding any other provision in the 2025 Plan to the contrary, each such award shall become fully vested and, as applicable, exercisable and any rights of repurchase or forfeiture restrictions thereon will lapse, immediately prior to the consummation of the corporate transaction. Awards subject to performance-based vesting that are not assumed pursuant to the foregoing shall be deemed earned and vested at 100% of target level, unless otherwise indicated pursuant to the terms and conditions of the applicable award agreement.

如果某项奖励因上文所述的公司交易而代替或替换授予并归属，我们的董事会或薪酬委员会将以书面或电子方式通知该奖励的持有人，该奖励将可在董事会或薪酬委员会自行决定的一段时间内行使，且该奖励将在该期限届满时无对价终止。董事会或薪酬委员会的任何决定无需以相同方式对待所有未兑现奖励，且对每位相关参与者具有终局性和约束力。董事会有充分的权力和授权，将我们的回购权、重新收购权和/或没收权转让给该等继受公司或收购公司。

If an award vests in lieu of assumption or substitution in connection with a corporate transaction as provided above, our board of directors or our compensation committee will notify the holder of such award in writing or electronically that such award will be exercisable for a period of time determined by our board of directors or our compensation committee, in its sole discretion, and such award will terminate upon the expiration of such period without consideration. Any determinations by our board of directors or our compensation committee need not treat all outstanding awards in an identical manner, and shall be final and binding on each applicable participant. Our board of directors shall have full power and authority to assign our right to repurchase, right to re-acquire, and/or forfeiture rights to such successor or acquiring corporation.

根据我们的 2025 年计划授予我们非雇员董事的所有奖励，在公司交易发生时应全部加速归属。

The vesting of all awards granted to our non-employee directors under our 2025 Plan shall accelerate in full in the event of a corporate transaction.

调整。如果由于股票股息、特别股息或分配（无论以现金、股份或其他财产形式，常规现金股息除外）、资本重组、股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股份细分、合并、整合、重分类、分拆或我们资本结构的类似变化，导致我们 A 类普通股流通股的数量或类别发生无对价变化，则应对以下各项进行比例调整：根据我们的 2025 年计划预留供发行的股份数量和类别；未兑现期权或 SAR 的行权价格、股份数量和类别；其他未兑现奖励所对应的股份数量和类别；以及适用于 ISO 的任何最高奖励限额。

Adjustment. In the event of a change in the number or class of outstanding shares of our Class A common stock, without consideration, by reason of a stock dividend, extraordinary dividend, or distribution (whether in cash, shares, or other property, other than a regular cash dividend), recapitalization, stock split, reverse stock split, subdivision, combination, consolidation, reclassification, spin-off or similar change in our capital structure, proportional adjustments will be made to the number and class of shares reserved for issuance under our 2025 Plan; the exercise prices, number, and class of shares subject to outstanding options or SARs; the number and class of shares subject to other outstanding awards; and any applicable maximum award limits with respect to ISOs.

奖励的交换、重新定价和买断。管理人可在未经股东事先批准的情况下，(1) 在无需任何参与者同意的情况下降低未兑现期权或 SAR 的行权价格（前提是向该等参与者提供重新定价的书面通知），以及 (2) 支付现金或发行新奖励，以换取任何或所有未兑现奖励的交回和注销，但须在 2025 年计划条款要求的范围内取得任何受影响参与者的同意。

Exchange, Repricing, and Buyout of Awards. The administrator may, without prior stockholder approval, (1) reduce the exercise price of outstanding options or SARs without the consent of any participant (provided that written notice of the repricing is provided to such participants) and (2) pay cash or issue new awards in exchange for the surrender and cancellation of any, or all, outstanding awards, subject to the consent of any affected participant to the extent required by the terms of the 2025 Plan.

董事薪酬限额。任何非雇员董事因担任非雇员董事而根据我们的 2025 年计划获得的奖励，其授予日价值加上因担任非雇员董事而获得的现金薪酬，在任一日历年度内不得超过 $1 million，或在其首次担任我们非雇员董事的日历年度内不得超过 $1.5 million。个人在担任雇员期间或作为顾问提供服务而获得的奖励或支付的现金薪酬，不计入本限额。

Director Compensation Limits. No non-employee director may receive awards under our 2025 Plan in consideration for such director’s service as a non-employee director with a grant date value that when combined with cash compensation received for such director’s service as a non-employee director, exceeds $1 million in a calendar year or $1.5 million in the calendar year of his or her initial service as a non-employee director with us. Awards granted, or cash compensation paid, to an individual while he or she was serving in the capacity as an employee or in consideration of services as a consultant will not count for purposes of this limitation.

追回；可转让性。所有奖励均须根据我们董事会采纳或法律要求的任何薪酬追回或追偿政策予以追回或追偿，以该等政策或适用协议所规定的范围为限。除有限情形外，根据我们 2025 年计划授予的奖励一般不得以遗嘱或继承与分配法律以外的任何方式转让。

Clawback; Transferability. All awards are subject to clawback or recoupment pursuant to any compensation clawback or recoupment policy adopted by our board of directors or required by law, to the extent set forth in such policy or applicable agreement. Except in limited circumstances, awards granted under our 2025 Plan may generally not be transferred in any manner other than by will or by the laws of descent and distribution.

子计划。在符合 2025 年计划条款的前提下，计划管理人可根据 2025 年计划设立子计划，和/或修改授予美国境外参与者的奖励条款，以遵守适用于任何该等司法管辖区的任何法律或法规。

Sub-plans. Subject to the terms of the 2025 Plan, the plan administrator may establish a sub-plan under the 2025 Plan and/or modify the terms of awards granted to participants outside of the United States to comply with any laws or regulations applicable to any such jurisdiction.

修订；终止。我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可随时修订我们 2025 年计划，但须经可能要求的股东批准。我们 2025 年计划将自我们董事会采纳该计划之日起十年后终止，除非我们的董事会提前终止。2025 年计划的任何终止或修订均不得在未经受影响参与者同意的情况下对任何当时尚未兑现的奖励产生不利影响，但为遵守适用法律或 2025 年计划条款另有规定所必需者除外。

Amendment; Termination. Our board of directors or compensation committee may amend our 2025 Plan at any time, subject to stockholder approval as may be required. Our 2025 Plan will terminate ten years from the date our board of directors adopts the plan, unless it is terminated earlier by our board of directors. No termination or amendment of the 2025 Plan may adversely affect any then-outstanding award without the consent of the affected participant, except as is necessary to comply with applicable laws or as otherwise provided by the terms of the 2025 Plan.

#### 2025 年员工购股计划

#### 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan

2025 年 2 月，我们的董事会和股东批准了我们 2025 年员工购股计划（2025 ESPP），该计划于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明之日生效，以使符合条件的员工能够用累积的工资扣款购买我们 A 类普通股的股份。

In February 2025, our board of directors and our stockholders approved our 2025 ESPP, which became effective on the date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part to enable eligible employees to purchase shares of our Class A common stock with accumulated payroll deductions.

2025 ESPP 包括两个组成部分：“423 组成部分”和“非 423 组成部分”。我们意图使 423 组成部分符合《税法》第 423(b) 条所定义的“员工购股计划”下发行的期权资格。除 2025 ESPP 另有规定或董事会或薪酬委员会另有决定外，非 423 组成部分（如有）将以与 423 组成部分相同的方式运作和管理。

The 2025 ESPP includes two components: a “423 Component” and a “Non-423 Component.” We intend the 423 Component to qualify as options issued under an “employee stock purchase plan” as that term is defined in Section 423(b) of the Code. Except as otherwise provided in the 2025 ESPP or determined by the board of directors or the compensation committee, the Non-423 Component (if any) will operate and be administered in the same manner as the 423 Component.

股份储备。我们最初预留 10,000,000 股 A 类普通股，用于根据我们 2025 ESPP 发行和出售。根据我们 2025 ESPP 预留用于发行和出售的股份数量将于 2026 年至 2035 年每年的 1 月 1 日自动增加，增加数量等于以下两者中的较小者：(a) 相当于我们所有类别普通股已发行股份总数加上可因优先股转换而发行的 A 类普通股股份总数（如有）之和的 1% 的股份数量，在每种情况下均以紧接前一 December 31 的已发行股份为准；及 (b) 由我们的董事会或薪酬委员会确定的 A 类普通股股份数量；但我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可自行决定减少任何特定日历年的增加数量。在股份拆分、资本重组或类似事件的前提下，在我们 2025 ESPP 期限内发行的 A 类普通股股份不得超过 100,000,000 股。

Share Reserve. We have initially reserved 10,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock for issuance and sale under our 2025 ESPP. The number of shares reserved for issuance and sale under our 2025 ESPP will increase automatically on January 1st of each of 2026 through 2035 by the number of shares equal to the lesser of (a) the number of shares equal to 1% of the sum of the total number of outstanding shares of all classes of our common stock plus the total number of shares of our Class A common stock issuable upon conversion of preferred stock (if any), in each case outstanding as of the immediately preceding December 31 and (b) such number of shares of our Class A common stock determined by our board of directors or compensation committee; provided, that our board of directors or our compensation committee may in its sole discretion reduce the amount of the increase in any particular calendar year. Subject to stock splits, recapitalizations, or similar events, no more than 100,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock may be issued over the term of our 2025 ESPP.

管理。我们的 2025 年员工购股计划（ESPP）由我们的薪酬委员会或由我们的董事会代行薪酬委员会职责进行管理，并受我们 2025 年 ESPP 条款和条件的约束。除其他事项外，管理人有权（在适用法律允许的范围内）确定参与我们 2025 年 ESPP 的资格、在该计划下指定单独的发行（并确定该等发行的期限），以及解释、阐释和适用该计划的条款。

Administration. Our 2025 ESPP is administered by our compensation committee or by our board of directors acting in place of our compensation committee, subject to the terms and conditions of our 2025 ESPP. Among other things, the administrator has the authority to determine eligibility for participation in our 2025 ESPP (to the extent permitted by applicable law), designate separate offerings under the plan (and determine the length of such offerings), and construe, interpret, and apply the terms of the plan.

资格。有资格参与我们 2025 年 ESPP 项下任何发行的员工，通常包括在发行期开始时受雇于我们或我们某些指定子公司的任何员工。但是，管理人可以排除以下员工：受雇不足两年的员工、通常每周工作 20 小时或以下的员工、通常在一个日历年内工作五个月或以下的员工、根据适用税法确定的某些高薪员工，或属于外国司法管辖区公民或居民的某些员工（如果适用当地法律禁止此类参与，或此类参与将违反《税法》第 423 条的要求（就 423 组成部分项下的发行而言））。此外，任何拥有（或因归属规则而被视为拥有）我们各类资本股票或我们某一合格子公司资本股票合计总投票权或价值的 5% 或以上，或因参与我们 2025 年 ESPP 而拥有该等数量的员工，均无资格参与我们 2025 年 ESPP。管理人可不时对资格施加额外限制。

Eligibility. Employees eligible to participate in any offering pursuant to our 2025 ESPP generally include any employee that is employed by us or certain of our designated subsidiaries at the beginning of the offering period. However, the administrator may exclude employees who have been employed for less than two years, are customarily employed for 20 hours or less per week, are customarily employed for five months or less in a calendar year, are certain highly compensated employees as determined in accordance with applicable tax laws or are certain employees who are citizens or residents of a foreign jurisdiction if such participation is prohibited under applicable local laws or would violate the requirements of Section 423 of the Code (with respect to an offering under a 423 Component). In addition, any employee who owns (or is deemed to own because of attribution rules) 5% or more of the total combined voting power or value of all classes of our capital stock, or the capital stock of one of our qualifying subsidiaries, or who owns such amount because of participation in our 2025 ESPP, is not eligible to participate in our 2025 ESPP. The administrator may impose additional restrictions on eligibility from time to time.

发行。根据我们的 2025 年 ESPP，合格员工可在系列发行期内，通过在该期间内累积的工资扣款，获得以折扣价购买我们 A 类普通股股份的选择权。每个发行期本身可包含一个或多个购买期。任何发行期不得超过 27 个月。在任何给定购买期内，根据我们 2025 年 ESPP 购买股份的购买价格为以下两者中较低者的 85%:(1) 适用发行期首个交易日的我们 A 类普通股公平市场价值，或 (2) 适用购买期最后一个交易日的我们 A 类普通股公平市场价值。

Offerings. Under our 2025 ESPP, eligible employees are offered the option to purchase shares of our Class A common stock at a discount over a series of offering periods through accumulated payroll deductions over the period. Each offering period may itself consist of one or more purchase periods. No offering period may be longer than 27 months. The purchase price for shares purchased under our 2025 ESPP during any given purchase period is 85% of the lesser of the fair market value of our Class A common stock on (1) the first trading day of the applicable offering period or (2) the last trading day of the applicable purchase period.

任何参与者在任何一个购买期内不得购买超过 5,000 股我们 A 类普通股（或我们的薪酬委员会可能确定的更高或更低数量），并且在发行生效的任何日历年内，不得认购公平市场价值超过 $25,000 的我们 A 类普通股股份（以发行期开始之日确定）。

No participant may purchase more than 5,000 shares of our Class A common stock (or such greater or lesser number as our compensation committee may determine) during any one purchase period and may not subscribe for more than $25,000 in fair market value of shares of our Class A common stock (determined as of the date the offering period commences) in any calendar year in which the offering is in effect.

资本重组时的调整。若因股票股利、资本重组、股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股份细分、股份合并、股份重新分类或类似的无对价资本结构变动导致我们 A 类普通股已发行股份的数量或类别发生变化，则管理人将按比例调整我们 2025 年 ESPP 下可供发行的 A 类普通股股份数量或类别、购买价格及任何参与人选择购买的股份数量或类别，以及参与人可购买的最大股份数量。

Adjustments Upon Recapitalization. If the number or class of outstanding shares of our Class A common stock is changed by stock dividend, recapitalization, stock split, reverse stock split, subdivision, combination, reclassification or similar change in our capital structure without consideration, then the administrator will proportionately adjust the number or class of shares of our Class A common stock that are available under our 2025 ESPP, the purchase price and number or class of shares any participant has elected to purchase as well as the maximum number of shares which may be purchased by participants.

控制权变更。若我们发生根据我们 2025 年 ESPP 条款确定的控制权变更交易，则届时生效的任何发售期将由继任公司或其母公司或子公司承继，或以同等权利替代。若继任公司拒绝承继或替代购买权，则届时生效的任何发售期将缩短，并在管理人确定的最终购买日终止。最终购买日应发生在控制权变更交易生效日当日或之前，且我们 2025 年 ESPP 将在控制权变更交割时终止。

Change of Control. If we experience a change of control transaction as determined under the terms of our 2025 ESPP, any offering period then in effect will be assumed or an equivalent option substituted by the successor corporation or a parent or a subsidiary of the successor corporation. In the event that the successor corporation refuses to assume or substitute for the purchase right, any offering period then in effect will be shortened and terminated on a final purchase date established by the administrator. The final purchase date will occur on or prior to the effective date of the change of control transaction, and our 2025 ESPP will terminate on the closing of the change of control.

可转让性。参与人一般不得转让、转移、质押或以其他方式处置其账户中已计入的工资扣款，或与我们 2025 年 ESPP 项下购买股份选择相关的任何权利，但依遗嘱或继承或分配法律进行的除外。

Transferability. Participants may generally not assign, transfer, pledge, or otherwise dispose of payroll deductions credited to their account or any rights regarding an election to purchase shares pursuant to our 2025 ESPP other than by will or the laws of descent or distribution.

修订；终止。董事会或薪酬委员会可在任何时候未经股东同意修订、暂停或终止我们 2025 年 ESPP，但法律另有要求的除外。除非提前终止，我们 2025 年 ESPP 在我们 2025 年 ESPP 项下预留发行的全部 A 类普通股股份发行完毕之日或生效日十周年之日（以较早者为准）终止。

Amendment; Termination. The board of directors or compensation committee may amend, suspend, or terminate our 2025 ESPP at any time without stockholder consent, except as required by law. Unless earlier terminated, our 2025 ESPP terminates upon the earlier to occur of the issuance of all shares of our Class A common stock reserved for issuance under our 2025 ESPP, or the tenth anniversary of the effective date.

#### 薪酬追回政策

#### Compensation Recovery Policy

2025 年 2 月，我们通过了《薪酬追回政策》（“《薪酬追回政策》”）。《薪酬追回政策》依据 SEC 于 2022 年 10 月通过的关于在与会计重述相关的情形下追回错误授予高管薪酬的最终规则制定，并与相应的纳斯达克上市标准保持一致（合称“追回规则”）。根据《薪酬追回政策》，并在追回规则规定的某些有限例外情形下，若我们需要重述财务报表，我们须追回在要求进行会计重述之日前的三个完整财年内，向任何现任或前任高管（如追回规则所述）支付的错误授予的激励性薪酬（如追回规则所述，包括现金和股权薪酬）。可追回金额为高管基于重述前财务报表所获得的任何激励性薪酬中，超过假设该激励性薪酬基于财务重述确定时该高管本应获得的金额的部分。

In February 2025, we adopted a Compensation Recovery Policy (the “Compensation Recovery Policy”). The Compensation Recovery Policy is in accordance with the final rules regarding recovery of erroneously awarded executive officer compensation in connection with an accounting restatement, as adopted by the SEC in October 2022, and consistent with the corresponding Nasdaq listing standards (together, the “Clawback Rules”). Pursuant to the Compensation Recovery Policy, and subject to certain limited exceptions in the Clawback Rules, in the event we are required to restate our financial statements, we are required to recoup erroneously awarded incentive-based compensation (as described in the Clawback Rules, including both cash and equity compensation) paid to any current or former executive officer (as described in the Clawback Rules) during the three completed fiscal years immediately prior to the date the accounting restatement was required. The amount recoverable is the amount of any incentive-based compensation received by the executive officer based on the financial statements prior to the restatement that exceeds the amount that such executive officer would have received had the incentive-based compensation been determined based on the financial restatement.

#### 2024 Tender Offer

2024 年 10 月，若干现有股东及新股东提出以每股 47.00 美元现金的价格，向我们的若干证券持有人购买我们的 A 类普通股(包括在 (i) 行使已归属的普通股购买期权和/或 (ii) 转换我们的可转换优先股和 B 类普通股时发行的若干 A 类普通股)、B 类普通股和可转换优先股（以下简称“2024 年要约收购”）。合计 13,851,240 股 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和可转换优先股被要约出售，合计购买价格为 $651 million。在 2024 年要约收购中出售的每一股 B 类普通股和可转换优先股均在每次购买前自动转换为一股 A 类普通股。

In October 2024, certain existing stockholders and new stockholders offered to purchase shares of our Class A common stock (including certain shares of our Class A common stock issued upon (i) exercise of vested options to purchase common stock; and/or (ii) conversion of shares of our convertible preferred stock and Class B common stock), Class B common stock, and convertible preferred stock, from certain of our securityholders for $47.00 per share in cash (the “2024 Tender Offer”). An aggregate of 13,851,240 shares of our Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and convertible preferred stock were tendered for an aggregate purchase price of $651 million. Each share of our Class B common stock and convertible preferred stock sold in the 2024 Tender Offer was automatically converted into one share of Class A common stock immediately prior to each purchase.

#### 股权交换权协议

#### Equity Exchange Right Agreements

2024 年 9 月，我们与每位联合创始人 Intrator 先生、Venturo 先生和 McBee 先生签订了股权交换权协议。根据该协议，每位联合创始人均有权（但无义务）要求我们将该创始人行使或结算股权奖励时获得的任何 A 类普通股股份，交换为 B 类普通股股份（“股权交换权”）。股权交换权仅适用于 2024 年 9 月之前授予我们联合创始人的股权奖励。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我们联合创始人持有的、可购买 A 类普通股股份的未行使股票期权对应的 A 类普通股股份为 9,109,000 股，这些股份在行使时可根据股权交换权交换为等量的 B 类普通股股份。

In September 2024, we entered into an Equity Exchange Right Agreement with each of our Co-Founders, Messrs. Intrator, Venturo, and McBee, pursuant to which each of our Co-Founders have a right (but not an obligation), to require us to exchange, for shares of our Class B common stock, any shares of our Class A common stock received upon by him upon the exercise or settlement of equity awards for shares of our Class A common stock (the “Equity Exchange Rights”). The Equity Exchange Rights only apply to equity awards granted to our Co-Founders prior to September 2024. As of December 31, 2024, there were 9,109,000 shares of our Class A common stock subject to outstanding stock options to purchase shares of our Class A common stock held by our Co-Founders and that may be exchanged, upon exercise, for an equivalent number of shares of our Class B common stock pursuant to the Equity Exchange Rights.

股权交换权在以下情况下终止：(a) 对于联合创始人持有的、受股权奖励约束的 A 类普通股股份，在根据适用股权奖励条款没收该等股份之日终止；(b) 对于因行使或结算联合创始人持有的股权奖励而发行的 A 类普通股股份，在以下较早发生者时终止：(i) 联合创始人出售、转让或以其他方式处置该等 A 类普通股股份时，或 (ii) 以下日期中较早者：(i) 我们董事会确定的、不晚于本次发行七周年后 61 天的日期，(ii) 经 B 类普通股已发行投票权三分之二 affirmative vote 指定的日期，或 (iii) Michael Intrator 服务终止（定义见本文）后不超过 61 天的日期。

The Equity Exchange Rights terminate (a) with respect to shares of our Class A common stock subject to equity awards that are held by our Co-Founders, on the date on which such shares are forfeited pursuant to the terms of the applicable equity award, and (b) with respect to shares of our Class A common stock issued upon the exercise or settlement of equity awards held by a Co-Founder, (i) when the Co-Founder sells, transfers, or otherwise disposes of such shares of our Class A common stock or (ii) upon the earlier of (i) a date that is fixed by our board of directors that is no more than 61 days following the seventh anniversary of this offering, (ii) the date specified by the affirmative vote of two-thirds of the outstanding voting power of the Class B common stock, or (iii) no more than 61 days following Michael Intrator’s Service Termination (as defined herein).

#### NVIDIA 主服务协议

#### NVIDIA Master Services Agreement

2023 年 4 月，我们与 NVIDIA（持有我们已发行股本超过 5%的实益拥有人）签订了主服务协议（“主服务协议”），据此，我们通过履行 NVIDIA 向我们提交的订单表格，向 NVIDIA 提供我们的基础设施和平台服务。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，NVIDIA 已根据主服务协议及相关订单表格向我们支付合计约$320 million。任何一方均可在以下情况下终止主服务协议：(i) 就违约事项向另一方发出 30 天书面通知，或 (ii) 如果另一方成为破产申请或其他破产程序、接管、清算或为债权人利益进行转让的对象，且该等程序未在 90 天内被驳回。

In April 2023, we entered into a Master Services Agreement (the “Master Services Agreement”) with NVIDIA, a beneficial owner of more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, pursuant to which we provide NVIDIA with our infrastructure and platform services through fulfillment of order forms submitted to us by NVIDIA. As of December 31, 2024, NVIDIA has paid us an aggregate of approximately $320 million pursuant to the Master Services Agreement and related order forms. Either party may terminate the Master Services Agreement (i) upon 30 days’ written notice to the other party of a breach or (ii) if the other party becomes subject to a bankruptcy petition or other insolvency proceeding, receivership, liquidation or assignment for the benefit of creditors and such proceedings are not dismissed within 90 days.

#### 与直系亲属的雇佣安排

#### Employment Arrangement with an Immediate Family Member

Michael McBee 是我们的首席开发官 Brannin McBee 的兄弟，自 2024 年 11 月起以非高管身份受雇于我们。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，Michael McBee 先生的年度基本工资为 $190,000，此外还有股权激励。Michael McBee 先生的薪酬是参照类似职位的外部市场惯例确定的，或在与我们首席开发官无亲属关系的类似职位员工所获薪酬进行比较时，参照内部薪酬公平性确定的。Michael McBee 先生还有资格按照与适用于与我们首席开发官无亲属关系的类似职位员工相同的一般条款和条件获得股权奖励。

Michael McBee, the brother of Brannin McBee, our Chief Development Officer, has been employed by us in a non-executive role since November 2024. For the year ended December 31, 2024, Mr. Michael McBee’s annual base salary was $190,000, in addition to equity compensation. Mr. Michael McBee’s compensation was based on reference to external market practice of similar positions or internal pay equity when compared to the compensation paid to employees in similar positions who were not related to our Chief Development Officer. Mr. Michael McBee was also eligible for equity awards on the same general terms and conditions as applicable to employees in similar positions who were not related to our Chief Development Officer.

#### AI 算力服务预留容量及预付款协议

#### AI Computing Service Reserved Capacity and Prepayment Agreement

2024 年 8 月，我们与由 Magnetar 管理的一只基金（“MagAI Ventures”）订立了一项协议（经修订，简称“MagAI 容量协议”）。根据 MagAI 容量协议，我们将以预先协商的小时费率向 MagAI Ventures 的某些投资组合公司提供预定数量的云计算服务。各投资组合公司实际使用的云计算服务具体数量（如有）将与该投资组合公司单独协商，并须经 MagAI Ventures 最终批准。

In August 2024, we entered into an agreement (as amended, the “MagAI Capacity Agreement”) with a fund managed by Magnetar (“MagAI Ventures”). Under the MagAI Capacity Agreement, we will provide certain portfolio companies of MagAI Ventures with a predetermined amount of cloud computing services at a pre-negotiated hourly rate. The specific amount of cloud computing services to be used by each portfolio company, if any, will be negotiated individually with each portfolio company, and will be subject to final approval by MagAI Ventures.

我们就 MagAI 容量协议收到了约 $230 million 的可退还保证金。MagAI Ventures（包括其投资组合公司）根据该安排对云服务的任何消费均从该保证金金额中扣除，未使用部分将在该安排期限结束时退还给 MagAI Ventures。

We received a refundable deposit of approximately $230 million in connection with the MagAI Capacity Agreement. Any consumption of cloud services by MagAI Ventures, including by their portfolio companies, under this arrangement is deducted from this deposit amount, with the unused portion refunded back to MagAI Ventures at the end of the term of the arrangement.

在该安排的整个期限内，如果 MagAI Ventures 的投资组合公司未就全部预定云计算服务签约，我们可与 MagAI Ventures 协商，将该可用容量改用于其他客户，并就按 MagAI Ventures 预先协商费率向这些客户收费本可产生的收入以上的任何已实现收入，与 MagAI Ventures 分享利润。

Throughout the term of the arrangement, if MagAI Ventures portfolio companies do not contract for the full amount of the predetermined cloud computing services, we may agree with MagAI Ventures to instead use this available capacity for other customers, and share profits with MagAI Ventures for any revenues realized above the revenues that would have been generated by charging these customers the MagAI Ventures pre-negotiated rate.

MagAI 容量协议的初始期限为四年，MagAI Ventures 有权选择将安排再延长两年，且任何一方均可出于便利终止该安排。如因便利终止该安排，我们需要向 MagAI Ventures 支付一笔分手费，金额等于保证金未使用部分乘以一个在该安排期限内从 1.06x 增至 1.73x 的系数。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，由于尚未根据该安排提供任何服务，该可退还保证金中的约 $230 million 计入合并资产负债表中的其他流动负债。

The MagAI Capacity Agreement runs for an initial period of four years, with an option for MagAI Ventures to extend the arrangement for two additional years, and the arrangement can be terminated by either party out of convenience. If the arrangement is terminated out of convenience, we are required to pay MagAI Ventures a breakup fee equal to the unused portion of the deposit multiplied by a factor that increases from 1.06x to 1.73x over the term of the arrangement. As of December 31, 2024, approximately $230 million of this refundable deposit is included within other current liabilities in the consolidated balance sheet, as no services had yet been provided under this arrangement.

#### 优先股投资

#### Preferred Stock Investment

2024 年 6 月 14 日，我们就 Magnetar 管理的基金（“MAIV”）购买一家私营公司的优先股股份事宜，向该基金合计出资$50 million。就该投资而言，在以下两者中较早发生之日：(a) MAIV 交割一周年之日，及(b) 我们以书面形式向 Magnetar 证明我们拟在 30 个日历日内就首次公开发行向 SEC 提交注册声明之日，起至优先股发行交割日七周年届满之日止，我们可在任何月末经提前 30 日书面通知，要求 MAIV 以实物形式向我们分配合计不超过我们在 MAIV 中权益的 99%。任何该等请求将由 MAIV 通过以下方式满足：(i) 向我们分配该私营公司的优先股股份，或(ii) 在 MAIV 出售该等股份后向我们支付该等股份的总出售价款，在每种情况下均应在合理可行范围内尽快完成。

On June 14, 2024, we contributed an aggregate amount of $50 million to a fund managed by Magnetar (“MAIV”) in connection with MAIV’s purchase of shares of preferred stock in a private company. In connection with this investment, upon the earlier of (a) the one year anniversary of the closing of MAIV and (b) the date that we certify in writing to Magnetar that we intend to file a registration statement with the SEC in respect of an initial public offering within 30 calendar days, and ending upon the expiration of the seventh anniversary of the closing date of the preferred stock offering, we may, at any month-end upon 30 days’ written notice, request that MAIV make a distribution in kind to us of up to, in the aggregate, 99% of our interest in MAIV. Any such request will be satisfied by MAIV either (i) distributing to us shares of the private company’s preferred stock, or (ii) providing payment to us of the aggregate sale price of such shares following MAIV’s sale of the shares, in each case, as promptly as reasonably practicable.

若该私营公司的优先股以实物形式向我们分配，且在该等分配后我们出售该等优先股的任何股份（或该等股份转换或交换所成的任何证券），我们将按如下方式分配该等出售的净收益：(i) 在我们收到相当于我们对 MAIV 合计出资额的金额之前，净收益的 100%归我们；(ii) 此后，净收益的 75%归我们，25%归 Magnetar 的关联方。

To the extent there is an in-kind distribution of the private company’s preferred stock to us and following such distribution we sell any shares of such preferred stock (or any securities into which such stock is converted or exchanged), we will allocate the net proceeds from such sale as follows (i) 100% of the net proceeds to us until we receive an amount equal to our aggregate capital contribution to MAIV and (ii) thereafter, 75% of the net proceeds to us and 25% to an affiliate of Magnetar.

#### 延迟提款定期贷款 2.0 融资

#### Delayed Draw Term Loan 2.0 Facility

2024 年 5 月 16 日，我们的直接全资子公司 CCAC IV 作为借款人，与 U.S. Bank National Association（作为存款银行）、U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association（作为行政代理人和抵押代理人）、Blackstone Alternative Credit Advisors LP、Blackstone Alternative Solutions L.L.C.、Blackstone Tactical Opportunities Advisors L.L.C.及 Blackstone Private

On May 16, 2024, CCAC IV, our direct, wholly-owned subsidiary, as borrower, entered into a credit agreement with U.S. Bank National Association, as depository bank, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as administrative agent and collateral agent, Blackstone Alternative Credit Advisors LP, Blackstone Alternative Solutions L.L.C., Blackstone Tactical Opportunities Advisors L.L.C., and Blackstone Private

Investments Advisors L.L.C.（作为牵头贷款人和联席牵头投资人）、Magnetar（作为联席牵头投资人）以及作为协议一方的贷款人签订了一份信贷协议，设立了一项$7.6 billion 的延迟提款定期贷款融资（经修订，即“DDTL 2.0 融资”）。我们签订 DDTL 2.0 融资主要是为了为履行客户合同所需的资本支出提供资金，包括购置 GPU 服务器及相关基础设施。

Investments Advisors L.L.C., as lead lenders and co-lead investors, Magnetar, as a co-lead investor, and the lenders party thereto, providing for a $7.6 billion delayed draw term loan facility (as amended, the “DDTL 2.0 Facility”). Our DDTL 2.0 Facility was entered into primarily to finance capital expenditures required to perform customer contracts, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure.

在我们的 DDTL 2.0 融资项下，可在 2025 年 6 月的承诺终止日之前提取额外贷款，经所需贷款人同意，该终止日可再延长三个月。就任何借款请求而言，我们 DDTL 2.0 融资项下可提取的贷款总额限于贷款所资助合同对应的 GPU 服务器及相关基础设施折旧后购买价格的一定百分比，该百分比基于相关客户的信用评级确定。

Additional loans are available to be drawn under our DDTL 2.0 Facility until the commitment termination date in June 2025, which may be extended for an additional three months with the consent of the required lenders. The aggregate amount of loans available to be drawn under our DDTL 2.0 Facility in connection with any borrowing request are limited to a percentage of the depreciated purchase price of GPU servers and related infrastructure for the contract that the loans are being used to finance, with such percentage based upon the credit rating of the applicable customer.

我们 DDTL 2.0 融资安排项下的借款金额适用的年利率，由我们选择，为以下两者之一：(a) 对于基准利率贷款，适用的利差（范围为 5.0% 至 12.0%，取决于正在融资的合同对应客户的信用评级）加上基准利率（下限为 0.00%），该基准利率参照以下三者中的最高者确定：(i) 最优惠利率，(ii) 联邦基金有效利率加 0.50%，以及 (iii) 一个月期限 SOFR 加 1.00%；或 (b) 对于期限 SOFR 贷款，适用的利差（范围为 6.0% 至 13.0%，取决于正在融资的合同对应客户的信用评级）加上三个月利息期的期限 SOFR（下限为 0.00%）。

Amounts borrowed under our DDTL 2.0 Facility are subject to an interest rate per annum equal to, at our option, either (a) for base rate loans, an applicable margin (ranging from 5.0% to 12.0%, depending on the credit rating of the customer whose contract is being financed) plus a base rate (subject to a 0.00% floor) determined by reference to the highest of (i) the prime rate, (ii) the federal funds effective rate plus 0.50%, and (iii) the one month term SOFR plus 1.00% or (b) for term SOFR loans, an applicable margin (ranging from 6.0% to 13.0%, depending on the credit rating of the customer whose contract is being financed) plus the term SOFR (subject to a 0.00% floor) for a three month interest period.

我们 DDTL 2.0 融资安排项下的所有义务，除某些例外情形外，均由该子公司的绝大部分资产以及该子公司 100% 股权权益的质押提供担保。

All obligations under our DDTL 2.0 Facility are secured, subject to certain exceptions, by substantially all of the subsidiary’s assets and a pledge of 100% of the equity interests in the subsidiary.

我们 DDTL 2.0 融资安排项下的每笔贷款在放款后 5 年到期。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我们 DDTL 2.0 融资安排已提取 $3.8 billion，我们 DDTL 2.0 融资安排项下尚有 $3.8 billion 可供借款。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我们就延迟提取定期贷款 2.0 融资安排项下未偿金额分别支付了 $0 million 的本金和 $21 million 的利息。

Each loan under our DDTL 2.0 Facility matures 5 years after funding. As of December 31, 2024, $3.8 billion of our DDTL 2.0 Facility was drawn and $3.8 billion remained available for borrowing under our DDTL 2.0 Facility. As of December 31, 2024, we have paid $0 million and $21 million in principal and in interest on outstanding amounts under our Delayed Draw Term Loan 2.0 Facility, respectively.

有关 DDTL 2.0 融资安排的更多信息，请参见“重大债务说明——DDTL 2.0 融资安排”。

For additional information regarding the DDTL 2.0 Facility, see “Description of Material Indebtedness— DDTL 2.0 Facility.”

#### 聘用 Magnetar 高管

#### Hiring of Magnetar Executives

Ernie Rogers 曾是我们的董事会成员兼 Magnetar 首席运营官，我们已向其提供战略融资首席架构师一职。担任该职位期间，Rogers 先生将被授予 600,000 份 RSU，分两年归属，并有权获得$450,000 的年度基本工资及相当于其年度基本工资 100%的目标奖金，但须达成业绩指标。若 Rogers 先生与我们之间的雇佣关系因“非因正当理由”被终止或其因“正当理由”辞职，Rogers 先生的 RSU 将全部加速归属，但以其签署索赔豁免书为前提。Rogers 先生已原则上同意上述条款，但须与 Magnetar 就其离职事宜达成一致。在入职我们之前，且假设其与 Magnetar 能够达成该等协议，Rogers 先生将辞去其 Magnetar 首席运营官一职。

Ernie Rogers, a former member of our board of directors and the Chief Operating Officer of Magnetar, has been offered a position as our Chief Architect, Strategic Financing. In this position, Mr. Rogers would be granted 600,000 RSUs vesting over two years and would be entitled to an annual base salary of $450,000 and a target bonus of 100% of his annual base salary, subject to achievement of performance metrics. Upon a termination of Mr. Rogers’ employment with us without “cause” or his resignation for “good reason,” Mr. Rogers’ RSUs would accelerate in full, subject to him signing a release of claims. Mr. Rogers has agreed in principle to these terms, subject to reaching agreement with Magnetar with respect to his separation therefrom. Prior to his start date with us, and assuming he and Magnetar can reach such agreement, Mr. Rogers would resign from his position as Chief Operating Officer of Magnetar.

Magnetar 管理公司首席财务官 Jessica Damrat 已获邀担任我们的高级副总裁（战略融资）。担任该职位期间，Damrat 女士将被授予 200,000 份 RSU，分两年归属，并有权获得 450,000 美元的年度基本工资以及相当于其年度基本工资 100% 的目标奖金，但须达成业绩指标。若 Damrat 女士与我们之间的雇佣关系因“正当理由”之外的原因终止，或她因“合理理由”辞职，则其 RSU 将全部加速归属，前提是她签署一份权利豁免书。Damrat 女士已原则上同意上述条款，但须与 Magnetar 就其离职事宜达成一致。在入职我们之前，且假设她与 Magnetar 能够达成该等协议，Damrat 女士将辞去其 Magnetar 管理公司首席财务官的职务。

Jessica Damrat, the Chief Financial Officer, Management Company, of Magnetar, has been offered a position as our SVP, Strategic Financing. In this position, Ms. Damrat would be granted 200,000 RSUs vesting over two years and would be entitled to an annual base salary of $450,000 and a target bonus of 100% of her annual base salary, subject to achievement of performance metrics. Upon a termination of Ms. Damrat’s employment with us without “cause” or her resignation for “good reason,” Ms. Damrat’s RSUs would accelerate in full, subject to her signing a release of claims. Ms. Damrat has agreed in principle to these terms, subject to reaching agreement with Magnetar with respect to her separation therefrom. Prior to her start date with us, and assuming she and Magnetar can reach such agreement, Ms. Damrat would resign from her position as Chief Financial Officer, Management Company, of Magnetar.

#### 投资者权利协议

#### Investors’ Rights Agreement

我们与其它方于 2024 年 5 月 16 日签订了《第三份经修订和重述的投资者权利协议》（“权利协议”），该协议除其他事项外规定，我们股本证券的若干持有人，包括由 Magnetar 和 NVIDIA 管理或提供咨询的基金或账户（二者均为我们已发行股本证券 5% 以上的实益拥有人），以及我们董事会成员 Jack Cogen、我们的首席执行官、总裁兼董事会主席 Michael Intrator 和我们的首席战略官 Brian Venturo 的若干关联方，有权要求我们提交注册声明，或要求将其持有的股本股份纳入我们另行提交的注册声明中。有关该等注册权利的更多信息，请参见“股本说明——注册权”一节。

We are party to a Third Amended and Restated Investors’ Rights Agreement between us and other parties, dated May 16, 2024 (the “Rights Agreement”), which provides, among other things, that certain holders of our capital stock, including funds or accounts managed or advised by Magnetar and NVIDIA, each beneficial owners of more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, as well as certain affiliates of Jack Cogen, a member of our board of directors, and Michael Intrator, our Chief Executive Officer, President, and Chairman of our board of directors, and Brian Venturo, our Chief Strategy Officer, have the right to demand that we file a registration statement or request that their shares of our capital stock be included on a registration statement that we are otherwise filing. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights” for more information regarding these registration rights.

#### Magnetar 经修订和重述的注册权协议

#### Magnetar Amended and Restated Registration Rights Agreement

我们与 2025 年可转换票据购买方、2025 年票据购买方以及由 Magnetar 管理或提供咨询的若干其他基金或账户（合称“Magnetar RRA 各方”）于 2022 年 10 月 17 日签订了《经修订和重述的注册权协议》（经修订，即“Magnetar 注册权协议”），该协议除其他事项外规定，Magnetar RRA 各方将有权就以下各项的注册享有权利：(i) 2025 年可转换票据转换后所对应的 A 类普通股股份，(ii) 常规认股权证、一分钱认股权证，(iii) 行使常规认股权证和一分钱认股权证后可发行的 A 类普通股股份，以及 (iv) 截至我们的任何类别或系列证券在全国性证券交易所上市之日任何 Magnetar RRA 各方持有的任何 A 类普通股股份，截至本招股说明书日期，假设行使常规认股权证和一分钱认股权证，上述各项合计构成 107,962,916 股 A 类普通股（合称“Magnetar 可注册证券”），将根据《证券法》予以注册。有关该等注册权利的更多信息，请参见“股本说明——注册权”一节。

We are party to an Amended and Restated Registration Rights Agreement between us and the 2025 Convertible Note Purchasers and the 2025 Note Purchasers and certain other funds or accounts managed or advised by Magnetar (collectively, the “Magnetar RRA Parties”), dated October 17, 2022 (as amended, the “Magnetar Registration Rights Agreement”), which provides, among other things, that the Magnetar RRA Parties will be entitled to rights with respect to the registration of (i) the shares of our Class A common stock into which the 2025 Convertible Notes were converted, (ii) the Regular Warrants, the Penny Warrants, (iii) the shares of our Class A common stock issuable upon exercise of the Regular Warrants and the Penny Warrants, and (iv) any shares of our Class A common stock held by any Magnetar RRA Party as of the date any class or series of our securities become listed on a national securities exchange which, as of the date of this prospectus, collectively constitute an aggregate of 107,962,916 shares of our Class A common stock assuming exercise of the Regular Warrants and the Penny Warrants (collectively, the “Magnetar Registrable Securities”) under the Securities Act. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights” for more information regarding these registration rights.

投票协议 Voting Agreement

根据我们的投票协议，我们股本的某些持有人已同意就某些事项对其股份进行投票，包括就我们董事会成员的选举进行投票。有关根据我们的投票协议选举我们董事会成员的更多信息，请参见标题为“管理层——董事会”的章节。我们股本的持有人，包括由 Magnetar 管理或提供咨询的基金或账户、与 Fidelity 关联的某些实体以及 NVIDIA（各自均为我们已发行股本超过 5% 的实益拥有人），以及我们董事会成员 Jack Cogen 及其某些关联方，我们的首席执行官兼总裁 Michael Intrator 及其某些关联方，我们的首席战略官 Brian Venturo 及其某些关联方，以及我们的首席发展官 Brannin McBee 的某些关联方，均为我们投票协议的当事方。我们的投票协议将在本次发行完成后终止。

Pursuant to our Voting Agreement, certain holders of our capital stock have agreed to vote their shares on certain matters, including with respect to the election of members of our board of directors. See the section titled “Management—Board of Directors” for more information regarding the election of members of our board of directors pursuant to our Voting Agreement. Holders of our capital stock, including funds or accounts managed or advised by Magnetar, certain entities affiliated with Fidelity, and NVIDIA, each beneficial owners of more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, as well as Jack Cogen, a member of our board of directors, and certain of his affiliates, and Michael Intrator, our Chief Executive Officer and President, and certain of his affiliates, Brian Venturo, our Chief Strategy Officer, and certain of his affiliates, and certain affiliates of Brannin McBee, our Chief Development Officer, are parties to our Voting Agreement. Our Voting Agreement will terminate upon the completion of this offering.

赔偿协议 Indemnification Agreements

我们已与每位高管和董事（包括与某些 5% 股东有关联的高管和董事）签订赔偿协议，并打算继续签订此类协议。赔偿协议以及我们经修订并重述的章程将要求我们在 DGCL 允许的最大范围内对董事进行赔偿。除极有限的例外情形外，我们经修订并重述的章程还将要求我们预付董事和高管发生的费用。有关这些协议的更多信息，请参见“管理层——责任限制与赔偿事项”。

We have entered into, and intend to continue to enter into, separate indemnification agreements with each of our executive officers and directors, including those affiliated with certain of our 5% stockholders. The indemnification agreements and our amended and restated bylaws will require us to indemnify our directors to the fullest extent not prohibited by DGCL. Subject to very limited exceptions, our amended and restated bylaws will also require us to advance expenses incurred by our directors and officers. For more information regarding these agreements, see “Management—Limitations on Liability and Indemnification Matters.”

定向股份计划 Directed Share Program

应我们的请求，承销商已预留最多 1,875,000 股 A 类普通股，按首次公开发行价格出售给我们的现有员工（包括管理层）、其他服务提供者以及由我们某些授权高管确定的其他个人和实体，占本招股说明书项下所发售股份的 5%。定向股份计划不会限制我们的董事、高管及其家庭成员，或持有我们超过 5% 资本股票的持有人购买价值超过 $120,000 的 A 类普通股的能力。我们目前尚不清楚这些关联人士将在多大程度上参与我们的定向股份计划（如有），也不清楚他们将在多大程度上购买价值超过 $120,000 的 A 类普通股。

At our request, the underwriters have reserved for sale, at the initial public offering price, up to 1,875,000 shares of our Class A common stock, or 5% of the shares being offered pursuant to this prospectus, to our current employees, including management, other service providers, and other individuals and entities as determined by certain of our authorized officers. The directed share program will not limit the ability of our directors, officers and their family members, or holders of more than 5% of our capital stock, to purchase more than $120,000 in value of our Class A common stock. We do not currently know the extent to which these related persons will participate in our directed share program, if at all, or the extent to which they will purchase more than $120,000 in value of our Class A common stock.

关联方交易的政策与程序 Policies and Procedures for Related Party Transactions

本次发行完成后，我们的审计委员会将主要负责审查并批准或不批准“关联方交易”，即我们与关联人士之间涉及的合计金额超过或预计可能超过 $120,000 且关联人士在其中拥有或将会拥有直接或间接重大利益的交易。

Following the completion of this offering, our audit committee will have the primary responsibility for reviewing and approving or disapproving “related party transactions,” which are transactions between us and related persons in which the aggregate amount involved exceeds or may be expected to exceed $120,000 and in which a related person has or will have a direct or indirect material interest.

本次发行完成后，我们关于我们与关联人士之间交易的书面政策将规定，关联人士是指董事、高级管理人员、董事候选人或在最近一个完整年度开始以来的任何时点持有 5% 股份的股东，以及上述任何人士的直系亲属。本次发行完成后生效的审计委员会章程将规定，我们的审计委员会应审查并批准或不批准任何关联方交易。在批准或否决任何此类交易时，我们的审计委员会将考虑其可获得并认为与其相关的相关事实和情况，包括但不限于交易条款在商业上是否合理，以及关联人士在交易中直接或间接利益的重大性和性质。

Upon completion of this offering, our written policy regarding transactions between us and related persons will provide that a related person is defined as a director, executive officer, nominee for director or 5% stockholder, in each case since the beginning of the most recently completed year, and any of their immediate family members. Our audit committee charter that will be in effect upon completion of this offering will provide that our audit committee shall review and approve or disapprove any related party transactions. In approving or rejecting any such transactions, our audit committee will consider the relevant facts and circumstances available and deemed relevant to our audit committee, including, but not limited to, the commercial reasonableness of the terms of the transaction and the materiality and character of the related person’s direct or indirect interest in the transaction.

(1) · Consists of (i) 7,072,260 shares of our Class A common stock directly held by Michael Intrator; (ii) 22,103,520 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by Mr. Intrator; (iii) 1,668,020 shares of our Class B common stock issuable upon the exercise of stock options directly held by Mr. Intrator which are exercisable within 60 days of March 15, 2025; (iv) 365,200 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by Mr. Intrator’s spouse; (v) 25,649,280 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by Omnadora Capital LLC (“Omnadora”); (vi) 30,000 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by the PMI 2024 F&F GRAT (“PMI”), (vii) 7,240 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by the Silver Thimble Resulting Trust (“Silver Thimble”); (viii) 4,576,000 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by the Intrator Family GST-Exempt Trust (the “Intrator GST Trust”); and (ix) 2,290,320 shares of our Class B common stock directly held by the Intrator Family Trust (together with the Intrator GST Trust, the “Intrator Family Trusts”). Mr. Intrator serves as the sole manager of Omnadora Management LLC, which is the manager of Omnadora, and therefore may be deemed to exercise voting and investment discretion over securities held by Omnadora. Mr. Intrator’s spouse is the trustee of PMI and co-trustee of the Intrator Family Trusts and may be deemed to exercise voting and investment discretion over securities held by them. Mr. Intrator serves as investment manager with respect to Silver Thimble and in such capacity exercises voting and investment discretion over securities held by it.
