锁定期与市场禁售协议 Lock-Up and Market Standoff Agreements

就本次发行而言，我们全体董事和高级管理人员、出售股东以及若干其他持有人（合计约占我们已发行 A 类普通股及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为 A 类普通股的证券的 83.7%）与承销商签订了锁定期协议。根据该等协议，除特定例外情形外，未经 Morgan Stanley（代表承销商）与 Magnetar 事先书面同意，在自本招股说明书之日起至下列两者中较早发生之日止的期间内，他们不得按照该等协议的条款：(i) 我们公开宣布本招股说明书所载财务报表对应最近期间之后第二季度业绩后的第二个交易日交易收盘时，及 (ii) 本招股说明书日期后 180 天：

In connection with this offering, all of our directors and executive officers, the selling stockholders, and certain other holders that together represent approximately 83.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to lock-up agreements with the underwriters pursuant to which they have agreed, subject to certain exceptions, that without the prior written consent of Morgan Stanley, on behalf of the underwriters, and Magnetar, they will not, in accordance with the terms of such agreements during the period ending on the earlier of (i) the close of trading on the second trading day after the date that we publicly announce earnings for the second quarter following the most recent period for which financial statements are included in this prospectus and (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus:

(1) · 直接或间接要约、质押、出售、签订出售合同、出售任何期权或购买合同、购买任何期权或出售合同、授予任何期权、权利或认股权证以购买、出借或以其他方式转让或处置我们的任何普通股股份以及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为我们的普通股的证券；

(1) · offer, pledge, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, lend, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our common stock;

(2) · 订立任何互换、对冲交易或其他安排，将我们普通股所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给另一方，无论上述任何此类交易是否以交付我们的普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算；

(2) · enter into any swap, hedging transaction, or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of our common stock, whether any such transaction described above is to be settled by delivery of our common stock or such other securities, in cash or otherwise;

(3) · 公开披露采取上述第 (1) 或 (2) 条所限制的任何行动的意图；或

(3) · publicly disclose the intention to take any of the actions restricted by clause (1) or (2) above; or

(4) · 就我们的任何普通股股份或可转换为、可行使为或可交换为我们的普通股的任何证券的登记提出任何要求，或行使任何相关权利。

(4) · make any demand for, or exercise any right with respect to, the registration of any shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock.

此外，另有约 14.7% 的已发行 A 类普通股以及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行权为 A 类普通股的证券，受市场禁售条款约束。根据该等条款，相关持有人同意，在锁定期内，不得出借、要约出售、出售、订立出售合同、出售任何购买期权或合同、购买任何出售期权或合同、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证，或以其他方式直接或间接转让或处置其在包含本招股说明书的注册声明生效前即时持有的任何 A 类普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行权为或可交换为 A 类普通股的证券，亦不得订立任何互换或其他安排，将此类 A 类普通股所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给他人。这些市场禁售条款的形式和具体限制性规定因证券持有人而异。例如，尽管其中部分市场禁售协议并未明确限制对冲交易，且其他协议在我们与证券持有人之间就可能是否限制对冲存在不同解释，但我们的内幕交易政策禁止我们所有现任董事、高级管理人员、员工、承包商和顾问进行对冲。涉及我们股权证券的出售、卖空或对冲交易，无论发生在本次发行之前还是之后，也无论我们是否认为其被禁止，均可能对我们 A 类普通股的价格产生不利影响。

Furthermore, an additional approximately 14.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to market standoff provisions, pursuant to which such holders agreed to not lend, offer, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our Class A common stock held immediately prior to the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, or enter into any swap or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of such Class A common stock during the Lock-up Period. The forms and specific restrictive provisions within these market standoff provisions vary among security holders. For example, although some of these market standoff agreements do not specifically restrict hedging transactions and others may be subject to different interpretations between us and security holders as to whether they restrict hedging, our insider trading policy prohibits hedging by all of our current directors, officers, employees, contractors, and consultants. Sales, short sales, or hedging transactions involving our equity securities, whether before or after this offering and whether or not we believe them to be prohibited, could adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.

鉴于上述情况，我们几乎所有已发行的 A 类普通股以及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行权为 A 类普通股的证券，在锁定期内均受锁定协议或市场禁售条款约束。我们已同意代表承销商执行所有该等市场禁售限制，并同意在锁定期内未经 Morgan Stanley（代表承销商）和 Magnetar 事先书面同意，不修订或豁免任何该等市场禁售条款；但前提是，对于根据本招股说明书所述由我们的董事和高级管理人员、出售股东及我们证券的某些其他登记持有人与承销商签订的锁定协议格式本应有权解除限制的股份，我们可以解除该等限制。

As a result of the foregoing, substantially all of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to a lock-up agreement or market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period. We have agreed to enforce all such market standoff restrictions on behalf of the underwriters and not to amend or waive any such market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period without the prior written consent of Morgan Stanley, on behalf of the underwriters, and Magnetar, provided that we may release shares from such restrictions to the extent such shares would be entitled to release under the form of lock-up agreement with the underwriters entered into by our directors and executive officers, the selling stockholders, and certain other record holders of our securities as described herein.

某些不受市场禁售限制或锁定期协议约束的证券持有人，可能就其所持 A 类普通股进行交易，从而对我们的股价产生负面影响。此外，既不受与我们签订的市场禁售限制约束、也不受与承销商签订的锁定期协议约束的证券持有人，在遵守我们适用的内幕交易政策及适用证券法的前提下，可随时出售、卖空、转让、质押或以其他方式处置或试图出售、卖空、转让、对冲、质押或以其他方式处置其股权权益。

Certain of our security holders that are not bound by market standoff restrictions or lock-up agreements could enter into transactions with respect to those shares of our Class A common stock that negatively impact our stock price. In addition, a security holder who is neither subject to market standoff restrictions with us nor a lock-up agreement with the underwriters may be able to sell, short sell, transfer, pledge, or otherwise dispose of or attempt to sell, short sell, transfer, hedge, pledge, or otherwise dispose of their equity interests at any time, subject to our insider trading policy, as applicable, and applicable securities laws.

此外，根据锁定期协议和市场禁售协议的某些例外规定，在锁定期内，最多约 727,342 股 A 类普通股将有资格在公开市场以卖出补缴（sell-to-cover）交易方式出售，以满足代扣代缴税款义务。此外，由我们现任员工和服务提供者（不包括管理层持有人和董事）持有的约 963,140 股已发行 A 类普通股以及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为我们普通股的证券，可在我们公开公布本招股说明书所载财务报表对应最近期间之后第一个季度财报之日后的第二个交易日收盘时出售，前提是：在包含至少一日落在首次发行后财报发布日之后的连续十个交易日期间内，任意五个交易日内我们 A 类普通股在纳斯达克的每股收盘价至少比本招股说明书封面所载我们 A 类普通股的首次公开发行价格高出 25%。

In addition, pursuant to certain exceptions to the lock-up agreements and market standoff agreements, up to approximately 727,342 shares of our Class A common stock will be eligible for sale in the open market during the Lock-up Period in sell-to-cover transactions in order to satisfy tax withholding obligations. Furthermore, approximately 963,140 shares of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our common stock held by our current employees and service providers (excluding the Management Holders and directors) may be sold at the close of trading of the second trading day after the date that we publicly announce earnings for the first quarter following the most recent period for which financial statements are included in this prospectus, if the closing price per share of our Class A common stock on Nasdaq for any five trading days out of the ten consecutive trading day period including at least one day occurring after the Initial Post-Offering Earnings Release Date is at least 25% greater than the initial public offering price of our Class A common stock set forth on the cover of this prospectus.

锁定期协议和市场禁售条款所施加的限制受某些例外情形约束，包括就以下事项而言：

(d) · distributions, transfers, or dispositions of shares of our common stock or other securities to any corporation, partnership, limited liability company, other entity that is an affiliate of the lock-up party, investment fund

sponsored, managed, advised, or sub-advised by the investment manager, or advisor of the lock-up party or of which all of the beneficial ownership interests of which are held by the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party in a transaction not involving a disposition for value;

创始人锁定期协议受若干例外情形约束，包括：(a) 依据承销协议向承销商出售股份；(b) 为管理持有人或管理持有人直系亲属的直接或间接利益，向任何获准关联方转让任何股份，但任何该等转让不得涉及有偿处置；或 (c) 在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日，该管理持有人及该管理持有人全部获准关联方合计持有的证券中最多 2.5% 的出售，前提是在本次发行中与承销商签订的锁定期协议到期后，我们 A 类普通股在 Nasdaq 的每股收盘价在锁定期协议到期后发生的任何连续十个交易日的期间内至少有五个交易日使我们对应的市值达到 $150 billion 或以上。

The Founder Lock-Up Agreement is subject to certain exceptions, including (a) the sale of shares to the underwriters pursuant to the underwriting agreement, (b) the transfer of any shares to any permitted affiliates for the direct or indirect benefit of the Management Holder or the immediate family of the Management Holder, provided that any such transfer shall not involve a disposition for value, or (c) the sales of up to 2.5% of the securities held by such Management Holder and all of such Management Holder’s permitted affiliates, in the aggregate, on the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, if, following the expiration of the lock-up agreement entered into with the underwriters in this offering, the closing price per share of our Class A common stock on Nasdaq imputes a market capitalization to us of $150 billion or greater for at least five trading days in any ten-day consecutive trading day period occurring after the expiration of the lock-up agreement entered into with the underwriters in this offering.

144 规则 Rule 144

一般而言，根据现行有效的 144 规则，一旦我们已受《交易法》第 13 条或第 15(d) 条上市公司报告要求约束至少 90 天，则任何在出售前 90 天内任何时候均不被视为《证券法》项下我们关联方的人士，且其已实益持有拟出售股份至少六个月（包括任何先前非关联方持有人的持有期），有权无需遵守 144 规则的出售方式、数量限制或通知规定而出售该等股份，但须遵守 144 规则的公开信息要求。若该人士已实益持有拟出售股份至少一年（包括任何先前非关联方持有人的持有期），则该人士有权无需遵守 144 规则任何要求而出售该等股份。

In general, under Rule 144 as currently in effect, once we have been subject to public company reporting requirements of Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act for at least 90 days, a person who is not deemed to have been one of our affiliates for purposes of the Securities Act at any time during the 90 days preceding a sale and who has beneficially owned the shares proposed to be sold for at least six months, including the holding period of any prior owner other than our affiliates, is entitled to sell those shares without complying with the manner of sale, volume limitation or notice provisions of Rule 144, subject to compliance with the public information requirements of Rule 144. If such a person has beneficially owned the shares proposed to be sold for at least one year, including the holding period of any prior owner other than our affiliates, then that person would be entitled to sell those shares without complying with any of the requirements of Rule 144.

一般而言，根据现行有效的 144 规则，我们的关联方或代表关联方出售股份的人士有权在上述锁定期及市场禁售协议届满后，在任何三个月期间内出售不超过以下两者中较大者的股份数量：

In general, under Rule 144, as currently in effect, our affiliates or persons selling shares on behalf of our affiliates are entitled to sell upon expiration of the lock-up and market standoff agreements described above, within any three-month period, a number of shares that does not exceed the greater of:

- 当时已发行的我们 A 类普通股股份数量的 1%，在本次发行及同步股份发行完成后将约等于 3,459,974 股；或

- 1% of the number of shares of our Class A common stock then outstanding, which will equal approximately 3,459,974 shares immediately after this offering and the concurrent share issuance; or

- 在就该项出售向 SEC 提交 Form 144 通知之前的四个日历周内，我们 A 类普通股的周平均交易量。

- the average weekly trading volume of our Class A common stock during the four calendar weeks preceding the filing of a notice on Form 144 with respect to that sale.

我们的关联方或代表关联方出售股份的人士根据 144 规则进行的出售，还须遵守某些出售方式规定和通知要求，以及关于我们的当前公开信息的可获得性。

Sales under Rule 144 by our affiliates or persons selling shares on behalf of our affiliates are also subject to certain manner of sale provisions and notice requirements and to the availability of current public information about us.

701 规则 Rule 701

规则 701 通常允许依据书面补偿计划或合同购买我们股本股份、且在紧接前 90 天内未被视作公司关联方的股东，依据规则 144 出售该等股份，但无需遵守规则 144 的公开信息、持有期、数量限制或通知条款。规则 701 亦允许公司关联方依据规则 144 出售其规则 701 股份，而无需遵守规则 144 的持有期要求。然而，该规则要求所有规则 701 股份持有人须自本招股说明书之日起满 90 天后，方可依据规则 701 出售该等股份，且以本文所述锁定期及市场禁售协议届满为前提。

Rule 701 generally allows a stockholder who purchased shares of our capital stock pursuant to a written compensatory plan or contract and who is not deemed to have been an affiliate of our company during the immediately preceding 90 days to sell these shares in reliance upon Rule 144, but without being required to comply with the public information, holding period, volume limitation, or notice provisions of Rule 144. Rule 701 also permits affiliates of our company to sell their Rule 701 shares under Rule 144 without complying with the holding period requirements of Rule 144. All holders of Rule 701 shares, however, are required by that rule to wait until 90 days after the date of this prospectus before selling those shares pursuant to Rule 701, subject to the expiration of the lock-up and market standoff agreements described herein.

注册声明 Registration Statements

本次发行完成后，我们拟在可行情况下尽快根据《证券法》以 S-8 表格提交一份或多份注册声明，涵盖所有受未行使期权及 RSU 约束的 A 类普通股股份，以及根据我们的股权激励计划预留供发行的 A 类普通股股份。我们预计将在《证券法》允许的情况下尽快提交该等注册声明。然而，在 S-8 表格上登记的股份可能受 Rule 144 的成交量限制以及销售方式、通知和公开信息要求的约束，并且在相关股份所受的锁定期和市场禁售协议到期之前，不具备转售资格。

As soon as practicable after the completion of this offering, we intend to file one or more registration statements on Form S-8 under the Securities Act covering all of the shares of our Class A common stock subject to outstanding options and RSUs and the shares of our Class A common stock reserved for issuance under our equity incentive plans. We expect to file such registration statement(s) as soon as permitted under the Securities Act. However, the shares registered on Form S-8 may be subject to the volume limitations and the manner of sale, notice, and public information requirements of Rule 144 and will not be eligible for resale until expiration of the lock-up and market standoff agreements to which they are subject.

注册权 Registration Rights

我们已向部分股东授予要求登记权、附带登记权和 S-3 表格登记权，以便其出售我们的普通股。根据《证券法》登记这些股份的出售，将使这些股份在登记生效后立即可以根据《证券法》自由交易而不受限制，但关联方购买的股份除外。有关这些权利的进一步说明，请参见标题为“股本说明——登记权”的章节。

**MATERIAL U.S. FEDERAL INCOME TAX CONSIDERATIONS FOR NON-U.S. HOLDERS OF OUR CLASS A COMMON STOCK**

以下摘要描述了非美国持有人（定义见下文）在本次发行中取得的 A 类普通股的取得、持有和处置所产生的重大美国联邦所得税后果。本讨论并未涵盖美国联邦所得税的所有方面，未讨论任何替代性最低税或净投资收入医疗保险附加税的潜在适用，也未讨论《税法》第 451(b) 条下的特殊税务会计规则，并且不涉及任何州或地方税、美国联邦赠与税或遗产税法（仅在以下有限范围内除外），也不涉及根据非美国持有人的特定情况可能与其相关的任何非美国税务后果。

The following summary describes the material U.S. federal income tax consequences of the acquisition, ownership, and disposition of our Class A common stock acquired in this offering by Non-U.S. Holders (as defined below). This discussion does not address all aspects of U.S. federal income taxes, does not discuss the potential application of any alternative minimum tax or the Medicare contribution tax on net investment income, or the special tax accounting rules under Section 451(b) of the Code, and does not deal with any state or local taxes, U.S. federal gift or estate tax laws (except to the limited extent provided below), or any non-U.S. tax consequences that may be relevant to Non-U.S. Holders in light of their particular circumstances.

Special rules different from those described below may apply to certain Non-U.S. Holders that are subject to special treatment under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), such as:

- “qualified foreign pension funds” as defined in Section 897(l)(2) of the Code and entities all of the interests of which are held by qualified foreign pension funds;

- persons that own, or are deemed to own, more than 5% of our Class A common stock;

- “受控外国公司”、“被动外国投资公司”，以及为规避美国联邦所得税而累积收益的公司；

- “controlled foreign corporations,” “passive foreign investment companies,” and corporations that accumulate earnings to avoid U.S. federal income tax;

- 作为“跨式”、“对冲”、“转换交易”、“合成证券”或综合投资或其他风险降低策略的一部分持有我们 A 类普通股的人士；

- persons that hold our Class A common stock as part of a “straddle,” “hedge,” “conversion transaction,” “synthetic security,” or integrated investment or other risk reduction strategy;

- 不将我们 A 类普通股作为《税法》第 1221 条含义下的资本资产持有的人士（一般而言，即出于投资目的持有）；以及

- persons who do not hold our Class A common stock as a capital asset within the meaning of Section 1221 of the Code (generally, for investment purposes); and

- 合伙企业及其他穿透实体和安排，以及此类穿透实体和安排的投资者（无论其组织或设立地点如何）。

- partnerships and other pass-through entities and arrangements, and investors in such pass-through entities and arrangements (regardless of their places of organization or formation).

我们敦促此类非美国持有人咨询其税务顾问，以确定收购、持有和处置我们 A 类普通股可能对其相关的美国联邦、州、地方及其他税务后果。

COMMON STOCK IN LIGHT OF THEIR PARTICULAR SITUATIONS AS WELL AS ANY TAX CONSEQUENCES ARISING UNDER THE LAWS OF ANY OTHER TAXING JURISDICTION, INCLUDING ANY STATE, LOCAL, OR NON-U.S. TAX CONSEQUENCES OR ANY U.S. FEDERAL NON-INCOME TAX CONSEQUENCES, AND THE POSSIBLE APPLICATION OF TAX TREATIES.

就本讨论而言，非美国持有人是指对我们的 A 类普通股享有受益所有权，且就美国联邦所得税而言不属于美国持有人、也不属于合伙企业或其他穿透实体或安排的受益所有人。美国持有人是指对我们的 A 类普通股享有受益所有权，且就美国联邦所得税而言属于以下情形之一的人：(1) 为美国公民或美国居民的个人；(2) 根据美国、美国任何州或哥伦比亚特区法律设立或组织的公司（或就美国联邦所得税而言作为公司征税的其他实体）；(3) 其收入无论来源如何均须缴纳美国联邦所得税的遗产；或 (4) 信托，前提是该信托 (i) 受美国境内法院的主要监督，且一名或多名美国人(按《税法》第 7701(a)(30) 条的含义)有权控制该信托的所有重大决定，或 (ii) 根据适用的财政部法规作出有效选择，被视为美国人。

For purposes of this discussion, a Non-U.S. Holder is a beneficial owner of our Class A common stock that is not a U.S. Holder or a partnership or other pass-through entity or arrangement for U.S. federal income tax purposes. A U.S. Holder means a beneficial owner of our Class A common stock that is, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, (1) an individual who is a citizen or resident of the United States, (2) a corporation (or other entity taxable as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes) created or organized in or under the laws of the United States, any state thereof, or the District of Columbia, (3) an estate the income of which is subject to U.S. federal income taxation regardless of its source, or (4) a trust if it (i) is subject to the primary supervision of a court within the United States and one or more United States persons (within the meaning of Section 7701(a)(30) of the Code) have the authority to control all substantial decisions of the trust or (ii) has a valid election in effect under applicable Treasury Regulations to be treated as a United States person.

如果您是非美国公民的个人，则可能因在某一日历年度内在美国境内停留至少 31 天，且在截至当前日历年度的三年期间内累计停留至少 183 天而被视为居民外国人（而非非居民外国人）。一般而言，为此目的，当前年度停留的全部天数、紧接上一年度停留天数的三分之一以及再上一年度停留天数的六分之一均计入。居民外国人一般须像美国公民一样缴纳美国联邦所得税。对于自身就美国联邦所得税而言属于居民外国人还是非居民外国人身份不确定的个人，我们建议其就收购、持有和处置我们的 A 类普通股所产生的美国联邦所得税后果咨询其税务顾问。

If you are an individual non-U.S. citizen, you may be deemed to be a resident alien (as opposed to a nonresident alien) by virtue of being present in the United States for at least 31 days in the calendar year and for an aggregate of at least 183 days during a three-year period ending in the current calendar year. Generally, for this purpose, all the days present in the current year, one-third of the days present in the immediately preceding year, and one-sixth of the days present in the second preceding year are counted. Resident aliens are generally subject to U.S. federal income tax as if they were U.S. citizens. Individuals who are uncertain of their status as resident or nonresident aliens for U.S. federal income tax purposes are urged to consult their tax advisors regarding the U.S. federal income tax consequences of the acquisition, ownership, and disposition of our Class A common stock.

分配 Distributions

我们目前没有计划在可预见的未来就我们的 A 类普通股支付任何股息。但是，如果我们确实就我们的 A 类普通股进行分配，则向非美国持有人作出的该等分配，在从我们当期或累计的收益和利润（按美国联邦所得税原则确定）中支付的范围内，将构成美国税务意义上的股息。超过我们当期和累计收益和利润的分配将构成资本返还，用于冲减（但不低于零）非美国持有人在我们 A 类普通股中的调整计税基础。任何剩余的超出部分将被视为出售或交换我们 A 类普通股所实现的收益，如下文“——我们 A 类普通股处置收益”一节所述。

We do not have current plans to pay any dividends on our Class A common stock in the foreseeable future. If we do make distributions on our Class A common stock, however, such distributions made to a Non-U.S. Holder will constitute dividends for U.S. tax purposes to the extent paid out of our current or accumulated earnings and profits (as determined under U.S. federal income tax principles). Distributions in excess of our current and accumulated earnings and profits will constitute a return of capital that is applied against and reduces, but not below zero, a Non-U.S. Holder’s adjusted tax basis in our Class A common stock. Any remaining excess will be treated as gain realized on the sale or exchange of our Class A common stock as described below under the section titled “—Gain on Disposition of Our Class A Common Stock.”

我们 A 类普通股的任何分配，若被视为向非美国持有人支付的股息，且与该持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务无实际关联，通常将按 30%的税率或美国与该非美国持有人居住国之间适用的所得税条约所规定的较低税率缴纳预提税。为根据适用的所得税条约获得降低的预提税率，非美国持有人通常需要向适用的预提代理人提供正确填写的 IRS Form W-8BEN、IRS Form W-8BEN-E 或其他适当表格，证明该非美国持有人有权享受该所得税条约下的优惠。该表格必须在支付股息之前提供，并须定期更新。如果非美国持有人通过代表其行事的金融机构或其他代理人持有股票，则该持有人需要向该代理人提供适当的文件。随后，该持有人的代理人需要直接或通过其他中介向适用的预提代理人提供证明。如果您有资格根据所得税条约享受降低的美国预提税税率，您应咨询您的税务顾问，以确定您是否能够通过及时向 IRS 提交适当的退税申请，获得任何超额预提款项的退还或抵免。

Any distribution on our Class A common stock that is treated as a dividend paid to a Non-U.S. Holder that is not effectively connected with the holder’s conduct of a trade or business in the United States will generally be subject to withholding tax at a 30% rate or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty between the United States and the Non-U.S. Holder’s country of residence. To obtain a reduced rate of withholding tax under an applicable income tax treaty, a Non-U.S. Holder generally will be required to provide the applicable withholding agent with a properly executed IRS Form W-8BEN, IRS Form W-8BEN-E, or other appropriate form, certifying the Non-U.S. Holder’s entitlement to benefits under that income tax treaty. Such form must be provided prior to the payment of dividends and must be updated periodically. If a Non-U.S. Holder holds stock through a financial institution or other agent acting on the holder’s behalf, the holder will be required to provide appropriate documentation to such agent. The holder’s agent will then be required to provide certification to the applicable withholding agent, either directly or through other intermediaries. If you are eligible for a reduced rate of U.S. withholding tax under an income tax treaty, you should consult with your tax advisor to determine if you are able to obtain a refund or credit of any excess amounts withheld by timely filing an appropriate claim for a refund with the IRS.

通常情况下，我们无需就支付给非美国持有人的股息代扣税款，前提是该等股息与该持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务存在实际关联（且若适用的所得税条约有此要求，该等股息可归属于该持有人在美国维持的常设机构），并且已向相关扣缴义务人提供正确填写的 IRS W-8ECI 表格，说明该等股息存在上述关联。一般而言，该等实际关联股息将按适用于美国人士的常规税率，以净收入为基础缴纳美国联邦所得税。收到实际关联股息的公司制非美国持有人还可能需缴纳额外的“分支机构利润税”，该税在特定情形下按 30% 的税率（或适用条约规定的更低税率）对公司制非美国持有人的实际关联收益和利润征收，并需作若干调整。

We generally are not required to withhold tax on dividends paid to a Non-U.S. Holder that are effectively connected with the holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, are attributable to a permanent establishment that the holder maintains in the United States) if a properly executed IRS Form W-8ECI, stating that the dividends are so connected, is furnished to the applicable withholding agent. In general, such effectively connected dividends will be subject to U.S. federal income tax on a net income basis at the regular rates applicable to United States persons. A corporate Non-U.S. Holder receiving effectively connected dividends may also be subject to an additional “branch profits tax,” which is imposed, under certain circumstances, at a rate of 30% (or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable treaty) on the corporate Non-U.S. Holder’s effectively connected earnings and profits, subject to certain adjustments.

See also the sections titled “—Backup Withholding and Information Reporting” and “—Foreign Accounts” for additional withholding rules that may apply to dividends, including dividends paid to certain foreign financial institutions or non-financial foreign entities.

处置我们 A 类普通股的收益 Gain on Disposition of Our Class A Common Stock

在遵守下文“—备用预扣税与信息申报”及“—外国账户”两节所述讨论的前提下，非美国持有人通常无需就出售或以其他方式处置我们的 A 类普通股所实现的收益缴纳美国联邦所得税或预扣税，除非：(1) 该收益与非美国持有人在美国开展的贸易或业务存在有效关联（且若适用所得税条约有此要求，该收益归属于非美国持有人在美国维持的常设机构）；(2) 非美国持有人为非居民外籍个人，且在处置的纳税年度内在美国停留 183 天或以上，并满足某些其他条件；或(3) 我们在该处置之前的五年期间或非美国持有人持有我们 A 类普通股的持有期（以较短者为准）内的任何时间，属于或曾经属于《税法》第 897(c)(2)条所指的“美国不动产持有公司”。

Subject to the discussions below under the sections titled “—Backup Withholding and Information Reporting” and “—Foreign Accounts,” a Non-U.S. Holder generally will not be subject to U.S. federal income or withholding tax with respect to gain realized on a sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock unless (1) the gain is effectively connected with a trade or business of the Non-U.S. Holder in the United States (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, is attributable to a permanent establishment that the Non-U.S. Holder maintains in the United States), (2) the Non-U.S. Holder is a nonresident alien individual and is present in the United States for 183 or more days in the taxable year of the disposition and certain other conditions are met, or (3) we are or have been a “United States real property holding corporation” within the meaning of Section 897(c)(2) of the Code at any time within the shorter of the five-year period preceding such disposition or the Non-U.S. Holder’s holding period in our Class A common stock.

若您为非美国持有人，上述第(1)项所述收益将按适用于美国人的常规美国联邦所得税税率，就出售所得净收益缴税。若您为公司型非美国持有人，上述第(1)项所述收益还可能需缴纳额外的分支机构利润税，税率为 30%或适用所得税条约可能规定的较低税率。若您为上述第(2)项所述的个人非美国持有人，您将需就出售所得收益缴纳 30%的统一所得税，该收益可用某些美国来源的资本损失予以抵销（即使您不被视为美国居民），前提是您已就此类损失及时申报美国联邦所得税申报表。就上述第(3)项而言，一般而言，若美国不动产权益（定义见《税法》及《财政部条例》）按公允市场价值计算至少占我们全球不动产及我们用于或持有用于贸易或业务的其他资产的一半，我们即属于美国不动产持有公司。我们认为我们目前不是、且预计不会成为美国不动产持有公司。但是，无法保证我们未来不会成为美国不动产持有公司。即使我们被视为美国不动产持有公司，只要(1) 在(i) 处置之前的五年期间或(ii) 非美国持有人的持有期（以较短者为准）内，非美国持有人直接、间接及推定拥有的我们 A 类普通股始终不超过 5%，且(2) 就相关规则而言，我们的 A 类普通股在成熟证券市场上定期交易，则非美国持有人处置我们 A 类普通股所实现的收益将无需缴纳美国联邦所得税。无法保证我们的 A 类普通股将符合就此目的在成熟证券市场上定期交易的条件。

If you are a Non-U.S. Holder, gain described in (1) above will be subject to tax on the net gain derived from the sale at the regular U.S. federal income tax rates applicable to United States persons. If you are a corporate Non-U.S. Holder, gain described in (1) above may also be subject to the additional branch profits tax at a 30% rate or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty. If you are an individual Non-U.S. Holder described in (2) above, you will be required to pay a flat 30% income tax on the gain derived from the sale, which gain may be offset by certain U.S. source capital losses (even though you are not considered a resident of the United States), provided you have timely filed U.S. federal income tax returns with respect to such losses. With respect to (3) above, in general, we would be a United States real property holding corporation if United States real property interests (as defined in the Code and the Treasury Regulations) comprised (by fair market value) at least half of our worldwide real property and our other assets which are used or held for use in a trade or business. We believe that we are not, and do not anticipate becoming, a United States real property holding corporation. However, there can be no assurance that we will not become a United States real property holding corporation in the future. Even if we are treated as a United States real property holding corporation, gain realized by a Non-U.S. Holder on a disposition of our Class A common stock will not be subject to U.S. federal income tax so long as (1) the Non-U.S. Holder owned, directly, indirectly, and constructively, no more than five percent of our Class A common stock at all times within the shorter of (i) the five-year period preceding the disposition or (ii) the Non-U.S. Holder’s holding period and (2) our Class A common stock is regularly traded on an established securities market for purposes of the relevant rules. There can be no assurance that our Class A common stock will qualify as regularly traded on an established securities market for this purpose.

美国联邦遗产税 U.S. Federal Estate Tax

非居民外籍个人的遗产通常需就位于美国境内的财产缴纳美国联邦遗产税。由于本公司为美国公司，我们的 A 类普通股将属于美国境内财产，因此，除非美国与被继承人居住国之间适用的遗产税条约另有规定，否则该等股份将被计入非居民外籍被继承人的应税遗产。就美国联邦遗产税而言，“居民”和“非居民”的定义与美国联邦所得税下的定义不同。敦促投资者就收购、持有或处置我们的 A 类普通股所产生的美国联邦遗产税后果咨询其税务顾问。

The estates of nonresident alien individuals generally are subject to U.S. federal estate tax on property with a U.S. situs. Because we are a U.S. corporation, our Class A common stock will be U.S. situs property and, therefore, will be included in the taxable estate of a nonresident alien decedent, unless an applicable estate tax treaty between the United States and the decedent’s country of residence provides otherwise. The terms “resident” and “nonresident” are defined differently for U.S. federal estate tax purposes than for U.S. federal income tax purposes. Investors are urged to consult their tax advisors regarding the U.S. federal estate tax consequences of the acquisition, ownership, or disposition of our Class A common stock.

备用预扣税与信息申报 Backup Withholding and Information Reporting

一般而言，我们或适用的预扣代理人必须就我们向 A 类普通股支付的任何分配（无论该分配是否构成股息）向 IRS 报告信息，包括任何该等分配的金额、收款人的姓名和地址，以及预扣税款金额（如有）。类似的报告也会发送给获得任何该等分配的持有人。根据税收协定或某些其他协议，IRS 可能会将其报告提供给收款人居住国的税务机关。

Generally, we or an applicable withholding agent must report information to the IRS with respect to any distributions we pay on our Class A common stock (whether or not the distribution constitutes a dividend), including the amount of any such distributions, the name and address of the recipient, and the amount, if any, of tax withheld. A similar report is sent to the holder to whom any such distributions are paid. Pursuant to tax treaties or certain other agreements, the IRS may make its reports available to tax authorities in the recipient’s country of residence.

我们（或我们的付款代理人）向非美国持有人支付的股息也可能需要缴纳美国备用预扣税。美国备用预扣税通常不适用于提供了正确填写的 IRS Form W-8BEN 或 IRS Form W-8BEN-E（如适用）或以其他方式确立豁免的非美国持有人，前提是适用的预扣代理人并不实际知悉或有理由知悉该持有人为美国人。

Dividends paid by us (or our paying agents) to a Non-U.S. Holder may also be subject to U.S. backup withholding. U.S. backup withholding generally will not apply to a Non-U.S. Holder who provides a properly executed IRS Form W-8BEN or IRS Form W-8BEN-E, as applicable, or otherwise establishes an exemption, provided that the applicable withholding agent does not have actual knowledge or reason to know the holder is a United States person.

根据现行美国联邦所得税法，美国信息报告和备用预扣税要求通常适用于通过任何经纪商（无论美国或非美国）的美国办事处处置我们 A 类普通股所得的款项，除非非美国持有人提供了正确填写的 IRS Form W-8BEN 或 IRS Form W-8BEN-E（如适用），或以其他方式满足确立非美国人身份的证明文件要求，或以其他方式确立豁免。一般而言，如果交易是通过非美国经纪商的非美国办事处在美国境外进行的，则美国信息报告和备用预扣税要求不适用于向非美国持有人支付处置所得款项。但是，如果经纪商实际知悉或有理由知悉该持有人实际上是美国人，则信息报告和备用预扣税要求可能适用于处置所得款项的支付。仅为信息报告目的，某些在美国拥有大量所有权或业务的经纪商通常将按照类似于美国经纪商的方式处理。

Under current U.S. federal income tax law, U.S. information reporting and backup withholding requirements generally will apply to the proceeds of a disposition of our Class A common stock effected by or through a U.S. office of any broker, U.S. or non-U.S., unless the Non-U.S. Holder provides a properly executed IRS Form W-8BEN or IRS Form W-8BEN-E, as applicable, or otherwise meets documentary evidence requirements for establishing non-U.S. person status or otherwise establishes an exemption. Generally, U.S. information reporting and backup withholding requirements will not apply to a payment of disposition proceeds to a Non-U.S. Holder where the transaction is effected outside the United States through a non-U.S. office of a non-U.S. broker. Information reporting and backup withholding requirements may, however, apply to a payment of disposition proceeds if the broker has actual knowledge, or reason to know, that the holder is, in fact, a United States person. For information reporting purposes only, certain brokers with substantial U.S. ownership or operations will generally be treated in a manner similar to U.S. brokers.

备用预扣税不是额外税款。如果对您适用了备用预扣税，您应咨询您的税务顾问，以确定您是否能够获得多缴税款的退税或抵免。

Backup withholding is not an additional tax. If backup withholding is applied to you, you should consult with your tax advisor to determine whether you are able to obtain a tax refund or credit of the overpaid amount.

境外账户 Foreign Accounts

此外，根据《外国账户税收合规法案》（“FATCA”），美国联邦预提税可能适用于某些类型的付款，包括向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息，支付对象为非美国金融机构及某些其他非美国实体。具体而言，向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息若支付给“外国金融机构”或“非金融外国实体”（各自定义见《税法》），可能被征收 30%的预提税，除非（1）该外国金融机构同意承担某些尽职调查和报告义务，（2）该非金融外国实体证明其没有任何“美国实质性所有人”（定义见《税法》），或提供关于每位美国实质性所有人的身份信息，或（3）该外国金融机构或非金融外国实体以其他方式符合上述规则的豁免条件。本段所述的 30%联邦预提税通常不适用美国所得税协定下的减免。如果收款人是外国金融机构且受上述第（1）项尽职调查和报告要求的约束，则其必须与美国财政部签订协议，要求其除其他事项外承诺识别由某些“特定美国人”或“美国拥有的外国实体”（各自定义见《税法》）持有的账户，每年报告有关该等账户的某些信息，并对向不合规的外国金融机构及某些其他账户持有人支付的某些款项预提 30%的税款。位于与美国就 FATCA 签订了政府间协定的司法管辖区的外国金融机构可能适用不同的规则。尽管根据适用的财政部条例和行政指引，FATCA 项下的预提税通常也会适用于出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入款项，但拟议的财政部条例完全取消了针对毛收入款项的 FATCA 预提税。拟议条例的前言明确指出，在最终定稿之前，纳税人可以依赖该等拟议条例。

In addition, U.S. federal withholding taxes may apply under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (“FATCA”) on certain types of payments, including dividends on our Class A common stock, made to non-U.S. financial institutions and certain other non-U.S. entities. Specifically, a 30% withholding tax may be imposed on dividends on our Class A common stock paid to a “foreign financial institution” or a “non-financial foreign entity” (each as defined in the Code), unless (1) the foreign financial institution agrees to undertake certain diligence and reporting obligations, (2) the non-financial foreign entity either certifies it does not have any “substantial United States owners” (as defined in the Code) or furnishes identifying information regarding each substantial United States owner, or (3) the foreign financial institution or non-financial foreign entity otherwise qualifies for an exemption from these rules. The 30% federal withholding tax described in this paragraph is not generally subject to reduction under income tax treaties with the United States. If the payee is a foreign financial institution and is subject to the diligence and reporting requirements in (1) above, it must enter into an agreement with the U.S. Department of the Treasury requiring, among other things, that it undertake to identify accounts held by certain “specified United States persons” or “United States-owned foreign entities” (each as defined in the Code), annually report certain information about such accounts, and withhold 30% tax on certain payments to non-compliant foreign financial institutions and certain other account holders. Foreign financial institutions located in jurisdictions that have an intergovernmental agreement with the United States governing FATCA may be subject to different rules. While under the applicable Treasury Regulations and administrative guidance, withholding taxes under FATCA generally also would have applied to payments of gross proceeds from the sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock, proposed Treasury Regulations eliminate FATCA withholding on payments of gross proceeds entirely. The preamble to the proposed regulations specifies that taxpayers are permitted to rely on such proposed regulations pending finalization.

潜在投资者应就其对我们 A 类普通股的投资可能适用 FATCA 项下预提税一事咨询其税务顾问。

Prospective investors should consult their tax advisors regarding the potential application of withholding taxes under FATCA to their investment in our Class A common stock.

每位潜在投资者均应就其收购、持有和处置我们 A 类普通股所涉及的税务后果咨询其税务顾问，包括适用法律任何拟议变更的后果，以及根据任何州、地方、非美国或美国联邦非所得税法律（如遗产税和赠与税）产生的税务后果，以及税务协定可能适用的情况。

EACH PROSPECTIVE INVESTOR SHOULD CONSULT ITS TAX ADVISOR REGARDING THE TAX CONSEQUENCES OF ACQUIRING, OWNING, AND DISPOSING OF OUR CLASS A COMMON STOCK, INCLUDING THE CONSEQUENCES OF ANY PROPOSED CHANGE IN APPLICABLE LAW, AS WELL AS TAX CONSEQUENCES ARISING UNDER ANY STATE, LOCAL, NON-U.S. OR U.S. FEDERAL NON-INCOME TAX LAWS SUCH AS ESTATE AND GIFT TAX, AND THE POSSIBLE APPLICATION OF TAX TREATIES.

We have agreed to reimburse the underwriters for certain of their expenses up to $60,000. In addition, the underwriters have agreed to reimburse us for approximately $1 million of our expenses in connection with this offering, based on the initial public offering price per share of $40.00 and assuming no exercise of the over-allotment option.

承销商已告知我们，其不打算向全权委托账户的销售超过其发售的 A 类普通股总股数的 5%。

The underwriters have informed us that they do not intend sales to discretionary accounts to exceed 5% of the total number of shares of our Class A common stock offered by them.

我们已获准将 A 类普通股在 Nasdaq 上市，交易代码为“CRWV”。

We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on Nasdaq under the trading symbol “CRWV.”

应我们的请求，承销商已将 1,041,805 股 A 类普通股分配给表示有兴趣按首次公开发行价格在本发行中购买 A 类普通股的投资者。然而，由于意向表示不构成具有约束力的购买协议或承诺，承销商可决定向任何或所有该等方出售更多、更少或不出售本发行中的股份，或任何或所有该等方可决定在本发行中购买更多、更少或不购买股份。承销商就该等方购买的任何股份所收取的承销折扣，将与其在本发行中向公众出售的任何其他股份所收取的承销折扣相同。

At our request, the underwriters have allocated 1,041,805 shares of our Class A common stock to investors that have indicated an interest in purchasing shares of our Class A common stock in this offering at the initial public offering price. However, because indications of interest are not binding agreements or commitments to purchase, the underwriters may determine to sell more, fewer, or no shares in this offering to any or all of these parties, or any or all of these parties may determine to purchase more, fewer, or no shares in this offering. The underwriters will receive the same underwriting discount on any shares purchased by these parties as they will on any other shares sold to the public in this offering.

就本次发行而言，我们全体董事和高级管理人员、出售股东以及若干其他持有人（合计约占我们已发行 A 类普通股及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为 A 类普通股的证券的 83.7%）与承销商签订了锁定期协议。根据该等协议，除特定例外情形外，未经 Morgan Stanley（代表承销商）与 Magnetar 事先书面同意，在自本招股说明书之日起至下列两者中较早发生之日止的期间内，他们不得按照该等协议的条款：(i) 我们公开宣布本招股说明书所载财务报表对应最近期间之后第二季度业绩后的第二个交易日交易收盘时，及 (ii) 本招股说明书日期后 180 天：

In connection with this offering, all of our directors and executive officers, the selling stockholders, and certain other holders that together represent approximately 83.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to lock-up agreements with the underwriters pursuant to which they have agreed, subject to certain exceptions, that without the prior written consent of Morgan Stanley, on behalf of the underwriters, and Magnetar, they will not, in accordance with the terms of such agreements during the period ending on the earlier of (i) the close of trading on the second trading day after the date that we publicly announce earnings for the second quarter following the most recent period for which financial statements are included in this prospectus and (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus:

(1) · 直接或间接要约、质押、出售、签订出售合同、出售任何期权或购买合同、购买任何期权或出售合同、授予任何期权、权利或认股权证以购买、出借或以其他方式转让或处置我们的任何普通股股份以及可直接或间接转换为、可交换为或可行使为我们的普通股的证券；

(1) · offer, pledge, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, lend, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our common stock;

(2) · 订立任何互换、对冲交易或其他安排，将我们普通股所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给另一方，无论上述任何此类交易是否以交付我们的普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算；

(2) · enter into any swap, hedging transaction, or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of our common stock, whether any such transaction described above is to be settled by delivery of our common stock or such other securities, in cash or otherwise;

(3) · 公开披露采取上述第 (1) 或 (2) 条所限制的任何行动的意图；或

(3) · publicly disclose the intention to take any of the actions restricted by clause (1) or (2) above; or

(4) · 就我们的任何普通股股份或可转换为、可行使为或可交换为我们的普通股的任何证券的登记提出任何要求，或行使任何相关权利。

(4) · make any demand for, or exercise any right with respect to, the registration of any shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock.

此外，我们已发行 A 类普通股中另有约 14.7%的股份，以及可直接或间接转换为、或可交换为、或可行使以取得我们 A 类普通股的证券，均受限于市场禁售条款；根据该等条款，相关持有人同意，在锁定期内，不得出借、要约出售、出售、订立出售合同、出售任何购买期权或购买合同、购买任何出售期权或出售合同、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证，或以其他方式直接或间接转让或处置其在包含本招股说明书的注册声明生效前即时持有的任何 A 类普通股股份，或任何可转换为、或可行使以取得、或可交换为我们 A 类普通股的证券，亦不得订立任何互换或其他安排，将此类 A 类普通股所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给他人。该等市场禁售条款的形式及具体限制性规定因证券持有人而异。例如，尽管其中部分市场禁售协议并未明确限制对冲交易，且其他协议在我们与证券持有人之间就可能是否限制对冲存在不同解释，但我们的内幕交易政策禁止我们所有现任董事、高级管理人员、员工、承包商和顾问进行对冲。涉及我们股权证券的出售、卖空或对冲交易，无论发生在本次发行之前或之后，也无论我们是否认为其被禁止，均可能对我们 A 类普通股的价格产生不利影响。

Furthermore, an additional approximately 14.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to market standoff provisions, pursuant to which such holders agreed to not lend, offer, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our Class A common stock held immediately prior to the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, or enter into any swap or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of such Class A common stock during the Lock-up Period. The forms and specific restrictive provisions within these market standoff provisions vary among security holders. For example, although some of these market standoff agreements do not specifically restrict hedging transactions and others may be subject to different interpretations between us and security holders as to whether they restrict hedging, our insider trading policy prohibits hedging by all of our current directors, officers, employees, contractors, and consultants. Sales, short sales, or hedging transactions involving our equity securities, whether before or after this offering and whether or not we believe them to be prohibited, could adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.

鉴于上述情况，我们几乎所有已发行的 A 类普通股，以及可直接或间接转换为、或可交换为、或可行使以取得我们 A 类普通股的证券，在锁定期内均受限于锁定协议或市场禁售条款。我们已同意代表承销商执行所有该等市场禁售限制，并同意在锁定期内未经 Morgan Stanley（代表承销商）和 Magnetar 事先书面同意，不修订或豁免任何该等市场禁售条款；但前提是，对于根据本招股说明书所述由我们的董事和高级管理人员、出售股东及我们证券的某些其他登记持有人与承销商签订的锁定协议格式本应有权解除限制的股份，我们可以解除该等限制。

As a result of the foregoing, substantially all of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to a lock-up agreement or market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period. We have agreed to enforce all such market standoff restrictions on behalf of the underwriters and not to amend or waive any such market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period without the prior written consent of Morgan Stanley, on behalf of the underwriters, and Magnetar, provided that we may release shares from such restrictions to the extent such shares would be entitled to release under the form of lock-up agreement with the underwriters entered into by our directors and executive officers, the selling stockholders, and certain other record holders of our securities as described herein.

锁定协议和市场禁售条款所施加的限制受限于某些例外情形，包括就以下事项而言：

The restrictions imposed by the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions are subject to certain exceptions, including with respect to:

(a) · 与在本次发行中或本次发行完成后在公开市场交易中取得的我们普通股或其他证券股份相关的交易，前提是，在锁定期内，就后续出售在本次发行中或在上述公开市场交易中取得的我们的 A 类普通股或其他证券而言，不得要求且不得自愿作出任何公告或根据《交易法》第 16(a)条进行任何备案，也不得作出任何其他报告我们普通股实益所有权减少的公开备案或披露；

(a) · transactions relating to shares of our common stock or other securities acquired in the this offering or in open market transactions after the completion of this offering, provided that no public announcement or filing under Section 16(a) of the Exchange Act, or any other public filing or disclosure reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of shares of our common stock, shall be required or shall be voluntarily made during the Lock-up Period in connection with subsequent sales of our Class A common stock or other securities acquired either in this offering or in such open market transactions;

(b) · 转让我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股股份的证券(i)作为善意赠与或赠与慈善组织或教育机构，或(ii)出于善意的遗产规划目的，在每种情况下，该等转让均不涉及有偿处置；

(b) · transfers of shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for shares of our common stock (i) as a bona fide gift or to a charitable organization or educational institution or (ii) for bona fide estate planning purposes, in each case, in a transfer not involving a disposition for value;

(c) · 将我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股股份的证券转让或处置给(i)锁定期方的任何直系亲属，或为锁定期方或锁定期方直系亲属的直接或间接利益设立的任何信托，或若锁定期方为信托，则转让给委托人、受托人或任何受益人（包括该等委托人、受托人或受益人的遗产），以及(ii)在不涉及有偿处置的交易中进行；

(c) · transfers or dispositions of shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock to (i) any member of the immediate family of the lock-up party or any trust for the direct or indirect benefit of the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party, or if the lock-up party is a trust, to a trustor, trustee, or any beneficiary (including such trustor, trustee, or beneficiary’s estate), and (ii) in a transaction not involving a disposition for value;

(d) · 将我们的普通股股份或其他证券分配、转让或处置给任何公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、作为锁定期方关联方的其他实体、由锁定期方的投资管理人、顾问发起、管理、提供咨询或提供副咨询的投资基金，或锁定期方的顾问，或锁定期方或其直系亲属持有其全部实益权益的实体，且该等交易不涉及有偿处置；

(d) · distributions, transfers, or dispositions of shares of our common stock or other securities to any corporation, partnership, limited liability company, other entity that is an affiliate of the lock-up party, investment fund sponsored, managed, advised, or sub-advised by the investment manager, or advisor of the lock-up party or of which all of the beneficial ownership interests of which are held by the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party in a transaction not involving a disposition for value;

(e) · 通过遗嘱、其他遗嘱文件或无遗嘱继承转让或处置我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股股份的证券，以及

(e) · transfers or dispositions of shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock (i) by will, other testamentary document or intestate succession and

(ii) 通过法律实施，包括但不限于依据法院或监管机构的命令、与协商离婚和解相关、依据合格家庭关系令或依据其他法院命令；

(ii) by operation of law including, without limitation, pursuant to orders of a court or regulatory agency, in connection with a negotiated divorce settlement, pursuant to a qualified domestic relations order or by other court order;

(f) · 转让给根据上文(b)至(e)项允许进行处置或转让的个人或实体的代名人或托管人；

(f) · to a nominee or custodian of a person or entity to whom a disposition or transfer would be permissible under clauses (b) through (e) above;

(g) · 若锁定期一方为公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他实体，(x) 将我们的普通股股份或可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股的其他证券转让或处置给另一公司、成员、管理人、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他实体（或在每种情况下其代名人或托管人），且该实体为锁定期一方的直接或间接关联方（按《交易法》第 12b-2 条规则的定义），或转让或处置给控制、管理、提供建议或副建议、或与锁定期一方或锁定期一方的关联方处于共同控制之下的投资基金或其他实体，或 (y) 将我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股的证券分配给锁定期一方的现任或前任合伙人（普通或有限）、成员、管理人、股东、受益人或其他权益持有人（或在每种情况下其代名人或托管人），或分配给任何该等合伙人、成员、管理人、股东、受益人或其他权益持有人的遗产；

(g) · if the lock-up party is a corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other entity, (x) transfers or dispositions of shares of our common stock or other securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock to another corporation, member, managers, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other entity (or in each case its nominee or custodian) that is a direct or indirect affiliate (as defined under Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act) of the lock-up party, or to an investment fund or other entity that controls, manages, advises or sub-advises, or is under common control with, the lock-up party or affiliates of the lock-up party, or (y) distributions of shares of our common stock or any security convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock to current or former partners (general or limited), members, managers, stockholders, beneficiaries, or other equity holders of the lock-up party (or in each case its nominee or custodian) or to the estate of any such partners, members, managers, stockholders, beneficiaries, or other equity holders;

(h) · (i) 锁定期一方从我们处收到我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为普通股的证券，系因行使期权、结算限制性股票单位或其他股权奖励，或行使截至本招股说明书日期尚未行使且已在本招股说明书中披露的认股权证，或 (ii) 因限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证或其他购买我们普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股的证券的权利的归属、结算或行使（在每种情况下包括通过“净额”或“无现金”行使方式），向我们转让或处置，包括因该等限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证或其他权利的归属、结算或行使而应付的税款预扣或汇款的任何向我们转让，或因可转换证券的转换而向我们转让或处置，在所有这些情况下均依据股票激励计划或其他股权奖励计划授予的股权奖励，或依据可转换证券的条款，各项均如本文所述；但前提是 (i) 锁定期一方收到的任何该等我们的普通股股份或任何可转换为、可行使或可交换为我们普通股的证券应受锁定协议条款的约束，(ii) 除 (iii) 所述外，在锁定期内不得自愿作出《交易法》第 16(a) 条项下的任何公告或备案，或任何其他报告我们普通股股份实益所有权减少的公开备案或披露，且 (iii) 若因依据第 (h)(ii) 条进行的该等转让或处置而需要在锁定期内作出《交易法》第 16(a) 条项下的备案，该备案应明确表明该备案与本第 (h)(ii) 条所述情形有关；

就本次发行而言，在截至以下两者中较早发生之日止的期间内（(i) 我们发布紧接本招股说明书所载财务报表最近期间之后第二个季度财报后的第二个交易日交易收盘时，及 (ii) 本招股说明书日期后 180 日）（“受限期间”），我们将受到一定限制，不得：(1) 直接或间接要约、质押、出售、订立出售合同、出售任何购买期权或购买合同、购买任何出售期权或出售合同、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证、出借或以其他方式转让或处置我们的任何普通股股份或任何可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的证券，或 (2) 订立任何互换或其他安排，将我们普通股所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给另一方，无论上述第 (1) 项或第 (2) 项所述的任何此类交易是否以交付普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算，或 (3) 就发行我们的任何普通股股份或任何可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的证券向 SEC 提交任何注册声明。

In connection with the offering, and during the period ending on the earlier of (i) the closing of trading on the second trading day immediately following our release of earnings for the second quarter following the most recent period for which financial statements are included in this prospectus and (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the “Restricted Period”), we will be subject to certain restrictions on our ability to: (1) offer, pledge, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right or warrant to purchase, lend, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for common stock or (2) enter into any swap or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of our common stock, whether any such transaction described in clause (1) or (2) above is to be settled by delivery of common stock or such other securities, in cash or otherwise or (3) file any registration statement with the SEC relating to the offering of any shares of our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for common stock.

在我们于限制期内发行证券所受的限制存在若干例外情形，包括：(a) 根据承销协议将出售的股份；(b) 行使本招股说明书日期已存在的期权或认股权证，或转换该日已存在的证券，或按本文件所述结算限制性股票单位（包括净额结算）；(c) 根据本招股说明书日期生效且本文件所述的计划条款，向我们员工、高级管理人员、董事、顾问或咨询人授予股票期权、股票奖励、限制性股票、限制性股票单位或其他股权奖励，以及向其发行我们的普通股或可转换为普通股或可行使为普通股的证券（无论是通过行使股票期权还是其他方式）；(d) 就根据本招股说明书日期生效且本文件所述的任何员工福利计划已授予或将要授予的股权奖励的发行、归属、行使、结算或转售，提交 S-8 表格注册声明；(e) 在本次发行中转换我们的优先股时，作为支付应计股息而发行我们的普通股股份；(f) 就一项或多项合并；收购证券、业务、财产或其他资产、产品或技术；合资企业；商业关系或其他战略公司交易或联盟，而出售或发行或签订协议出售或发行我们的普通股或可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的证券；但前提是，我们可能出售或发行或同意出售或发行的我们的普通股或可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的证券（按转换后、行使后或交换后基准计算）的总金额，不得超过本次发行完成后立即按完全稀释基准计算的我们已发行和流通普通股总股数的 10%（“并购上限”）；但前提是，如本文件所述，与我们收购 Weights and Biases, Inc. 相关可能发行的普通股股份不受并购上限限制；(g) 如本文件所述，在 Magnetar 行使购买 15.0 百万美元 A 类普通股的期权时，向 Magnetar 关联方私募配售我们的普通股股份；(h) 如本文件所述，向 OpenAI 私募配售发行的我们的 A 类普通股股份；(i) 为股东、高级管理人员或董事根据《交易法》第 10b5-1 条规则建立转让我们普通股股份的交易计划提供便利，但前提是 (A) 该计划不规定在限制期内转让我们的普通股（除非锁定协议格式另有允许），且 (B) 如果我们被要求或自愿就建立该计划作出《交易法》下的公开公告或备案（如有），该公告或备案应包含一项声明，大意是在限制期内不得根据该计划转让我们的普通股；但前提是，就上述 (b) 和 (f) 条而言，其接收方向承销商提供签署的锁定协议。

The restrictions on issuances by us during the Restricted Period are subject to certain exceptions, including with respect to: (a) shares to be sold pursuant to the underwriting agreement, (b) upon the exercise of an option or warrant or the conversion of a security outstanding as of the date of this prospectus or the settlement of restricted stock units (including net settlement) as described herein, (c) grants of stock options, stock awards, restricted stock, restricted stock units or other equity awards, and the issuance of our common stock or securities convertible into or exercisable for our common stock (whether upon the exercise of stock options or otherwise) to our employees, officers, directors, advisors, or consultants pursuant to the terms of a plan in effect on the date of this prospectus and described herein, (d) the filing of a registration statement on Form S-8 relating to the issuance, vesting, exercise, settlement, or resale of equity awards granted or to be granted pursuant to any employee benefit plan in effect on the date of this prospectus and described herein, (e) the issuance of shares of our common stock as payment of accrued dividends in connection with the conversion of our shares of preferred stock in this offering, (f) the sale or issuance of or entry into an agreement to sell or issue our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock in connection with one or more mergers; acquisitions of securities, businesses, property or other assets, products, or technologies; joint ventures; commercial relationships, or other strategic corporate transactions or alliances; provided that the aggregate amounts of our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock (on an as-converted, as-exercised, or as-exchanged basis) that we may sell or issue or agree to sell or issue shall not exceed 10% of the total number of shares of our common stock issued and outstanding immediately following the completion of this offering determined on a fully-diluted basis (the “M&A Cap”); provided, however, that those shares of common stock that may be issued in connection with our acquisition of Weights and Biases, Inc., as described herein, shall not be subject to the M&A Cap, (g) the sale and issuance of shares of our common stock in a private placement to affiliates of Magnetar upon exercise of Magnetar’s option to purchase $15.0 million of Class A common stock as described herein, (h) shares of our Class A common stock issued in a private placement to OpenAI, as described herein, (i) facilitating the establishment of a trading plan on behalf of a stockholder, officer, or director pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act for the transfer of shares of our common stock, provided that (A) such plan does not provide for the transfer of our common stock during the Restricted Period (except as otherwise permitted under the form of lock-up agreement) and (B) to the extent a public announcement or filing under the Exchange Act, if any, is required of or voluntarily made by us regarding the establishment of such plan, such announcement or filing shall include a statement to the effect that no transfer of our common stock may be made under such plan during the Restricted Period; provided that, with respect to clauses (b) and (f) above, the recipients thereof provide to the underwriters a signed lock-up agreement.

为便利我们 A 类普通股的发行，承销商可能进行稳定、维持或以其他方式影响我们 A 类普通股价格的交易。具体而言，承销商可能卖出超过其在承销协议项下有义务购买的股份，从而形成空头头寸。若空头头寸不超过承销商根据超额配售选择权可购买的股份数量，则该卖空为补足型卖空。承销商可通过行使超额配售选择权或在公开市场购买股份来平仓补足型卖空。在确定平仓补足型卖空的股份来源时，承销商将考虑（其中包括）股份的公开市场价格与超额配售选择权项下可购买价格之间的比较。承销商还可能卖出超过超额配售选择权数量的股份，从而形成裸空头头寸。承销商必须通过在公开市场购买股份来平仓任何裸空头头寸。如果承销商担心定价后我们 A 类普通股在公开市场可能面临下行压力，从而可能对本次发行中购买的投资者产生不利影响，则更可能形成裸空头头寸。作为便利本次发行的额外手段，承销商可能在公开市场出价购买我们 A 类普通股，以稳定我们 A 类普通股的价格。这些活动可能使我们 A 类普通股的市场价格高于独立市场水平或维持在该水平，或阻止或减缓我们 A 类普通股市场价格的下跌。承销商无义务进行这些活动，并可随时终止任何此类活动。

In order to facilitate the offering of our Class A common stock, the underwriters may engage in transactions that stabilize, maintain, or otherwise affect the price of our Class A common stock. Specifically, the underwriters may sell more shares than they are obligated to purchase under the underwriting agreement, creating a short position. A short sale is covered if the short position is no greater than the number of shares available for purchase by the underwriters under the over-allotment option. The underwriters can close out a covered short sale by exercising the over-allotment option or purchasing shares in the open market. In determining the source of shares to close out a covered short sale, the underwriters will consider, among other things, the open market price of shares compared to the price available under the over-allotment option. The underwriters may also sell shares in excess of the over-allotment option, creating a naked short position. The underwriters must close out any naked short position by purchasing shares in the open market. A naked short position is more likely to be created if the underwriters are concerned that there may be downward pressure on the price of our Class A common stock in the open market after pricing that could adversely affect investors who purchase in this offering. As an additional means of facilitating this offering, the underwriters may bid for, and purchase, shares of our Class A common stock in the open market to stabilize the price of our Class A common stock. These activities may raise or maintain the market price of our Class A common stock above independent market levels or prevent or slow a decline in the market price of our Class A common stock. The underwriters are not required to engage in these activities and may end any of these activities at any time.

利益冲突 Conflicts of Interest

J.P. Morgan Securities LLC 和 MUFG Securities Americas Inc. 各自的关联方均为我们 2024 年定期贷款融资项下的贷款人。如“募集资金用途”所述，本次发行的净收益将用于偿还我们 2024 年定期贷款融资项下的未偿借款，且由于偿还 2024 年定期贷款融资项下的借款，J.P. Morgan Securities LLC 和 MUFG Securities Americas Inc. 各自的关联方将获得本次发行净收益的 5% 或以上。因此，根据 FINRA 规则 5121，J.P. Morgan Securities LLC 和 MUFG Securities Americas Inc. 各自被视为存在“利益冲突”。据此，本次发行按照规则 5121 的要求进行，该规则要求（其中包括）“合格独立承销商”参与注册声明和本招股说明书的编制，并对其行使惯常的“尽职调查”标准。Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC 已同意担任本次发行的合格独立承销商，并承担《证券法》项下承销商的法律责任和义务，特别包括其第 11 条所固有的责任和义务。Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC 不会因担任与本次发行相关的合格独立承销商而收取任何额外费用。我们已同意就 Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC 因担任合格独立承销商而产生的责任（包括《证券法》项下的责任）向其作出赔偿。J.P. Morgan Securities LLC 和 MUFG Securities Americas Inc. 各自在未获得账户持有人明确书面批准的情况下，不会向其行使自由裁量权的任何账户确认任何销售。更多信息请参见“募集资金用途”。

An affiliate of each of J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc. is a lender under our 2024 Term Loan Facility. As described in “Use of Proceeds,” net proceeds from this offering will be used to repay outstanding borrowings under our 2024 Term Loan Facility, and an affiliate of each of J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc. will receive 5% or more of the net proceeds of this offering due to the repayment of borrowings under the 2024 Term Loan Facility. Therefore, each of J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc. is deemed to have a “conflict of interest” under FINRA Rule 5121. Accordingly, this offering is being conducted in compliance with the requirements of Rule 5121, which requires, among other things, that a “qualified independent underwriter” participate in the preparation of, and exercise the usual standards of “due diligence” with respect to, the registration statement and this prospectus. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC has agreed to act as a qualified independent underwriter for this offering and to undertake the legal responsibilities and liabilities of an underwriter under the Securities Act, specifically including those inherent in Section 11 thereof. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC will not receive any additional fees for serving as a qualified independent underwriter in connection with this offering. We have agreed to indemnify Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC against liabilities incurred in connection with acting as a qualified independent underwriter, including liabilities under the Securities Act. Each of J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc. will not confirm any sales to any account over which it exercises discretionary authority without the specific written approval of the account holder. See “Use of Proceeds” for additional information.

In addition, in the ordinary course of their various business activities, the underwriters and their respective affiliates may make or hold a broad array of investments and actively trade debt and equity securities (or related derivative securities) and financial instruments (including bank loans) for their own account and for the accounts of their customers and may at any time hold long and short positions in such securities and instruments. Such investment and securities activities may involve our securities and instruments. The underwriters and their respective affiliates may also make investment recommendations or publish or express independent research views in respect of such securities or instruments and may at any time hold, or recommend to clients that they acquire, long or short positions in such securities and instruments.

发行定价 Pricing of the Offering

在本次发行之前，我们的 A 类普通股不存在公开市场。首次公开发行价格由我们与承销商代表协商确定。在确定首次公开发行价格时考虑的因素包括：我们的前景以及我们所处行业的整体前景、我们近期的销售额、盈利及某些其他财务和经营信息，以及从事与我们类似业务的公司的市盈率、市销率、证券市场价格及某些财务和经营信息。

Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. The initial public offering price was determined by negotiations between us and the representatives. Among the factors considered in determining the initial public offering price were our prospects and those of our industry in general, our sales, earnings, and certain other financial and operating information in recent periods, and the price-earnings ratios, price-sales ratios, market prices of securities, and certain financial and operating information of companies engaged in activities similar to ours.

LLC 及其关联方按本公司指示通过定向股份计划进行。在定向股份计划中向已签署上述锁定协议的董事或高管出售的任何股份，均受该等锁定协议条款约束。若该等人士购买上述预留股份，则向公众发售的 A 类普通股数量将相应减少。未被如此购买的任何预留股份，将由承销商按与本招股说明书所发售其他股份相同的基础向公众发售。

- 与 RSM 在任何会计原则或实务、财务报表披露或审计范围或程序事项上的“分歧”(定义见 S-K 条例第 304(a)(1)(iv)项及其相关指示)，若该等分歧未能按其满意的方式解决，将导致 RSM 在其意见中提及该分歧所涉事项。

- no “disagreements” (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instructions thereto) with RSM on any matter of accounting principles or practices, financial statement disclosure, or auditing scope or procedure, which disagreements, if not resolved to its satisfaction, would have caused RSM to make reference in connection with its opinion to the subject matter of the disagreement.

- 不存在 S-K 条例第 304(a)(1)(v)项及其相关指示所定义的“应报告事件”，但财务报告内部控制存在重大缺陷除外，该缺陷与我们会计、财务和运营职能中缺乏足够数量、具备适当专业水平的人员有关，这些人员应能提供合理保证，确保交易得到适当记录和披露。

- no “reportable events” as such term is defined in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K and the related instructions thereto other than the material weakness in the internal control over financial reporting relating to a lack of sufficient number of qualified personnel within our accounting, finance, and operations functions who possessed an appropriate level of expertise to provide reasonable assurance that transactions were being appropriately recorded and disclosed.

我们已向 RSM 提供上述披露内容的副本，并要求 RSM 向我们提供一封致 SEC 的信函，说明其是否同意我们上述陈述，如不同意，则说明其不同意的方面。RSM 日期为 2024 年 12 月 16 日的信函副本已作为附件 16.1 提交至本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明。

在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2022 年 12 月 31 日的各年度内，以及截至 2024 年 6 月 4 日的期间内，我们或任何代表我们行事的人均未就涉及将会计原则应用于特定交易（无论已完成或拟议）、可能对我们财务报表出具的审计意见类型，或属于 Regulation S-K 第 304(a)(1)(iv) 项及其相关指示所称“分歧”的任何其他事项，或属于 Regulation S-K 第 304(a)(1)(v) 项及其相关指示所称“应报告事件”的任何其他事项，与 Deloitte 进行过咨询。

During the years ended December 31, 2023 and December 31, 2022, and through the period ended June 4, 2024, neither we, nor anyone acting on our behalf, consulted with Deloitte on matters that involved the application of accounting principles to a specified transaction, either completed or proposed, the type of audit opinion that might be rendered on our financial statements, or any other matter that was the subject of a disagreement as that term is used in Item 304 (a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instructions to Item 304 of Regulation S-K or a reportable event as that term is used in Item 304(a)(1)(v) and the related instructions to Item 304 of Regulation S-K.

对财务报表的意见 Opinion on the Financial Statements

我们已审计了随附的 CoreWeave, Inc. 及其子公司（以下简称“公司”）截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日和 2023 年 12 月 31 日的合并资产负债表，以及截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止两年期间各年度的相关合并经营报表、综合亏损表、可赎回可转换优先股及股东权益赤字表和现金流量表，以及相关附注（统称为“财务报表”）。我们认为，财务报表在所有重大方面公允反映了公司截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日和 2023 年 12 月 31 日的财务状况，以及截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止两年期间各年度的经营成果和现金流量，符合美国公认会计原则。

We have audited the accompanying consolidated balance sheets of CoreWeave, Inc. and subsidiaries (the “Company”) as of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the related consolidated statements of operations, comprehensive loss, redeemable convertible preferred stock and stockholders’ deficit, and cash flows, for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2024, and the related notes (collectively referred to as the “financial statements”). In our opinion, the financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company as of December 31, 2024 and 2023, and the results of its operations and its cash flows for each of the two years in the period ended December 31, 2024, in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.

意见的依据 Basis for Opinion

这些财务报表由公司管理层负责。我们的责任是在审计的基础上对公司财务报表发表意见。我们是一家在美国公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）注册的会计师事务所，并须根据美国联邦证券法律以及美国证券交易委员会和 PCAOB 的适用规则和规定，对公司保持独立性。

These financial statements are the responsibility of the Company’s management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company’s financial statements based on our audits. We are a public accounting firm registered with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (PCAOB) and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.

我们按照 PCAOB 的标准开展审计。这些标准要求我们计划和执行审计，以就财务报表是否不存在因错误或舞弊导致的重大错报获取合理保证。公司无须对其财务报告内部控制进行审计，我们亦未受聘执行该审计。作为审计的一部分，我们须了解财务报告内部控制，但并非为对公司财务报告内部控制的有效性发表意见。因此，我们不发表此类意见。

We conducted our audits in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud. The Company is not required to have, nor were we engaged to perform, an audit of its internal control over financial reporting. As part of our audits, we are required to obtain an understanding of internal control over financial reporting but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of the Company’s internal control over financial reporting. Accordingly, we express no such opinion.

我们的审计包括执行程序以评估财务报表是否存在因错误或舞弊导致的重大错报风险，并执行应对这些风险的程序。此类程序包括在测试基础上检查有关财务报表中金额和披露的证据。我们的审计还包括评价管理层采用的会计原则和作出的重大估计，以及评价财务报表的整体列报。我们认为，我们的审计为我们的意见提供了合理基础。

Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. Such procedures included examining, on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the financial statements. Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the overall presentation of the financial statements. We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinion.

1. 概述及重要会计政策摘要 1. Overview and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

#### 组织与业务描述

#### Organization and Description of Business

CoreWeave, Inc. 及其子公司（“公司”或“CoreWeave”）最初于 2017 年作为特拉华州有限责任公司成立，随后于 2018 年转换为特拉华州公司。公司总部位于新泽西州利文斯顿。公司是一家现代云基础设施技术公司，提供 CoreWeave 云平台，该平台由专有软件和云服务组成，可提供大规模管理复杂 AI 基础设施所需的自动化和效率。此前，公司曾拥有区块链挖矿和管理服务业务，该业务已于 2022 年 9 月停止运营，公司在本合并财务报表中将其作为终止经营业务报告。更多信息请参阅附注 16——终止经营。

CoreWeave, Inc., together with its subsidiaries (the “Company” or “CoreWeave”), was originally formed as a Delaware limited liability company in 2017 and then converted to a Delaware corporation in 2018. The Company is headquartered in Livingston, New Jersey. The Company is a modern cloud infrastructure technology company which offers the CoreWeave Cloud Platform that consists of proprietary software and cloud services that deliver the automation and efficiency needed to manage complex AI infrastructure at scale. Previously, the Company had Blockchain Mining and Management Services business which ceased operations in September 2022 and the Company is reporting this as discontinued operations in these consolidated financial statements. Refer to Note 16—Discontinued Operations for additional information.

#### 列报基础与合并

#### Basis of Presentation and Consolidation

随附的合并财务报表已按照美国公认会计原则（“美国 GAAP”）编制，并包含公司及其全资和多数控股子公司的账目。所有公司间余额和交易已在合并中抵销。

The accompanying consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (“U.S. GAAP”) and include the accounts of the Company and its wholly and majority-owned subsidiaries. All intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated in consolidation.

公司在每项安排开始时确定，公司已投资或拥有其他可变利益的实体是否被视为可变利益实体（“VIE”）。被视为 VIE 的投资将进行评估，以确定公司是否为该 VIE 的主要受益人，若是，则需合并该实体。公司评估其是否 (1) 拥有主导对 VIE 经济绩效产生最重大影响活动的权力，以及 (2) 承担可能对 VIE 而言重大的损失义务或有权从 VIE 获得可能对 VIE 而言重大的利益。如果公司不是 VIE 的主要受益人，则该投资或其他可变利益按照适用的美国 GAAP 进行会计处理。

The Company determines at inception of each arrangement whether an entity in which the Company has made an investment or in which the Company has other variable interests is considered a variable interest entity (“VIE”). Investments that are considered VIEs are evaluated to determine whether the Company is the primary beneficiary of the VIE, in which case it would be required to consolidate the entity. The Company evaluates whether it has (1) the power to direct the activities that most significantly impact the VIE’s economic performance, and (2) the obligation to absorb losses or the right to receive benefits from the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE. If the Company is not the primary beneficiary of the VIE, the investment or other variable interest is accounted for in accordance with applicable U.S. GAAP.

如果实体不具备 VIE 的特征，则被视为投票权益实体（“VOE”）。当公司拥有多数股权并控制该实体的重大经营、财务和投资决策时，公司将合并该 VOE。

In circumstances where an entity does not have the characteristics of a VIE, it would be considered a voting interest entity (“VOE”). The Company would consolidate a VOE when the Company has a majority equity interest and has control over significant operating, financial, and investing decisions of the entity.

#### 股票拆分

#### Stock Split

2025 年 3 月 14 日，公司对其普通股和可赎回可转换优先股实施了二十比一的股票拆分。所有股份和每股信息均已追溯调整，以反映所有列报期间的股票拆分。

On March 14, 2025, the Company effected a twenty-for-one stock split of its common stock and redeemable convertible preferred stock. All share and per share information has been retroactively adjusted to reflect the stock split for all periods presented.

#### 估计的使用

#### Use of Estimates

按照美国 GAAP 编制合并财务报表要求公司作出估计和假设，这些估计和假设会影响合并财务报表及随附附注中报告的金额。实际结果可能与该等估计存在重大差异。重大估计包括金融资产和负债的公允价值；分配给财产和设备的可使用年限；经营租赁和融资租赁所采用的折现率；衍生工具和认股权证负债的估值；股权激励费用，包括公司普通股公允价值的确定；以及所得税会计处理，包括递延所得税资产的估值备抵和不确定税务状况的计量。公司定期复核假设以确保其持续相关且合理，尤其是在高度主观的领域。公司基于历史经验和管理层认为合理的假设作出估计。

The preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP requires the Company to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported in the consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates. Significant estimates include the fair value of financial assets and liabilities; useful lives assigned to property and equipment; the discount rates used for operating and finance leases; valuation of derivative and warrant liabilities; stock-based compensation, including the determination of the fair value of the Company’s common stock; and accounting for income taxes, including the valuation allowance on deferred tax assets and the measurement of uncertain tax positions. Assumptions are reviewed regularly to ensure they remain relevant and reasonable, particularly in areas of high subjectivity. The Company bases its estimates on historical experience and assumptions that management considers reasonable.

#### 外币

#### Foreign Currency

公司的报告货币为美元。公司境外子公司的功能货币为美元。

The reporting currency of the Company is the U.S. dollar. The functional currency of the Company’s foreign subsidiaries is the U.S. dollar.

以功能货币以外的货币计价的货币性资产和负债，按期末汇率重新计量为功能货币。重新计量产生的外币交易损益在合并经营报表中计入其他收入净额，且在所列报的任何期间均不重大。

Monetary assets and liabilities denominated in currencies other than the functional currency are remeasured to the functional currency at period-end exchange rates. Foreign currency transaction gains and losses resulting from remeasurement are recognized in other income, net in the consolidated statements of operations, and have not been material for any of the periods presented.

#### 风险集中

#### Concentration of Risk

公司面临某些风险和不确定性，主要由于信用风险集中、重要客户和供应商集中，可能对其业务、财务状况、经营成果或现金流量产生重大不利影响。

The Company is subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could have a material adverse effect on its business, financial condition, results of operations, or cash flows primarily due to concentration of credit risk, significant customers, and supplier concentration.

信用风险集中

Concentration of Credit Risk

可能使公司面临重大信用风险集中的金融工具主要包括现金、现金等价物、受限现金、应收账款和可交易证券。公司将现金、现金等价物、受限现金和可交易证券存放于主要位于美国的高质量金融机构，其构成和到期情况由公司定期监控。公司在正常经营过程中向客户授予信用，因而在客户未能还款时面临信用风险。公司未在该等账款中经历任何重大损失。

Financial instruments that potentially expose the Company to significant concentration of credit risk consist primarily of cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, accounts receivable, and marketable securities. The Company maintains its cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and marketable securities with high-quality financial institutions mainly in the United States, where the composition and maturities of which are regularly monitored by the Company. The Company grants credit to its customers in the normal course of business, exposing it to credit risk in the event of nonrepayment by customers. The Company has not experienced any material losses in such accounts.
