The Company recorded a loss related to the fair value adjustment of these warrant liabilities of $0 million, $67 million, and $129 million within loss on fair value adjustments in the consolidated statements of operations during the years ended December 31, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively.

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，普通认股权证的公允价值分别重新计量为 $71 million 和 $200 million。这些金额包含在合并资产负债表的衍生工具及认股权证负债中。

The fair values of the regular warrants were remeasured to $71 million and $200 million as of December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively. These amounts are included within derivative and warrant liabilities on the consolidated balance sheets.

第二次交割和第三次交割属于必须发行并提供资金的贷款承诺。与贷款承诺相关的费用最初予以资本化，并作为递延融资成本核算。随着这些交割完成，递延融资成本的相关部分被重新分类为已提取贷款部分的债务折扣，并摊销计入利息费用。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日，票据的账面价值为 $124 million，与公允价值大致相当。与前三笔交割相关发行的一分钱认股权证和普通认股权证按发行日公允价值 $6 million 和 $3 million 分别计入递延融资成本。

The Second Closing and the Third Closing were loan commitments that were required to be issued and funded. The fees associated with the loan commitment were initially capitalized and accounted for as deferred financing costs. As these closings were completed, the associated portions of the deferred financing costs were reclassified as the debt discount for the portion of the drawn loans and amortized to interest expense. As of December 31, 2023, the carrying value of the notes was $124 million, which approximates fair value. The penny warrants and regular warrants issued in connection with the first three closings were recorded as part of the deferred financing costs equal to their issuance date fair values of $6 million and $3 million, respectively.

第四次交割赋予贷款方一项选择权（而非义务），可购买本金金额最高达 $25 million 的票据及相应部分的便士认股权证和普通认股权证。该选择权在初始交割日作为衍生负债入账，构成 $1 million 贷款承诺递延融资成本的一部分。该书面选择权被重新计量至公允价值，直至 2023 年 4 月完成结算日，公司于截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度就公允价值变动确认了 $2 million 的损失。第四次交割结算时发行的票据、便士认股权证和普通认股权证初始按其各自公允价值 $22 million、$4 million 和 $2 million 入账。

The Fourth Closing provided the lenders the option, but not the obligation to purchase up to $25 million principal amount of notes and the associated portion of penny warrants and regular warrants. The option was accounted for as a derivative liability issued on the initial closing date, representing part of the deferred financing costs of $1 million for the loan commitments. The written option was remeasured to fair value through the settlement date completed in April 2023, and the Company recognized a loss for the change in fair value of $2 million during the year ended December 31, 2023. The notes, penny warrants, and regular warrants issued upon settlement of the Fourth Closing were initially recorded at their respective fair values of $22 million, $4 million, and $2 million, respectively.

2024 年 6 月，公司向贷款方发出通知，行使赎回 2022 年优先担保票据的选择权。2024 年 7 月，公司以 $137 million 的赎回价格（含提前还款溢价及应计未付利息）结算了票据的全部本金金额，产生 $6 million 的清偿损失，计入其他收入净额。

In June 2024, the Company issued notice to the lenders to exercise its option to redeem the 2022 Senior Secured Notes. In July 2024, the Company settled the entire principal amount of the notes for a redemption price of $137 million, inclusive of prepayment premium and accrued and unpaid interest, resulting in an extinguishment loss of $6 million, which is included in other income, net.

#### 延迟提取定期贷款

#### Delayed Draw Term Loans

延迟提取定期贷款融资 1.0

Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility 1.0

2023 年 7 月，公司子公司之一 CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. II, LLC（“CCAC II”）与多家贷款方及 U.S. Bank, N.A.（作为行政代理人和抵押代理人）签订了延迟提取定期贷款。该协议提供最高达 $2.3 billion 的延迟提取定期贷款融资（经修订，“DDTL 1.0 融资”）。DDTL 1.0 融资项下的借款用于为收购计算设备相关的部分购买对价、费用和开支提供资金。

In July 2023, one of the Company’s subsidiaries, CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. II, LLC (“CCAC II”), entered into a delayed draw term loan with various lenders and U.S. Bank, N.A., as the administrative and collateral agent. The agreement provides for a delayed draw term loan facility of up to $2.3 billion (as amended, the “DDTL 1.0 Facility”). Borrowings under the DDTL 1.0 Facility were used to finance a portion of the purchase consideration, fees, and expenses relating to the acquisition of computing equipment.

DDTL 1.0 融资包含限制公司和/或 CCAC II 产生或担保额外债务；支付股息及进行其他分配或回购股票；进行某些投资；设立或产生留置权；出售资产；与关联方进行某些交易；以及合并、整合或转让或出售其全部或绝大部分资产的能力的契约。

The DDTL 1.0 Facility contains covenants that restrict the ability of the Company and/or CCAC II to incur or guarantee additional indebtedness; pay dividends and make other distributions or repurchase stock; make certain investments; create or incur liens; sell assets; enter into certain transactions with affiliates; and merge, consolidate or transfer or sell all or substantially all of its assets.

DDTL 1.0 融资项下的全部义务由公司无条件担保。DDTL 1.0 融资项下的未偿义务由以下各项的完善的第一优先质押和担保权益担保：(i) 其直接母公司持有的 CCAC II 股权，以及 (ii) CCAC II 的绝大部分资产。

All obligations under the DDTL 1.0 Facility are unconditionally guaranteed by the Company. Obligations outstanding under the DDTL 1.0 Facility are secured by perfected first priority pledges of and security interests in (i) the equity interests of CCAC II held by its direct parent and (ii) substantially all of the assets of CCAC II.

DDTL 1.0 融资项下未偿借款的利息按年利率计息，由公司选择，等于 Term SOFR 加 8.75% 或替代基准利率加 7.75%。2024 年 5 月 15 日，利率被修改为 Term SOFR 加 9.62% 或替代基准利率加 8.62%。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，DDTL 1.0 融资项下借款金额实际适用的平均利率分别为 14.12% 和 14.11%。

Interest on outstanding borrowings on the DDTL 1.0 Facility accrues at a rate per annum equal to either, at the Company’s election, Term SOFR plus 8.75% or the alternative base rate plus 7.75%. On May 15, 2024, the interest rate was modified to Term SOFR plus 9.62% or the alternative base rate plus 8.62%. As of December 31, 2023, and 2024, the actual average interest rate being charged on the amounts borrowed against the DDTL 1.0 Facility was 14.12% and 14.11%, respectively.

在整个 2023 年和 2024 年期间，公司依据 23 亿美元的融资承诺进行了借款。贷款本金须按季度分期偿还，最后一笔气球付款于 2028 年 3 月 28 日到期。公司可选择在任何时间、不时提前偿还贷款，且在发生违约事件或公司控制权变更时，或使用某些资产处置所得款项或发生债务融资时，须强制提前偿还。若贷款在贷款承诺终止日第四周年之前提前偿还，除本金和应计利息外，公司还须支付适用的溢价，金额为：(a) 对于在贷款承诺终止日第三周年之前进行的提前偿还，按现行利率计算的、自提前偿还日至贷款承诺终止日第三周年期间本应就所提前偿还贷款本金累计的未来利息付款的现值，加上所提前偿还贷款本金的 1.00%；或 (b) 对于在贷款承诺终止日第三周年至第四周年之间进行的提前偿还，金额等于所提前偿还贷款本金的 1.00%。

Throughout 2023 and 2024, the Company borrowed against the $2.3 billion facility commitment. The principal amount of the loans is required to be repaid in quarterly installments, with the final balloon payment due on March 28, 2028. The loans are prepayable at any time, from time to time, at the Company’s option, and are required to be prepaid upon the occurrence of an event of default or change of control of the Company, or with the proceeds of certain asset dispositions or incurrence of indebtedness. If the loans are prepaid prior to the fourth anniversary of the loan commitment termination date, in addition to principal and accrued interest, the Company is required to pay an applicable premium equal to (a) with respect to prepayments made prior to the third anniversary of the loan commitment termination date, the present value of future interest payments that would have accrued on the principal amount of the loans being prepaid through the third anniversary of the loan commitment termination date based on the interest rate in effect plus 1.00% of the principal amount of the loans being prepaid or (b) with respect to prepayments made between the third and fourth anniversary of the loan commitment termination date, an amount equal to 1.00% of the principal amount of the loans being prepaid.

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，DDTL 1.0 融资安排项下的未偿金额分别为 $1.4 billion 和 $2.0 billion。公司在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内分别发生递延融资成本 $12 million，并分别记录债务折价 $24 million 和 $22 million。该等成本在合并资产负债表上作为未偿债务余额的减项予以资本化，并在 DDTL 1.0 融资安排的期限内摊销计入利息费用。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，债务发行成本及债务折价的摊销额分别为 $2 million 和 $20 million。

As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, the amounts outstanding were $1.4 billion and $2.0 billion, respectively, under the DDTL 1.0 Facility. The Company incurred deferred financing costs of $12 million and recorded debt discounts of $24 million and $22 million for the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively. These costs are capitalized as a reduction to the outstanding debt balance on the consolidated balance sheets and are being amortized to interest expense over the term of the DDTL 1.0 Facility. Amortization of debt issuance costs and debt discounts was $2 million and $20 million for the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively.

公司须维持相当于已提取余额 16.00% 的限制性现金，截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日合计 220 百万美元。2024 年 5 月，在修订利率的同时，限制性现金要求降至已提取余额的 4.00%，但流动性要求在任何情况下均不得超过 56 百万美元。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，与该协议相关的限制性现金为 56 百万美元。

The Company was required to maintain restricted cash equal to 16.00% of the drawn balance, totaling $220 million as of December 31, 2023. In May 2024, in conjunction with the amendment to the interest rate, the restricted cash requirement was reduced to 4.00% of the drawn balance, but in no event can the liquidity requirement be greater than $56 million. As of December 31, 2024, $56 million was restricted cash in relation to this agreement.

延迟提取定期贷款融资安排 2.0

Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility 2.0

2024 年 5 月，公司子公司之一 CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. IV, LLC（“CCAC IV”）与多家贷款方及 U.S. Bank, N.A.（作为行政代理人和抵押代理人）签订了第二份协议。该协议提供另一项最高达 $7.6 billion 的延迟提取定期贷款融资（经修订，简称“DDTL 2.0 融资”）。该协议项下的借款主要用于为履行客户合同所需的资本支出提供资金，包括购置 GPU 服务器及相关基础设施。

In May 2024, one of the Company’s subsidiaries, CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. IV, LLC (“CCAC IV”) entered into a second agreement with various lenders and U.S. Bank, N.A., as the administrative and collateral agent. The agreement provides for another delayed draw term loan facility of up to $7.6 billion (as amended, the “DDTL 2.0 Facility”). Borrowings under this agreement were established to primarily finance capital expenditures necessary to fulfill customer contracts, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure.

根据 DDTL 2.0 融资安排，可在 2025 年 6 月之前提取额外贷款，并可在贷款人同意的情况下选择将承诺期延长三个月。可提供的贷款总额受限于贷款所融资资产的购买价格，该百分比基于 GPU 服务器的可折旧成本计算。

Under the DDTL 2.0 Facility, additional loans may be drawn until June 2025, with an option to extend the commitment period by three months subject to lender consent. The total loans available are constrained by the purchase price of assets for which the loans are being used to finance with such percentage based upon the depreciable cost of GPU servers.

公司在 DDTL 2.0 融资安排下的所有义务均由公司无条件担保。DDTL 2.0 融资安排下的未偿义务由以下各项的完善第一优先质押和担保权益担保：(i) 其直接母公司持有的 CCAC IV 股权权益，以及 (ii) CCAC IV 的绝大部分资产。

All obligations under the DDTL 2.0 Facility are unconditionally guaranteed by the Company. Obligations outstanding under the DDTL 2.0 Facility are secured by perfected first priority pledges of and security interests in (i) the equity interests of CCAC IV held by its direct parent and (ii) substantially all of the assets of CCAC IV.

DDTL 2.0 融资安排包含限制公司和/或 CCAC IV 以下能力的契约：产生或担保额外债务；支付股息及进行其他分配或回购股票；进行某些投资；设立或产生留置权；出售资产；与关联方进行某些交易；以及合并、整合或转让或出售其全部或绝大部分资产。

The DDTL 2.0 Facility contains covenants that restrict the ability of the Company and/or CCAC IV to incur or guarantee additional indebtedness; pay dividends and make other distributions or repurchase stock; make certain investments; create or incur liens; sell assets; enter into certain transactions with affiliates; and merge, consolidate or transfer or sell all or substantially all of its assets.

DDTL 2.0 融资安排下未偿借款的利息按年利率计算，利率由公司选择为 Term SOFR 或替代基准利率，加上基于相关客户合同信用质量的利差。对于特定投资级客户，Term SOFR 计价贷款的利差为 6.00%，基准利率计价贷款的利差为 5.00%。对于投资级客户，Term SOFR 贷款的利差为 6.50%，基准利率贷款的利差为 5.50%。对于非投资级客户合同，Term SOFR 贷款的利差为 13.00%，基准利率贷款的利差为 12.00%。

Interest on outstanding borrowings on the DDTL 2.0 Facility accrues at a rate per annum equal to either, at the Company’s election, Term SOFR or the alternative base rate plus a spread based on the credit quality of the associated customer contracts. For specified investment-grade customers, the spread is equal to 6.00% for Term SOFR denominated loans and 5.00% for base rate denominated loans. For investment-grade customers, the spread is equal to 6.50% for Term SOFR loans and 5.50% for base rate loans. For non-investment-grade customer contracts, the spread is equal to 13.00% for Term SOFR loans and 12.00% for base rate loans.

贷款本金须自 2025 年 10 月起按季度分期偿还，最后一笔气球付款于相关贷款发放后满五年时到期。贷款可由公司选择随时、不时提前偿还，并在发生违约事件或公司控制权变更，或产生某些债务时须强制提前偿还。如贷款在贷款承诺终止日满 30 个月之前提前偿还，除本金和应计利息外，公司还须支付相当于按现行利率计算至贷款承诺终止日满 30 个月期间本应计息的未来利息付款现值的适用溢价。

The principal amount of the loans is required to be repaid in quarterly installments, beginning in October 2025, with the final balloon payment due on five years after the applicable loan was funded. The loans are prepayable at any time, from time to time, at the Company’s option and are required to be prepaid upon the occurrence of an event of default or change of control of the Company, or incurrence of certain indebtedness. If the loans are prepaid prior to the 30-month anniversary of the loan commitment termination date, in addition to principal and accrued interest, the Company is required to pay an applicable premium equal to the present value of future interest payments that would have accrued through the 30-month anniversary of the loan commitment termination date based on the interest rate in effect.

截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，DDTL 2.0 融资机制项下借款实际适用的平均利率为 10.53%，借款总额为 $3.8 billion。公司就 DDTL 2.0 融资机制的发行发生了 $3 million 的递延融资成本，并记录了 $58 million 的债务折价。该等成本在合并资产负债表上作为未偿债务余额的减项予以资本化，并在 DDTL 2.0 融资机制的期限内摊销计入利息费用。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，债务发行成本及债务折价的摊销额为 $5 million。公司须维持相当于已提取余额 2.00% 的限制性现金，截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日合计为 $77 million。此外，截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司发生了合计 $4 million 的未提取费用，该费用在合并经营报表中计入利息费用净额。

As of December 31, 2024, the actual average interest rate being charged on the amounts borrowed against the DDTL 2.0 Facility was 10.53% and the total amount borrowed was $3.8 billion. The Company incurred deferred financing costs of $3 million and recorded debt discounts of $58 million related to the issuance of the DDTL 2.0 Facility. These costs are capitalized as a reduction to the outstanding debt balance on the consolidated balance sheets and are being amortized to interest expense over the term of the DDTL 2.0 Facility. Amortization of debt issuance costs and debt discounts was $5 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. The Company is required to maintain restricted cash equal to 2.00% of the drawn balance, totaling $77 million as of December 31, 2024. Additionally, the Company incurred undrawn fees totaling $4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, which is recognized in interest expense, net in the consolidated statements of operations.

#### 循环信贷融资

#### Revolving Credit Facility

2024 年 6 月 21 日，公司与 JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 签订信贷协议，由其担任行政代理人和担保代理人。该信贷协议于 2027 年 6 月 21 日到期。该信贷协议最初提供 $100 million 的高级循环信贷融资。2024 年 10 月 7 日，该信贷协议经修订，额度调整为 $650 million，包括 (i) $500 million 的有担保融资和 (ii) $150 million 的无担保融资，以支持公司数据中心基础设施及 AI 驱动的云计算业务的扩张。2024 年 12 月 2 日，该信贷协议经进一步修订，规定 $650 million 高级循环信贷融资为全额有担保（“循环信贷融资”）。循环信贷融资包括 $175 million 的信用证子融资。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司尚未提取循环信贷融资项下的款项。

On June 21, 2024, the Company entered into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent and collateral agent. The credit agreement matures on June 21, 2027. The credit agreement originally provided for a $100 million senior revolving credit facility. On October 7, 2024, the credit agreement was amended to have a capacity of $650 million consisting of (i) a $500 million secured facility and (ii) a $150 million unsecured facility to support the expansion of the Company’s data center infrastructure and AI-driven cloud computing operations. On December 2, 2024, the credit agreement was further amended to provide for the $650 million senior revolving credit facility to be fully secured (the “Revolving Credit Facility”). The Revolving Credit Facility includes a $175 million letter of credit sub-facility. As of December 31, 2024, the Company had not drawn on the Revolving Credit Facility.

公司循环信贷融资项下的借款按年利率计息，由公司选择：(a) 对于基准利率贷款，适用利差为 0.75% 加基准利率（下限为 1.00%），该基准利率参照以下各项中的最高者确定：(i) 最优惠利率；(ii) (a) 联邦基金有效利率与 (b) 隔夜银行融资利率中的较高者，在每种情况下均加 0.50%；以及 (iii) 一个月期限的有担保隔夜融资利率（“SOFR”）加 1.00%；或 (b) 对于期限基准贷款，适用利差为 1.75% 加一个月、三个月或六个月计息期的期限 SOFR（下限为 0.00%）。此外，公司须就平均未提取承诺额按年支付 0.25% 的费用。公司可随时自愿提前偿还循环信贷融资项下的未偿贷款，无需支付溢价或罚金。

Amounts borrowed under the Company’s Revolving Credit Facility are subject to an interest rate per annum equal to, at the Company’s option, either (a) for base rate loans, an applicable margin of 0.75% plus a base rate (subject to a 1.00% floor) determined by reference to the highest of (i) the prime rate, (ii) the greater of (a) the federal funds effective rate and (b) the overnight bank funding rate, in each case, plus 0.50%, and (iii) the one month term Secured Overnight Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 1.00% or (b) for term benchmark loans, an applicable margin of 1.75% plus the term SOFR (subject to a 0.00% floor) for a one, three or six month interest period. Additionally, the Company is required to pay a fee of 0.25% per annum on the average undrawn commitment. The Company may voluntarily prepay outstanding loans under its Revolving Credit Facility at any time without premium or penalty.

#### 2024 年定期贷款融资

#### 2024 Term Loan Facility

2024 年 12 月，公司与相关方签订了一份信贷协议，设立了一项金额为$1.0 billion 的定期贷款融资（“2024 年定期贷款融资”），该融资由(i)一笔$229 million 的有担保融资和(ii)一笔$771 million 的无担保融资组成。2024 年 12 月 16 日，公司提取了该协议项下可用的全部$1.0 billion 贷款。该定期贷款融资的所得款项可用于营运资金及一般公司用途（包括为收购和投资提供融资）。

In December 2024, the Company entered into a credit agreement providing for a $1.0 billion term loan facility (the “2024 Term Loan Facility”) consisting of (i) a $229 million secured facility and (ii) a $771 million unsecured facility. On December 16, 2024, the Company borrowed the full $1.0 billion of loans available under the agreement. The proceeds from the term loan facility may be used for working capital and general corporate purposes (including the financing of acquisitions and investments).

公司就发行 2024 年定期贷款融资产生了 $16 的递延融资成本。该等成本在合并资产负债表上作为“债务，流动”项下未偿债务余额的减项予以资本化，并在 2024 年定期贷款融资的期限内摊销计入利息费用。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，未摊销的递延融资成本为 $15。

The Company incurred deferred financing costs related to the issuance of the 2024 Term Loan Facility of $16 million. These costs are capitalized as a reduction to the outstanding debt balance within Debt, current on the consolidated balance sheets and are being amortized to interest expense over the term of the 2024 Term Loan Facility. As of December 31, 2024, the unamortized deferred financing costs were $15 million.

2024 年定期贷款融资于 2025 年 12 月 16 日到期。公司可随时、不时地自行选择提前还款，或在发生违约事件时，或以某些资产处置、债务发生或股权发行的所得款项提前还款，包括须以首次公开发行的部分或全部所得款项进行提前还款的要求。定期贷款融资项下借入的款项按年利率计息，由公司选择，利率等于 (a) 期限 SOFR 加前 180 天 5.25%、随后 90 天 5.75%、2024 年定期贷款融资剩余期限内 6.25%，或 (b) 替代基准利率（如前所述）加前 180 天 4.25%、随后 90 天 4.75%、2024 年定期贷款融资剩余期限内 5.25%。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，2024 年定期贷款融资项下借入款项的实际适用利率为 9.65%。2024 年定期贷款融资包含惯常的肯定性和否定性契约。

The 2024 Term Loan Facility matures December 16, 2025. The Company may prepay at any time, from time to time, at its option, upon the occurrence of an event of default, or with the proceeds of certain asset dispositions, incurrences of indebtedness or equity issuances, including a requirement to be prepaid with some or all of the proceeds of an initial public offering. Amounts borrowed under the term loan facility are subject to an interest rate per annum equal to, at the Company’s option, either (a) Term SOFR plus 5.25% for the first 180 days, 5.75% for the next 90 days, and 6.25% for the remainder of the term of the 2024 Term Loan Facility or (b) the alternative base rate (as described previously) plus 4.25% for the first 180 days, 4.75% for the next 90 days, and 5.25% for the remainder of the term of the 2024 Term Loan Facility. As of December 31, 2024, the actual interest rate being charged on the amounts borrowed against the 2024 Term Loan Facility was 9.65%. The 2024 Term Loan Facility contains customary affirmative and negative covenants.

#### OEM 融资安排

#### OEM Financing Arrangements

本公司与一家原始设备制造商（OEM）于 2024 年 2 月至 12 月期间签订了多项协议，据此本公司就若干设备取得融资，截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，该等设备的合计名义余额为 $1.3 billion。就该等融资协议，本公司为所融资设备授予了担保权益。该等协议作为融资安排进行会计处理，期限为两至三年。该等融资安排在期限内设有明确的还款计划，实际利率介于 9% 至 11% 之间。本公司未就该等融资安排发生任何债务发行费用。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的利息费用为 $60 million。

The Company entered into various agreements with an OEM between February and December 2024 whereby the Company obtained financing for certain equipment with an aggregate notional balance of $1.3 billion as of December 31, 2024. Related to the financing agreements, the Company granted a security interest for the financed equipment. The agreements are accounted for as financing arrangements, with terms between two to three years. The financing arrangements have a stated repayment schedule over the term with effective interest rates between 9% to 11%. The Company did not incur any debt issuance costs associated with the financing arrangements. Interest expense for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $60 million.

#### DCSP 融资安排

#### DCSP Financing Arrangements

2023 年 6 月，本公司与一家数据中心服务提供商（以下简称“DCSP”）签订了服务协议（以下简称“DCSP 服务协议”）。根据 DCSP 服务协议，DCSP 将设计、采购、建设并管理一座数据中心，分阶段提供最高 78 MW 的电力接入。此外，在截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，本公司购买了 116 百万美元的关键基础设施资产以支持该数据中心场地（以下简称“现有关键基础设施资产”）。

In June 2023, the Company entered into a service agreement with a data center service provider (the “DCSP”) (the “DCSP Service Agreement”). Under the DCSP Service Agreement, the DCSP will design, purchase, build, and manage a data center providing access to up to 78 MW of electrical power to be delivered in phases. Separately, during the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company purchased $116 million of critical infrastructure assets to support the data center site (the “Existing Critical Infrastructure Assets”).

2024 年 10 月，本公司作为贷款方，与 DCSP 签订了高级担保延迟提款定期贷款信贷协议（以下简称“应收票据”，连同 DCSP 服务协议合称“DCSP 融资安排”），以促进关键基础设施资产的购买。应收票据协议约定总承诺额度最高为 305 百万美元的延迟提款定期贷款融资，期限为七年，约定年利率为 13.00%。本公司就应收票据的发行发生了不重大的费用。

In October 2024, the Company, as a lender, entered into a Senior Secured Delayed Draw Term Loan Credit Agreement (the “Note Receivable”, and collectively, with the DCSP Service Agreement, the “DCSP Financing Arrangements”) with the DCSP to facilitate the purchase of critical infrastructure assets. The Note Receivable agreement provides for a total commitment of up to $305 million in delayed draw term loan funding for a term of seven years with a stated interest rate of 13.00% per annum. The Company incurred an immaterial amount of fees in conjunction with the issuance of the Note Receivable.

应收票据以支持数据中心当前及未来各阶段建设的新建及现有关键基础设施资产作为担保，DCSP 可随时提前还款且无需支付罚金。

The Note Receivable is secured by the new and existing critical infrastructure assets that support current and future phases of the build out at the data center and is prepayable at any time by the DCSP with no penalty.

在截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，DCSP 根据应收票据借款，用于结清本公司此前向 DCSP 垫付的款项、为购买额外关键基础设施资产提供资金以及购买现有关键基础设施资产。根据 DCSP 服务协议的条款，本公司继续控制现有关键基础设施资产，并就已收到的现有关键基础设施资产对价确认了一项融资义务。该融资义务期限为 14 年，隐含利率为 15%。现有关键基础设施资产计入合并资产负债表中的物业及设备净额，并按预计可使用年限计提折旧。

During the year ended December 31, 2024, the DCSP borrowed under the Note Receivable to settle amounts previously advanced to the DCSP by the Company, finance purchases of additional critical infrastructure assets, and purchase the Existing Critical Infrastructure Assets. Under the terms of the DCSP Service Agreement, the Company continues to control the Existing Critical Infrastructure Assets and the Company recorded a financing obligation related to the consideration received for the Existing Critical Infrastructure Assets. The financing obligation is payable over a term of 14 years and has an imputed interest rate of 15%. The Existing Critical Infrastructure Assets are included in property and equipment, net, on the consolidated balance sheets and are depreciated over their estimated useful life.

In April 2023, the Company authorized a total of 79,978,760 shares of Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock, with a par value of $0.000005 per share and an original issue price of $5.58 per share, pursuant to an amendment of the certificate of incorporation. Additionally, the Company issued a total of 12,484,540 shares of Series B-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock, with a par value of $0.000005 per share to settle the outstanding principal and interest balance of the 2021 Unsecured Senior Subordinated Convertible Promissory Notes based on a conversion price, equal to the original issue price of $0.40 per share. Refer to Note 10—Debt for additional information.

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司发行了 75,495,640 股 B 类可赎回可转换优先股，总募集资金为 $421 million。在首次发行时，公司向领投方（关联方）授予了一项选择权，可在最长九个月内按每股 $5.58 的原始发行价购买最多 40,348,040 股 B 类可赎回可转换优先股。B 类分批负债须确认为负债，因为其代表一项购买可赎回权益的合同。首次发行所得款项的一部分被分配至该负债的初始确认。该负债其后按公允价值重新计量，公允价值变动在结算日前的损益中确认。2023 年 5 月，因行使 B 类分批负债的一部分而发行了 35,864,920 股 B 类可赎回可转换优先股。2024 年 1 月，因行使 B 类分批负债的剩余部分而发行了 4,483,120 股 B 类可赎回可转换优先股。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度和截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司就 B 类分批负债的重新计量分别确认了 $105 million 的公允价值调整损失和并无重大收益或损失。

During the year ended December 31, 2023, the Company issued 75,495,640 shares of Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock for total gross proceeds of $421 million. At the time of the initial issuance, the Company granted an option to the lead investor, a related party, to purchase up to 40,348,040 shares of Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock over a period of up to nine months, at the original issuance price of $5.58 per share. The Series B tranche liability was required to be recognized as a liability as it represented a contract to purchase redeemable equity. A portion of the proceeds of the original issuance was allocated to the initial recognition of the liability. The liability was subsequently remeasured to fair value with changes in fair value recognized in earnings through the settlement date. In May 2023, 35,864,920 shares of Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock were issued upon exercise of the portion of the Series B tranche liability. In January 2024, 4,483,120 shares of Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock were issued upon exercise of the remaining portion of the Series B tranche liability. For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, the Company recognized a fair value adjustment loss of $105 million and no material gain or loss, respectively, on the remeasurement of the Series B tranche liability.

2024 年 5 月，公司发行了 29,523,120 股 C 类可赎回可转换优先股，每股面值为 $0.000005，原始发行价为每股 $38.95，总募集资金为 $1.1 billion，并发生了 $3 million 的相关发行费用。

In May 2024, the Company issued 29,523,120 shares of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock with a par value of $0.000005 per share and an original issue price of $38.95 per share for total gross proceeds of $1.1 billion and incurred related issuance costs of $3 million.

可赎回可转换优先股的持有人享有以下权利、优先权和特权：

The holders of the redeemable convertible preferred stock have the following rights, preferences, and privileges:

投票权

Voting

除法律或公司章程另有规定外，可赎回可转换优先股的持有人拥有完全的投票权，等同于普通股持有人按转换后基准享有的投票权。除法律或公司章程另有规定外，优先股股东作为一个单一类别共同投票。

Except as provided by law or by the Company’s certificate of incorporation, the holders of redeemable convertible preferred stock have full voting rights, equivalent to the voting rights of holders of common stock, as if converted. The preferred stockholders vote together as a single class, except as provided by law or by the Company’s certificate of incorporation.

股息

Dividends

可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权按转换后基准参与向普通股持有人分配的任何股息。

Holders of the redeemable convertible preferred stock are entitled to participate in any dividends distributed to holders of common stock, as if converted.

C 轮可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权获得按累计设定价值（初始为每股 $38.95）以每年 10% 的比率逐日计提的累积股息。累积股息按季度支付，可以现金支付，也可以通过计入累计设定价值优先额的方式以实物支付。C 轮可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权在支付任何其他股息之前优先获得累积股息。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司共支付现金股息 $59 million，并按公允价值确认实物支付（PIK）股息共计 $16 million。PIK 股息支付使 C 轮可赎回优先股的累计设定价值增加 $14 million，该金额等同于本应以现金支付的金额。该增加的价值将用于计算未来各季度应付股息。

Holders of the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock are entitled to a cumulative dividend that accrues from day-to-day at a rate of 10% per annum of the accumulated stated value, which is initially equal to $38.95 per share. Cumulative dividends are payable quarterly and can be paid in cash, or paid in kind by being added to the accumulated stated value preference. The holders of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock are entitled to receive the cumulative dividends prior and in preference to the payment of any other dividend. For the year ending December 31, 2024, the Company paid a total cash dividend of $59 million and a total PIK dividend, recognized at fair value, of $16 million. The PIK dividend payment increased the accumulated stated value of the Series C Redeemable Preferred Stock by $14 million, which is equivalent to the amount that would have been paid in cash. This increased value will be used to calculate future quarterly dividends payable.

转换

Conversion

每股可赎回可转换优先股可由持有人选择随时转换为 A 类普通股。转换比率通过将原始发行价（就 C 轮而言，为累计设定价值加上已计提未支付股息（不重复计算））除以转换时的转换价格确定，转换价格初始等于原始发行价，并须按惯例因股票拆分、股息及其他适用公司事件进行反稀释调整。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日，每股可赎回可转换优先股可转换为一股 A 类普通股。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，每股种子轮、A 轮、B 轮和 B-1 轮可赎回可转换优先股可转换为一股 A 类普通股，每股 C 轮可赎回可转换优先股可转换为 1.0119 股 A 类普通股。

Each share of redeemable convertible preferred stock is convertible at any time at the election of the holder into Class A common stock. The conversion rate is determined by dividing the original issue price, or in the case of the Series C, the accumulated stated value plus accrued and unpaid dividends (without double counting), by the conversion price at the time of conversion, with the conversion price initially equal to the original issue price, subject to customary anti-dilutive adjustments for stock splits, dividends, and other applicable corporate events. As of December 31, 2023, each share of redeemable convertible preferred stock was convertible into one share of Class A common stock. As of December 31, 2024, each share of Series Seed, Series A, Series B and Series B-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock was convertible into one share of Class A common stock and each share of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock was convertible into 1.0119 shares of Class A common stock.

发生以下任一情形时，转换即为强制转换：(i) 首次公开发行（IPO），每股价格至少为 $6.97，且公司获得的募集资金净额（扣除承销折扣和佣金后）至少为 $125 million；或 (ii) 占多数的可赎回可转换优先股持有人作为单一类别共同投票作出选择，但前提是，就 B 轮可赎回可转换优先股而言，须获得当时流通的 B 轮可赎回可转换优先股至少 20% 持有人的同意；且如果是在视同清算事件（定义见公司章程）中，C 轮可赎回可转换优先股持有人将获得的每股对价低于累计设定价值，则就 C 轮可赎回可转换优先股而言，须获得当时流通的 C 轮可赎回可转换优先股至少 90% 持有人的同意。

Conversion is mandatory upon the occurrence of either: (i) an IPO at a price per share of at least $6.97 resulting in at least $125 million in proceeds to the Company, net of underwriting discount and commissions, or (ii) the election by the holders of a majority of the redeemable convertible preferred stock, voting together as a single class, provided that the consent of holders of at least 20% of the then-outstanding Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock is required with respect to the Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock, and the consent of holders of at least 90% of the then-outstanding Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock is required with respect to the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock if in connection with a Deemed Liquidation Event (as defined in the Company’s certificate of incorporation) in which the holders of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock will receive consideration per share that is less than the accumulated stated value.

清算优先权

Liquidation Preference

在公司发生任何自愿或非自愿清算、解散或停业清算，或任何视同清算事件（包括合并或整合）时，(i)首先，在向次级优先股或普通股持有人支付任何款项之前，C 系列可赎回可转换优先股持有人有权从可供分配的可用资金中获得支付；(ii)其次，B 系列合并优先股（B 系列、B-1 系列）持有人有权从可供分配的可用资金中获得支付；(iii)再次，次级优先股（种子轮系列、A 系列）持有人有权从可供分配的可用资金中获得支付；且若公司未在此类交易完成后的 90 天内赎回可赎回可转换优先股，则该等优先股持有人可选择赎回其股份。持有人有权获得以下两者中的较高者：(x)该等股份的原始发行价，且对于 C 系列可赎回可转换优先股，为累计设定价值加上已计提但未支付股息，或 (y)若全部可赎回可转换优先股在清算前立即转换后本应支付的每股金额。

In the event of any voluntary or involuntary liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of the Company, or any Deemed Liquidation Event (including mergers or consolidations), (i) first, holders of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock are entitled to be paid out of any funds available for distribution, (ii) then, holders of Combined Series B Preferred Stock (Series B, Series B-1) are entitled to be paid out of any funds available for distribution, (iii) then, holders of Junior Preferred Stock (Series Seed, Series A) are entitled to be paid out of any funds available for distribution, and the holders of redeemable convertible preferred stock may elect to redeem their shares in the event the shares are not redeemed by the Company within 90 days of the consummation of such transactions, before any payments are made to holders of Junior Preferred Stock or common stock. Holders are entitled to the greater of: (x) the original issue price of such shares and in the case of the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock, the accumulated stated value plus accrued and unpaid dividends, or (y) the amount per share that would have been payable had all redeemable convertible preferred stock been converted immediately prior to the liquidation.

可选赎回

Optional Redemption

持有人有权（但无义务）强制公司赎回其股份，赎回价格等于每股累计设定价值加上已计提但未支付股息，且该选择权在发生控制权变更时加速行使。若 C 系列可赎回可转换优先股在 IPO 时转换，则持有人有权在 IPO 后首个交易日的第二个周年日，以每股 $38.95 现金赎回因转换 C 系列而发行的普通股。公司认为，赎回特征内嵌于相应股份之中，且无需分拆，因为若该等赎回特征独立存在，将不符合衍生工具的定义。

The holders have the option, but not the obligation, to force the Company to redeem their shares for a redemption price equal to the accumulated stated value per share plus accrued and unpaid dividends, with such option being accelerated upon the occurrence of a change of control. In the event the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock is converted upon an IPO, the holders will be entitled to redeem the common stock issued upon conversion of the Series C for $38.95 cash per share at the second anniversary of the first trading day after the IPO. The Company concluded that the redemption features were embedded within the respective shares of stock and were not required to be bifurcated because the redemption features would not meet the definition of a derivative if they were freestanding.

保护性条款

Protective Provisions

除所有可赎回可转换优先股所列的权利和特权外，B 系列可赎回可转换优先股还包括某些特殊权利，例如选举一名公司董事会（“董事会”）成员的权利，以及保护性权利，例如否决增加 B 系列合并优先股（B 系列、B-1 系列）授权股份数量的权利。C 系列可转换优先股还包括保护性权利，例如否决增加 C 系列可赎回可转换优先股授权股份数量的权利。

In addition to the rights and privileges listed for all redeemable convertible preferred stock, the Series B redeemable convertible preferred stock includes certain special rights, such as the ability to elect one member of the Company’s Board of Directors (“Board”), and protective rights, such as the ability to veto an increase in the authorized number of shares of Combined Series B Preferred Stock (Series B, Series B-1). Series C convertible preferred stock also includes protective rights, such as the ability to veto an increase in the authorized number of shares of Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock.

可赎回可转换优先股的分类

Classification of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock

尽管本公司的可赎回可转换优先股并非强制可赎回，但由于其在某些不受本公司控制的视同清算事件发生时可有条件赎回，因此被归类为股东权益赤字之外。相应地，可赎回可转换优先股在合并资产负债表的夹层部分列示于永久性权益之外。除 C 轮优先股外，可赎回可转换普通股未按赎回价值重新计量，因为赎回权仅在非持有人控制的事件发生时可有条件行使，且在所列报期间内这些或有事件均不被认为很可能发生，因此这些工具不被认为很可能变为可赎回。

Although the Company’s redeemable convertible preferred stock is not mandatorily redeemable, it is classified outside of stockholders’ deficit because it is contingently redeemable upon certain Deemed Liquidation Events outside the Company’s control. Accordingly, redeemable convertible preferred stock is presented outside of permanent equity in the mezzanine section of the consolidated balance sheets. With the exception of the Series C, the redeemable convertible common stock is not being remeasured to redemption value because the redemption rights are contingently exercisable upon the occurrence of events that are not within the control of the holders, the contingent events were not deemed probable of occurring at any time during the periods presented, and therefore, the instruments were not deemed probable of becoming redeemable.

C 轮可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权在认沽期权可行使之日无或有条件地要求以现金赎回其股份。因此，C 轮可赎回可转换优先股的账面价值在自发行日至赎回选择权首次可行使的期间内累积至其赎回价值。C 轮可赎回可转换优先股的累积股息，在本公司选择以现金结算时计提为股息负债，或在本公司选择以实物结算累积股息时计入赎回价值累积的计算中。

The holders of the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock are entitled to redeem their shares for cash on the date the put option becomes exercisable, without contingency. As a result, the carrying value of the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock is being accreted to its redemption value over the period from issuance to when the redemption option first becomes exercisable. The cumulative dividends on the Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock are accrued as dividend liabilities in the event the Company elects to settle in cash, or included in the calculation of the accretion to redemption value in the event the Company elects to settle the cumulative dividend in kind.

#### 普通股

#### Common Stock

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，本公司分别获授权发行 469,030,700 股和 690,680,000 股普通股，每股面值$0.000005。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日，本公司有一类普通股。在截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，本公司的公司章程经修订，使本公司普通股由 A 类普通股和 B 类普通股组成。普通股股东有权在董事会宣布派发股息时获得任何股息，并且在清算或解散时，也有权按所持股份数量比例平等获得所有依法可用于分配给股东的资产，但须受优先股股东权利的限制。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，董事会尚未宣布对本公司普通股的任何股息。

As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, the Company was authorized to issue 469,030,700 and 690,680,000 shares of common stock, respectively, with a par value of $0.000005 per share. As of December 31, 2023, the Company had one class of common stock. During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company’s certificate of incorporation was amended such that the Company’s common stock consists of Class A common stock and Class B common stock. Common stockholders are entitled to receive any dividends if and when declared by the Board, and upon liquidation or dissolution, are also entitled to receive all assets legally available for distribution to stockholders, ratably in proportion to the number of shares held, subject to the rights of preferred stockholders. As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, no dividends on the Company’s common stock had been declared by the Board.

投票权

Voting

A 类普通股持有人每股享有 1 票投票权。B 类普通股持有人在本公司首次公开募股完成前每股享有 1 票投票权。首次公开募股完成后，每股 B 类普通股将赋予持有人每股 10 票投票权。A 类普通股和 B 类普通股持有人作为一个单一类别共同投票，除非法律另有要求。

Holders of Class A common stock are entitled to one vote per share. Holders of Class B common stock are entitled to one vote per share prior to the completion of the Company’s IPO. Upon the completion of the IPO, each share of Class B common stock will entitle the holder to ten votes per share. Holders of Class A common stock and Class B common stock vote together as a single class, except where otherwise required by law.

转换

Conversion

B 类普通股股东可随时选择将所持 B 类普通股按一比一的比例转换为 A 类普通股。此外，在发生特定事件（包括未经许可的出售或转让）时，每股 B 类普通股将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股。进一步而言，在公司章程细则规定的特定事件发生时，所有已发行的 B 类普通股将自动转换为 A 类普通股。A 类普通股不可转换为任何其他类别的股份。

Shares of Class B common stock are convertible at any time at the option of the holder into shares of Class A common stock on a one-to-one basis. In addition, each share of Class B common stock will automatically convert into a share of Class A common stock, as a result of certain events, including upon a non-permitted sale or transfer. Further, upon certain events specified in the certificate of incorporation, all outstanding shares of Class B common stock will convert automatically into shares of Class A common stock. Class A common stock is not convertible into any other class of shares.

股息与清算权利

Dividend and Liquidation Rights

在公司宣派的任何股息中，A 类普通股与 B 类普通股享有同等参与权，但须受优先股股东权利的约束。在公司清算、解散或停业时，A 类普通股与 B 类普通股的持有人有权在清偿负债后按比例分享剩余资产的任何分配，但须受优先股股东权利的约束。

Both Class A common stock and Class B common stock participate equally in any dividends declared by the Company, subject to the rights of preferred stockholders. In the event of liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of the Company, holders of Class A common stock and Class B common stock are entitled to share in any distribution of assets remaining after payment of liabilities, subject to the rights of preferred stockholders.

#### 股票期权计划

#### Stock Option Plan

2019 年 7 月，公司通过了一项股票期权计划（“2019 年股票期权计划”或“该计划”）。该计划的目的是通过向潜在贡献对公司成功具有重要意义的合资格人士授予普通股奖励，为其提供参与公司未来业绩的机会，从而激励、留住并调动该等合资格人士的积极性。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，董事会授权根据该计划发行的股份总数分别为 66,637,600 股和 73,637,600 股。若此前根据该计划发行的股份因没收条款、优先购买权或公司回购而被公司重新取得，则该等股份应加回至当时根据该计划可供发行的股份数量中。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，根据该计划可供发行的股份分别为 11,061,240 股和 3,750,480 股。

In July 2019, the Company adopted a stock option plan (the “2019 Stock Option Plan” or the “Plan”). The purpose of the Plan is to provide incentives to attract, retain, and motivate eligible persons whose potential contributions are important to the success of the Company by offering those eligible persons an opportunity to participate in the Company’s future performance through the grant of awards of common stock. The total number of shares authorized by the Board to be issued under the Plan are 66,637,600 and 73,637,600 shares as of December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively. In the event that shares previously issued under the Plan are reacquired by the Company pursuant to a forfeiture provision, right of first refusal, or repurchase by the Company, such shares shall be added back to the number of shares then available for issuance under the Plan. As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, 11,061,240 and 3,750,480 shares, respectively, were available for issuance under the Plan.

公司可向员工、承包商或其他实体授予股票期权，以激励其为公司付出更多努力并促进公司业务成功。根据期权持有人与公司关系的具体情况以及一个日历年度内归属或行权的股票期权数量，股票期权可能被视为激励性股票期权或非合格股票期权。根据该计划授予的股票期权通常在三年或四年内归属。公司可授予可立即行权但受回购权约束的股票期权。公司还可授予允许加速归属的股票期权。根据该计划授予的股票期权将在授予后十年到期。公司在股票期权行权时发行普通股。

The Company may grant stock options to employees, contractors, or other entities in order to incentivize them to increase their efforts on behalf of the Company and to promote the success of the Company’s business. Stock options may be treated as incentive stock options or nonqualified stock options depending on the specific circumstances of an optionee’s relationship with the Company and the number of stock options vesting or exercised in a calendar year. Stock options granted under the Plan generally vest either over a three-year or four-year period. The Company may award stock options that are immediately exercisable, subject to a repurchase right. The Company may also grant stock options that allow for acceleration of vesting. The stock options granted under the Plan will expire after ten years from the time of their grant. The Company issues common stock upon the exercise of stock options.

该等假设和估计的确定方式如下：

These assumptions and estimates were determined as follows:

预期波动率——由于公司普通股没有公开市场，预期波动率是采用可比上市公司在相当于奖励预期期限的期间内的历史波动率确定的。

Expected Volatility—As there is no public market for the Company’s common stock, the expected volatility was determined using the historical volatilities of publicly listed peer companies over a period equivalent to the expected term of the awards.

预期期限——预期期限代表股权奖励预计将保持未行权状态的期间。对于被视为“普通香草型”的期权授予，公司采用简化方法确定预期期限。简化方法将期限视为归属时间与股票期权合同期限的平均值。

Expected Term—The expected term represents the period that the stock-based awards are expected to be outstanding. For option grants that are considered to be “plain vanilla,” the Company determines the expected term using the simplified method. The simplified method deems the term to be the average of the time-to-vesting and the contractual life of the stock options.

无风险利率——无风险利率基于授予时与美国国债零息债券隐含收益率，该债券的预期期限与股票期权相当。

Risk-Free Interest Rate—The risk-free interest rate is based on the implied yield available on U.S. Treasury zero-coupon issues with an equivalent expected term of the stock options at the time of grant.

预期股息率——预期股息假设为零，因为公司从未就其普通股支付股息，且目前没有计划这样做。

Expected Dividend Yield—The expected dividend is assumed to be zero, as the Company has never paid dividends on its common stock and has no current plans to do so.

公司普通股每股公允价值——由于公司普通股尚未公开交易，公司必须估计其普通股的公允价值。董事会每次批准奖励的会议上考虑众多客观和主观因素以确定公司普通股的公允价值。考虑的因素包括但不限于：(i) 公司普通股同期独立第三方估值的结果，(ii) 公司可赎回可转换优先股相对于普通股的价格、权利、优先权和特权，(iii) 公司普通股缺乏市场流动性，(iv) 公司实际经营和财务业绩以及对其未来业绩的估计趋势和前景、当前业务状况和财务预测，(v) 鉴于当前市场条件，实现流动性事件（如 IPO、直接上市或公司出售）的可能性；以及 (vi) 涉及公司股份的先例交易。

Fair Value Per Share of the Company’s Common Stock—Because the Company’s common stock is not yet publicly traded, the Company must estimate the fair value of its common stock. The Board considers numerous objective and subjective factors to determine the fair value of the Company’s common stock at each meeting in which awards are approved. The factors considered include, but are not limited to: (i) the results of contemporaneous independent third-party valuations of the Company’s common stock, (ii) the prices, rights, preferences, and privileges of the Company’s redeemable convertible preferred stock relative to those of its common stock, (iii) the lack of marketability of the Company’s common stock, (iv) the Company’s actual operating and financial performance and estimated trends and prospects for its future performance current business conditions and financial projections, (v) the likelihood of achieving a liquidity event, such as an IPO, direct listing, or sale of the Company, given prevailing market conditions; and (vi) precedent transactions involving the Company’s shares.

#### 二级交易

#### Secondary Transactions

2023 年 12 月，公司若干员工及非员工股东（「2023 年出售股东」）要约出售 41,476,000 股普通股（「2023 年二级发售」）。公司未在 2023 年二级发售中要约出售任何普通股，亦未从 2023 年出售股东出售普通股中获得任何所得款项。2023 年二级发售由一名新投资者主导进行，并被认定为按公允价值进行的公平交易。因此，公司未就 2023 年二级发售确认任何补偿成本。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司未就 2023 年二级发售发生任何费用。就参与 2023 年二级发售的若干股东行使 1,125,500 份期权，公司收到不足 $1 million 的现金（不含预扣税）。与 2023 年二级发售相关，11,103,380 股种子轮可赎回可转换优先股、3,896,180 股 A 轮可赎回可转换优先股及 2,077,980 股 B-1 轮可赎回可转换优先股转换为等量股数的普通股，纳入本次发售。

In December 2023, certain employee and non-employee stockholders of the Company (the “2023 Selling Stockholders”) offered 41,476,000 shares of common stock (the “2023 Secondary Offering”). The Company did not offer any shares of common stock in the 2023 Secondary Offering and did not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares of common stock by the 2023 Selling Stockholders. The 2023 Secondary Offering was conducted and led by a new investor and was determined to be an arms-length transaction at fair value. Accordingly, the Company did not record any compensation cost associated with the 2023 Secondary Offering. The Company incurred no costs in relation to the 2023 Secondary Offering for the year ended December 31, 2023. The Company received less than $1 million in cash (excluding withholding taxes) in connection with the exercise of 1,125,500 options by certain stockholders participating in the 2023 Secondary Offering. In conjunction with the 2023 Secondary Offering, 11,103,380 shares of Series Seed redeemable convertible preferred stock, 3,896,180 shares of Series A redeemable convertible preferred stock, and 2,077,980 shares of Series B-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock were converted to the equivalent number of shares of common stock to be included in the offering.

2024 年 10 月，公司若干员工及非员工股东（「2024 年出售股东」）以每股 $46.99 的购买价格向新投资者及现有投资者要约出售 13,851,240 股 A 类普通股，该价格等于交易时该股票的估计公允价值（「2024 年二级发售」）。公司未在 2024 年二级发售中要约出售任何普通股，亦未从 2024 年出售股东出售普通股中获得任何所得款项。2024 年二级发售被认定为按公允价值进行的公平交易。因此，公司未就 2024 年二级发售确认任何补偿成本。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司未就 2024 年二级发售发生任何费用。就参与 2024 年二级发售的若干股东行使 1,368,680 份期权，公司收到 $1 million 的现金（不含预扣税）。与 2024 年二级发售相关，3,329,540 股种子轮可赎回可转换优先股、518,060 股 A 轮可赎回可转换优先股、201,420 股 B-1 轮可赎回可转换优先股及 1,067,020 股 B 类普通股转换为等量股数的 A 类普通股，纳入本次发售。

In October 2024, certain employees and non-employee stockholders of the Company (the “2024 Selling Stockholders”) offered 13,851,240 shares of Class A common stock to new and existing investors at a purchase price of $46.99 per share, equal to the estimated fair value of the stock at the time of the transaction (the “2024 Secondary Offering”). The Company did not offer any shares of common stock in the 2024 Secondary Offering and did not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares of common stock by the 2024 Selling Stockholders. The 2024 Secondary Offering was determined to be an arms-length transaction at fair value. Accordingly, the Company did not record any compensation cost associated with the 2024 Secondary Offering. The Company incurred no costs in relation to the 2024 Secondary Offering for the year ended December 31, 2024. The Company received $1 million in cash (excluding withholding taxes) in connection with the exercise of 1,368,680 options by certain stockholders participating in the 2024 Secondary Offering. In conjunction with the 2024 Secondary Offering, 3,329,540 shares of Series Seed redeemable convertible preferred stock, 518,060 shares of Series A redeemable convertible preferred stock, 201,420 shares of Series B-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock, and 1,067,020 shares of Class B common stock were converted to the equivalent number of shares of Class A common stock to be included in the offering.

ASC 740《所得税》要求，净经营亏损（“NOL”）、暂时性差异和税收抵免结转的税收利益，应在管理层评估其实现可能性为“很可能”时确认为资产。未来税收利益的实现取决于公司在结转期内产生足够应纳税所得额的能力。由于公司近期存在经营亏损的历史，管理层认为目前上述未来税收利益所产生的递延所得税资产不太可能实现，因此，公司已就联邦和州递延所得税资产计提了估值备抵。

ASC 740, Income Taxes requires that the tax benefit of net operating losses (“NOL”), temporary differences, and credit carryforwards be recorded as an asset to the extent that management assesses that realization is “more likely than not.” Realization of the future tax benefits is dependent on the Company’s ability to generate sufficient taxable income within the carryforward period. Because of the Company’s recent history of operating losses, management believes that recognition of the deferred tax assets arising from the above-mentioned future tax benefits is currently not likely to be realized and, accordingly, a valuation allowance has been provided by the Company against federal and state deferred tax assets.

在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，估值备抵分别同比增加 $44 million 和 $133 million。

The valuation allowance increased year over year by $44 million and $133 million during the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively.

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司分别拥有 $933 million 和 $3.6 billion 的联邦 NOL 结转额，可用于抵减未来应纳税所得额，其中几乎全部可无限期结转。截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司分别拥有 $57 million 和 $61 million 的州 NOL 结转额，其中分别有 $19 million 和 $30 million 可无限期结转。如果 NOL 结转额未被使用，则分别有 $38 million 和 $31 million 将在 2032 年至 2044 年之间以不同金额到期。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司拥有可用于抵减未来应纳税所得额的境外 NOL 结转额 $5 million，可无限期结转。

As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, the Company had $933 million and $3.6 billion, respectively, in federal NOL carryforwards to offset future taxable income, almost all of which can be carried forward indefinitely. As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, the Company had state NOL carryforwards of $57 million and $61 million, respectively, of which $19 million and $30 million, respectively, can be carried forward indefinitely. If the NOL carryforwards are not utilized, $38 million and $31 million, respectively, will expire in varying amounts between the years 2032 and 2044. As of December 31, 2024, the Company had foreign NOL carryforwards to offset future taxable income of $5 million that can be carried forward indefinitely.

截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司可用于抵减未来应纳税所得额的联邦和州税收抵免结转额金额不重大。

As of December 31, 2023 and 2024, the Company had insignificant amounts of federal and state tax credit carryforwards available to offset future taxable income.

根据经修订的《1986 年国内税收法典》以及类似的州税收规定，如果公司发生“第 382 条项下的所有权变更”，则可能对净经营亏损和税收抵免结转额的使用施加限制。例如，发行新股或某些股东交易可能导致所有权变更。如果适用这些限制，结转额将受到年度限制，从而可能在考虑估值备抵之前减少递延所得税资产总额。

A limitation may apply to the use of the net operating loss and credit carryforwards, under provisions of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and similar state tax provisions that are applicable if the Company experiences an “ownership change under Section 382.” For example, an ownership change may occur as a result of the issuance of new equity or certain shareholder transactions. Should these limitations apply, the carryforwards would be subject to an annual limitation, resulting in a potential reduction in the gross deferred tax assets before considering the valuation allowance.

公司在截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内经历了第 382 条项下的所有权变更，并确定这些变更未对其 NOL 结转额未来可使用的可用性产生重大影响。

The Company experienced a Section 382 ownership change during the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, and determined that these changes did not materially impact the availability of its NOL carryforwards for use in the future.

公司须在美国、加利福尼亚州以及其他多个国内和国际司法管辖区缴纳所得税。美国、州和外国司法管辖区的诉讼时效通常为三至五年。由于早期年度产生的税务属性已结转，并可能在以后年度使用时接受审计，正常诉讼时效之外的财政年度仍可供税务机关审计。我们未发现任何正在进行的检查。

The Company is subject to income taxes in the United States, California, and other various domestic and international jurisdictions. The U.S., state, and foreign jurisdictions have statutes of limitations that generally range from three to five years. Fiscal years outside of the normal statute of limitation remain open to audit by tax authorities due to tax attributes generated in those early years, which have been carried forward and may be audited in subsequent years when utilized. We are not aware of any ongoing examinations.

由于税法法规的解释存在差异，税务机关可能对公司纳税申报立场提出异议。公司定期评估与纳税申报立场相关的风险敞口，并在需要时为税务检查可能导致的调整计提准备金。

Due to differing interpretations of tax laws and regulations, tax authorities may dispute the Company’s tax filing positions. The Company periodically evaluates the exposures associated with tax filing positions and will reserve amounts, if needed, for adjustments that may result from tax examinations.

公司的未确认税收利益总额不重大，且在截至 2022 年、2023 年和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内未发生重大变化。

The Company’s total amount of unrecognized tax benefits is insignificant, and did not change materially during the years ended December 31, 2022, 2023, and 2024.

确认未确认税收利益不会对有效税率产生影响，因为这些利益被记录为递延所得税资产，并已计提全额估值备抵。公司预计其不确定税务立场在未来 12 个月内不会发生任何重大变化。

Recognition of the unrecognized tax benefits would not have an impact on the effective tax as they are recorded as deferred tax assets which are subject to a full valuation allowance. The Company does not anticipate any significant change in its uncertain tax positions within the next 12 months.

#### 优先担保票据

#### Senior Secured Notes

2021 年 10 月，公司向由 Magnetar 管理或提供咨询的基金或账户发行了 2021 年可转换优先担保票据，本金金额为 $20 million，到期日为 2025 年。2022 年 4 月，本金金额增至 $50 million。2024 年 9 月，该等票据转换为公司 A 类普通股股份。详情请参见附注 10——债务。就发行 2021 年可转换优先担保票据事宜，公司授予 Magnetar 一项选择权，可按等于公司 IPO 每股发行价的价格购买最多 $15 million 的公司 A 类普通股，该选择权可在公司 A 类普通股该次发行一周年之日之前行使。2024 年 9 月，投资者选择转换全部 2021 年可转换优先担保票据，由此发行了 24,543,980 股 A 类普通股。

In October 2021, the Company issued $20 million of 2021 Convertible Senior Secured Notes to funds or accounts managed or advised by Magnetar, with a maturity date in 2025. The principal amount increased to $50 million in April 2022. In September 2024, these notes were converted into shares of the Company’s Class A common stock. Refer to Note 10—Debt for additional information. In connection with the issuance of the 2021 Convertible Senior Secured Notes, the Company granted Magnetar an option to purchase up to $15 million in the Company’s Class A common stock, at a price equal to the price per share in the Company’s IPO, which is exercisable until the one-year anniversary of such offering of the Company’s Class A common stock. In September 2024, the investors elected to convert all 2021 Convertible Senior Secured Notes, resulting in the issuance of 24,543,980 shares of Class A common stock.

2022 年 10 月至 2023 年 4 月期间，公司向由 Magnetar 管理或提供咨询的基金或账户发行了 $125 million 的 2022 年优先担保票据，到期日介于 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 4 月之间，并附带可购买 12,144,668 股公司 A 类普通股的认股权证。2024 年 7 月，公司全额赎回该等票据，支付了 $137 million。详情请参见附注 10——债务。就发行 2022 年优先担保票据事宜，公司授予 Magnetar 按等于公司 IPO 每股发行价的价格购买最多占公司 A 类普通股 5% 的股份的权利。

Between October 2022 and April 2023, the Company issued $125 million of 2022 Senior Secured Notes with maturity dates between October 2025 and April 2026 to funds or accounts managed or advised by Magnetar, along with warrants to purchase 12,144,668 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock. In July 2024, the Company redeemed these notes in full, paying $137 million. Refer to Note 10—Debt for additional information. In connection with the issuance of the 2022 Senior Secured Notes, the Company granted Magnetar the right to purchase up to 5% of the Company’s Class A common stock issued at a price equal to the price per share in the Company’s IPO.

#### 与购买 D 轮优先股相关的战略投资

#### Strategic Investment Related to a Purchase of Series D Preferred Stock

2024 年 6 月，公司向 Magnetar 管理的一只基金出资 $50 million，用于该基金购买第三方的优先股。公司有权要求以实物分配方式分配其在该基金中最多 99% 的权益，该分配将通过分配该第三方公司优先股股份的方式予以满足。该基金不符合 VIE 的定义，且根据 VOE 模型，公司拥有多数股权，并对该基金的重大经营、财务和投资决策拥有控制权。公司将该基金纳入合并范围，并将所购买的优先股作为非公开持股的权益证券进行会计处理，该等证券无易于确定的公允价值，按成本计量，并随后就可观察的价格变动或减值进行调整。

In June 2024, the Company contributed $50 million to a fund managed by Magnetar in connection with the fund’s purchase of a third-party’s preferred stock. The Company has the right to request a distribution in kind of up to 99% of its interest in the fund, which will be satisfied by distributing shares of the third-party company’s preferred stock. The fund did not meet the definition of a VIE, and under the VOE model, the Company has a majority equity interest and has control over significant operating, financial, and investing decisions of the fund. The Company consolidated the fund and accounted for the purchased preferred stock as privately held equity securities that do not have a readily determinable fair value measured at cost, with subsequent adjustments for observable price changes or impairments.

若向公司进行该第三方优先股的实物分配，且在该等分配之后公司出售该等优先股的任何股份（或该等股份转换或交换成的任何证券），公司应按如下方式分配该等出售的净收益：(i) 在收到相当于其累计出资额的金额之前，净收益的 100% 归公司；(ii) 此后，净收益的 75% 归公司，25% 归 Magnetar 的关联方。

To the extent there is an in-kind distribution of the third-party’s preferred stock to the Company and following such distribution the Company sells any shares of such preferred stock (or any securities into which such stock is converted or exchanged), the Company will allocate the net proceeds from such sale as follows: (i) 100% of the net proceeds to the Company until it receives an amount equal to its aggregate capital contribution and (ii) thereafter, 75% of the net proceeds to the Company and 25% to an affiliate of Magnetar.

#### 其他交易

#### Other Transactions

2024 年 8 月，本公司与 MagAI Ventures 签订了《AI 算力服务预留容量及预付款协议》（以下简称“MagAI 容量协议”）。根据该协议，本公司将以预先协商的小时费率向 MagAI Ventures 的投资组合公司提供预定数量的云计算服务。各投资组合公司（如有）将使用的云计算服务具体数量（包括容量和期限）将与各投资组合公司单独协商，并须经 MagAI Ventures 最终批准。本公司就 MagAI 容量协议收到了 230,000,000 美元的可退还保证金。MagAI Ventures（包括其投资组合公司）根据该安排对云服务的任何消耗均从该保证金金额中扣除，未使用部分将在该安排期限结束时退还给 MagAI Ventures。在该安排的整个期限内，如果 MagAI Ventures 的投资组合公司未就全部预定云计算服务签订合同，本公司可与 MagAI Ventures 协商，将该可用容量改用于其他客户，并就按 MagAI Ventures 预先协商费率向这些客户收费本可产生的收入以上的任何已实现收入与 MagAI Ventures 分享利润。

In August 2024, the Company entered into an AI Computing Service Reserved Capacity and Prepayment Agreement with MagAI Ventures (the “MagAI Capacity Agreement”). Under this agreement, the Company will provide portfolio companies of MagAI Ventures with a pre-determined amount of cloud computing services at a pre-negotiated hourly rate. The specific amount of cloud computing services, inclusive of the capacity and term, to be used by each portfolio company, if any, will be negotiated individually with each portfolio company, and will be subject to final approval by MagAI Ventures. The Company received a refundable deposit of $230 million in connection with the MagAI Capacity Agreement. Any consumption of cloud services by MagAI Ventures, including by their portfolio companies, under this arrangement is deducted from this deposit amount, with the unused portion refunded back to MagAI Ventures at the end of the term of the arrangement. Throughout the term of the arrangement, if MagAI Ventures portfolio companies do not contract for the full amount of the pre-determined cloud computing services, the Company may agree with MagAI Ventures to instead use this available capacity for other customers, and share profits with MagAI Ventures for any revenues realized above the revenues that would have been generated by charging these customers the MagAI Ventures pre-negotiated rate.

此外，MagAI 容量协议为 MagAI Ventures 规定了若干终止选择权，包括在目标开始日期前未能提供特定数量容量的情形。MagAI 容量协议初始期限为四年，MagAI Ventures 有权选择再延长两年。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，由于该安排下尚未提供任何服务，该可退还保证金计入合并资产负债表上的其他流动负债。2025 年 2 月，MagAI 容量协议经修订，赋予 MagAI Ventures 若干任意终止权。一旦发生该等终止，保证金未使用部分将按特定乘数退还。

Additionally, the MagAI Capacity Agreement provides for certain termination options for MagAI Ventures, including if a specified amount of capacity is not available by a target commencement date. The MagAI Capacity Agreement runs for an initial period of four years, with an option for MagAI Ventures to extend for two additional years. As of December 31, 2024, the refundable deposit is included within other current liabilities on the consolidated balance sheet, as no services had yet been provided under this arrangement. In February 2025, the MagAI Capacity Agreement was amended to provide certain termination for convenience rights to MagAI Ventures. Upon such termination, the unused portion of deposit will be refunded with a specified multiplier.

2024 年 9 月，本公司与各联合创始人分别签订了股权交换权协议。该协议授予各联合创始人一项权利（但非义务），即将其在股权奖励行权或结算时获得的 A 类普通股股份交换为 B 类普通股股份。该权利适用于先前授予本公司联合创始人的股权奖励以及未来可能授予本公司联合创始人的股权奖励。

In September 2024, the Company entered into an equity exchange right agreement with each of its co-founders. This agreement grants each co-founder the right, but not the obligation, to exchange shares of Class A common stock received upon the exercise or settlement of equity awards for shares of Class B common stock. This right applies to equity awards previously granted to the Company’s co-founders and to equity awards that may be granted to the Company’s co-founders in the future.

16. 终止经营 16. Discontinued Operations

#### 区块链挖矿与管理服务

#### Blockchain Mining and Management Services

2022 年 9 月 30 日，由于以太坊奖励政策发生变化，对公司未来潜在挖矿收入产生重大影响，公司终止了其区块链挖矿与管理服务，并将重心集中于其云计算业务。这一战略转变导致区块链挖矿与管理业务在公司截至 2022 年 12 月 31 日止年度的财务报表中被归类为终止经营业务。

On September 30, 2022, the Company ceased its Blockchain Mining and Management Services due to changes in Ethereum’s reward policy, which materially impacted potential future mining revenues, and concentrated its focus to its cloud computing business. This strategic shift resulted in the classification of the Blockchain Mining and Management business as discontinued operations in the Company’s financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2022.

区块链挖矿利用公司的算力挖掘加密货币，主要是以太坊，相关安排下以数字资产形式获得奖励并立即转换为美元。2022 年所有挖出的数字资产均已变现，截至 2022 年 12 月 31 日公司未持有任何数字资产。管理服务涉及为从事区块链挖矿的客户提供托管和运营支持，收入通过报销协议和收入分成获得。这些活动在后续期间不再存在，且任何后续期间均无终止经营业务。

Blockchain mining utilized the Company’s computing capacity to mine cryptocurrencies, primarily Ethereum, under arrangements where rewards were received as digital assets and immediately converted to U.S. dollars. All digital assets mined were liquidated in 2022, and the Company held no digital assets as of December 31, 2022. Management Services involved hosting and operational support for customers engaged in blockchain mining, with revenues derived through reimbursement agreements and revenue sharing. These activities are not present in subsequent periods, and there are no discontinued operations for any subsequent periods.

17. 期后事项 17. Subsequent Events

公司已对截至 2025 年 3 月 3 日（即合并财务报表出具之日）的期后事项进行了评估，并就附注 1 所述的股票拆分事项评估至 2025 年 3 月 19 日。

The Company has evaluated subsequent events through March 3, 2025, the date the consolidated financial statements were issued, and with respect to the stock split, described in Note 1, through March 19, 2025.

2025 年 1 月，公司在循环信贷额度下提取了 $50 million。

In January 2025, the Company drew $50 million on the Revolving Credit Facility.

2025 年 1 月，公司与一家 OEM 签订了多项额外融资协议。该等融资协议的合计名义余额为 $160 million。就上述融资协议，公司为所融资设备授予了担保权益。该等融资安排的期限为两年。

In January 2025, the Company entered into various additional financing agreements with an OEM. The financing agreements have an aggregate notional balance of $160 million. Related to the financing agreements, the Company granted a security interest for the financed equipment. The financing arrangements have a term of two years.

2025 年 2 月，公司在 DDTL 2.0 额度下额外借入 $473 million，使 DDTL 2.0 额度下的借款总额达到 $4.3 billion。更多信息请参见附注 10——债务。

In February 2025, the Company borrowed an additional $473 million under the DDTL 2.0 Facility, bringing the total borrowings on the DDTL 2.0 Facility to $4.3 billion. Refer to Note 10—Debt for additional information.

2025 年 2 月和 3 月，公司签订了新协议以租赁额外场地。公司预计将在未来 15 年内就上述租赁支付约 $3.4 billion 的额外租金。

In February and March 2025, the Company entered into new agreements to lease additional space. The Company expects to make approximately $3.4 billion of additional rent payments over the next 15 years related to the leases.

2025 年 2 月，公司与单一出租方修改了多项租赁协议。该等修改变更了合同约定的电力容量、期限和合同付款，并终止了相关托管协议。由于该等修改，公司将获得额外 70 MW 的合同电力容量。公司收到了此前计入其他非流动资产中的 $304 million 未使用托管资金的退款，并预计将在该等租赁 13 年的期限内支付约 $1.7 billion 的额外租金。

In February 2025, the Company modified multiple lease agreements with a single landlord. The modifications changed the contracted power capacity, term, and contractual payments, and terminated the related escrow agreements. As a result of the modification, the Company will receive an additional 70 MW of contracted power capacity. The Company received a refund of $304 million of unused escrow funds previously included within other non-current assets, and expects to make approximately $1.7 billion of additional rent payments over the 13 year term of these leases.

2025 年 2 月，公司签订最终协议，收购 AI 开发者平台 Weights and Biases, Inc.。购买价款预计主要以约 20,400,000 股公司 A 类普通股支付。鉴于该收购的时间安排，目前尚无法切实可行地披露有关最终购买价款、购买价款分配或其他相关披露的信息。

In February 2025, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Weights and Biases, Inc., an AI developer platform. The purchase price is anticipated to be payable primarily in approximately 20,400,000 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock. Given the timing of the acquisition, it is not practicable to disclose information regarding the final purchase price, purchase price allocation, or other related disclosure at this time.

附注 18. 期后事项（未经审计） Note 18. Subsequent Events (Unaudited)

公司已对自合并财务报表最初于 2025 年 3 月 3 日出具之日起至 2025 年 3 月 19 日（即合并财务报表重新出具之日）止的期后事项进行了评估。

The Company has evaluated subsequent events from the date the consolidated financial statements were originally issued on March 3, 2025 through March 19, 2025, the date the consolidated financial statements were reissued.

2025 年 3 月，公司与 OpenAI 签订了主服务协议（“OpenAI 主服务协议”），据此，公司通过履行 OpenAI 向公司提交的预留容量订单，向 OpenAI 提供云计算容量的访问权限。截至 2025 年 3 月 11 日，在满足交付及服务可用性要求的前提下，OpenAI 已承诺在 2030 年 10 月前向公司支付最高约 $11.9 billion。根据 OpenAI 主服务协议项下的未完成订单，公司已设立一家特殊目的实体，该实体将持有相关基础设施，且公司拟由该特殊目的实体承担债务，以为其履行 OpenAI 主服务协议项下义务提供融资。此外，公司已同意根据 OpenAI 主服务协议的条款，并依据与 OpenAI 签订的股票发行协议（“OpenAI 股票发行协议”），向 OpenAI 发行数量相当于 $350.0 million 的公司 A 类普通股，每股价值等于首次公开发行价格。该等股份以私募方式发行，须以本次发行为完成条件。OpenAI 主服务协议项下确认的任何收入，将以 OpenAI 股票发行协议项下所发行股份的价值予以抵销。

In March 2025, the Company entered into a Master Services Agreement (the “OpenAI Master Services Agreement”) with OpenAI, pursuant to which the Company provides OpenAI access to cloud computing capacity through fulfillment of reserved capacity orders submitted to the Company by OpenAI. As of March 11, 2025, subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to approximately $11.9 billion through October 2030. Under the outstanding order under the OpenAI Master Services Agreement, the Company has established a special purpose vehicle that will hold the infrastructure, and the Company intends for the special purpose vehicle to incur indebtedness to finance its obligations under the OpenAI Master Services Agreement. Additionally, the Company has agreed to issue to OpenAI, in accordance with the terms of the OpenAI Master Services Agreement and pursuant to a stock issuance agreement (the “OpenAI Stock Issuance Agreement”) with OpenAI, a number of shares of the Company’s Class A common stock equal to $350.0 million valued at a price per share equal to the initial public offering price. The issuance of the shares in a private placement is contingent upon the completion of this offering. Any revenue recognized under the OpenAI Master Service Agreement will be offset by the value of the shares issued under the OpenAI Stock Issuance Agreement.

2025 年 3 月，公司与 Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.（作为行政代理人）、担保方及贷款方签订了信贷协议（“2025 年定期贷款信贷协议”），提供一项 $300 million 的无担保定期贷款融资（“2025 年定期贷款融资”）。2025 年定期贷款融资项下的义务由 2025 年定期贷款信贷协议所述子公司担保人提供无条件担保。2025 年定期贷款融资项下的借款仅可在单次融资中提取。截至 2025 年 3 月 19 日，2025 年定期贷款融资项下尚无借款。2025 年定期贷款融资的所得款项可用于营运资金及一般公司用途（包括为收购及其他投资提供融资）。2025 年定期贷款融资将于 2025 年 12 月 16 日到期。2025 年定期贷款融资项下的借款按年利率计息，由公司选择，可为：(a) 对于基准利率贷款，适用利差为 0.75% 加基准利率（受 1.00% 下限约束），该基准利率参照以下各项中的最高者确定：(i) 最优惠利率，

In March 2025, the Company entered into a credit agreement (the “2025 Term Loan Credit Agreement”) with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent, the guarantors party thereto, and the lenders party thereto, providing for a $300 million unsecured term loan facility (the “2025 Term Loan Facility”). The obligations under the 2025 Term Loan Facility are unconditionally guaranteed by the subsidiary guarantors as described in the 2025 Term Loan Credit Agreement. Amounts borrowed under the 2025 Term Loan Facility may only be borrowed in a single funding. There have been no borrowings under the 2025 Term Loan Facility as of March 19, 2025. The proceeds of the 2025 Term Loan Facility may be used for working capital and general corporate purposes (including the financing of acquisitions and other investments). The 2025 Term Loan Facility will mature on December 16, 2025. Amounts borrowed under the 2025 Term Loan Facility are subject to an interest rate per annum equal to, at the Company’s option, either (a) for base rate loans, an applicable margin of 0.75% plus a base rate (subject to a 1.00% floor) determined by reference to the highest of (i) the prime rate,

(ii) 以下两者中的较高者：(A) 联邦基金有效利率和 (B) 隔夜银行融资利率，在每种情况下均加 0.50%，以及 (iii) 一个月期限 SOFR 加 1.00%，或 (b) 对于期限基准贷款，适用利差为 1.75% 加一个月、三个月或六个月利息期的期限 SOFR（受 0.00% 下限约束），并且在 (a) 或 (b) 任一情形下，还需向该等贷款人支付 2.25% 的费用。一旦提取，贷款可由公司选择随时、不时提前偿还，并且须以某些资产处置、债务发生或股权发行的收益进行提前偿还，包括须以本次发行的部分或全部收益进行提前偿还的要求。2025 年定期贷款融资项下贷款人的所有未提取承诺应在以下较早发生者发生时终止：(i) 2025 年 4 月 7 日和 (ii) 本次发行交割。

(ii) the greater of (A) the federal funds effective rate and (B) the overnight bank funding rate, in each case, plus 0.50%, and (iii) the one month term SOFR plus 1.00% or (b) for term benchmark loans, an applicable margin of 1.75% plus the term SOFR (subject to a 0.00% floor) for a one, three, or six month interest period plus, in the case of either of clauses (a) or (b), a fee of 2.25% payable to the lenders thereof. Once drawn, the loans are prepayable at any time, from time to time, at the Company’s option, and are required to be prepaid with the proceeds of certain asset dispositions, incurrences of indebtedness or equity issuances, including a requirement to be prepaid with some or all of the proceeds of this offering. All unfunded commitments of the lenders under the 2025 Term Loan Facility shall terminate upon the earlier to occur of (i) April 7, 2025 and (ii) the closing of this offering.

2025 年 3 月，公司签订了租赁额外空间的协议。公司预计将在未来 12 年内就这些租赁支付约 $497 million 的额外租金。

In March 2025, the Company entered into agreements to lease additional space. The Company expects to make approximately $497 million of additional rent payments over the next 12 years related to the leases.

2025 年 3 月，公司就位于单一场址的若干建筑物签订了一份租赁协议，拟用作数据中心。该协议提供 133 MW 的电力接入，预计将于 2026 年分阶段交付。公司将根据出租人发生的建设成本支付合同租金。与该租赁相关的未来 15 年期限内，合同租金支付总额介于 $3.8 billion 至 $4.8 billion 之间。

In March 2025, the Company entered into a lease agreement for various buildings located at a single site intended to be used as data centers. The agreement provides access to 133 MW of electrical power, which is expected to be delivered in phases in 2026. The Company will make contractual rent payments based on construction costs incurred by the lessor. The total contractual rent payments range from $3.8 billion to $4.8 billion over the next 15 years term related to this lease.

2025 年 3 月，公司与一家 OEM 签订了多项额外融资协议。该等融资协议的总名义余额为 $41 million。该等融资安排的期限为 2 年。公司就融资设备授予了担保权益。

In March 2025, the Company entered into various additional financing agreements with an OEM. The financing agreements have an aggregate notional balance of $41 million. The financing arrangements have a term of 2 years. The Company granted a security interest for the financed equipment.

2025 年 3 月，公司董事会批准了 2025 年股权激励计划（“2025 年计划”），该计划将与 IPO 相关联而生效。公司已预留合计 50,000,000 股 A 类普通股用于与 2025 年计划相关的发行。

In March 2025, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the 2025 Equity Incentive Plan (the “2025 Plan”), which will become effective in connection with the IPO. A total of 50,000,000 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock has been reserved for issuance in connection with the 2025 Plan.

2025 年 3 月，公司董事会批准了 2025 年员工购股计划（“2025 年 ESPP”），该计划将与 IPO 相关联而生效。公司已预留合计 10,000,000 股 A 类普通股用于与 2025 年 ESPP 相关的发行。

In March 2025, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the 2025 Employee Stock Purchased Plan (the “2025 ESPP”), which will both become effective in connection with the IPO. A total of 10,000,000 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock has been reserved for issuance in connection with the 2025 ESPP.

2024 年 12 月 31 日之后，公司董事会批准授予 8,753,320 份 RSU。基于每股首次公开发行价格，公司目前估计与该等 RSU 相关的未确认股权激励费用将约为 $360 million。该估计为初步估计，可能会发生变化，并且可能因截至本招股说明书日期的实际没收情况和实际预扣税率等因素而与最终确认金额存在重大差异。

Subsequent to December 31, 2024, the Company’s board of directors approved grants of 8,753,320 RSUs. Based on the initial public offering price per share, the Company currently estimates that the unrecognized stock-based compensation expense related to these RSUs will be approximately $360 million. This estimate is preliminary, subject to change, and may differ materially from the final amount recognized depending on factors such as actual forfeitures through the date of this prospectus and actual tax withholding rates.
